title_zh: BATRAW：退役电池包回收与关键原材料循环
title_en: Recycling of end of life battery packs for domestic raw material supply chains and enhanced circular economy

title_zh: 新加坡先进再制造与技术中心
title_en: Singapore Advanced Remanufacturing and Technology Centre
summary_zh: 通过公私合作和会员联合体，将应用研究转向产业制造、再制造和能源装备解决方案。
summary_en: A public–private membership consortium connects applied research with manufacturing, remanufacturing and energy-equipment solutions.
actors_zh: A*STAR、南洋理工大学，以及跨国企业、中小企业和初创企业会员。
actors_en: A*STAR, Nanyang Technological University and multinational, SME and start-up members.
mechanism_zh: 研究能力与产业会员需求在同一平台对接，合作覆盖能源等行业，促进技术试验与工业应用。
mechanism_en: Research capabilities meet member demand on a shared platform spanning energy and other industries.
observed_zh: 能源与航空、快消品、陆路交通、生物医药制造一起被列为五个产业支柱，联合体吸纳跨国企业、中小企业和初创企业。
observed_en: Energy is one of five pillars alongside aerospace, FMCG, land transport and biomedical manufacturing; membership includes multinationals, SMEs and start-ups.
constraints_zh: 转化能力依赖本地工程人才、试验设施和企业共同定义问题的能力。
constraints_en: Translation depends on local engineering skills, test facilities and the ability to jointly define industrial problems.
transfer_zh: 可围绕区域主导产业建设共享应用研究中心，使中小企业接入跨国企业的研发和供应链需求。
transfer_en: Build shared applied-research centres around regional industries, connecting smaller firms with multinational R&D and supply-chain needs.

title_zh: RECIRCULATE：电池表征、自动拆解与再利用交易
title_en: Reuse of batteries through characterisation, smart logistics, automated pack and module dismantling and repackaging and a blockchain enabled marketplace.
summary_zh: 由Centria协调，连接电池健康与安全状态表征、人工智能自动拆解、DHL参与的逆向物流以及区块链电池护照和交易平台。目标是使退役电池在维修、再使用、再制造和回收之间按状态分流；福特参与电动交通应用衔接。 联合体包括7个国家的11家机构，其中企业9家、高校及研究机构2家；欧盟最高资助额4.90百万欧元。

Combining these advances with a blockchain-based platform, that will combine the data collected during dismantling and recycling and the battery provenance, will enable a unique battery passport and virtual marketplace for e-mobility, consumer and stationary Battery Energy Storage Systems. title_zh: 全球电池联盟电池护照试点
title_en: Global Battery Alliance battery-passport pilots
summary_zh: 电池企业、追溯服务商与供应链伙伴试验产品级可持续性数据采集，探索电池护照的规则与验证。
summary_en: Battery firms, traceability providers and supply-chain partners pilot product-level sustainability data collection and passport verification.
actors_zh: 全球电池联盟、试点联合体、电芯制造商、数字追溯服务商及供应链企业。
actors_en: GBA, pilot consortia, cell manufacturers, traceability providers and supply-chain firms.
mechanism_zh: 使用多方制定的规则采集数据并形成原型护照，以试验识别数据完整性、验证及互操作问题。
mechanism_en: Multistakeholder rules guide data collection and prototype passports, revealing completeness, verification and interoperability issues.
observed_zh: 2024年试点由10个联合体形成原型护照；报告同时指出不同追溯系统互操作性未在该轮测试，试点评分不可直接跨组比较。
observed_en: Ten consortia produced prototype passports in the 2024 pilots; the report notes untested inter-provider interoperability and non-comparable pilot scores.
constraints_zh: 这是数据治理探索而非成熟的统一认证。商业保密、供应链负担与验证口径仍需处理。
constraints_en: This is a governance pilot, not a mature universal certification; confidentiality, supplier burdens and verification conventions remain important.
transfer_zh: 推进产业数据平台时，先统一指标定义与证据要求，再测试跨平台交换，不以展示二维码替代可信数据。
transfer_en: Align indicators and evidence requirements before testing cross-platform exchange; a QR code cannot substitute for trustworthy data.

title_zh: FLEXIndustries：高比例可再生能源下的工业数字灵活性
title_en: Digitally-enabled FLEXible Industries for reliable energy grids under high penetration of Variable Renewable Energy Sources (VRES)
summary_zh: 在土耳其、希腊、波兰、保加利亚和意大利的6处工业设施示范，覆盖汽车、生物燃料、聚合物、钢铁、化肥及制药。通过动态能源与过程管理平台连接储能、余热回收、热泵及需求响应；登记节能潜力目标为每年不少于159吉瓦时一次能源。 联合体包括8个国家的34家机构，其中企业23家、高校及研究机构8家；欧盟最高资助额12.38百万欧元。

title_zh: 日法里昂智慧社区联合示范
title_en: Japan–France Lyon smart-community demonstration
summary_zh: 日本与法国在里昂城市更新中联合测试建筑节能、光伏管理、电动汽车共享和社区能源数据系统。
summary_en: Japan and France tested efficient buildings, PV management, EV sharing and community energy-data systems within Lyon's redevelopment.
actors_zh: NEDO、里昂都会区、东芝及法国合作企业。
actors_en: NEDO, Lyon Métropole, Toshiba and French partner companies.
mechanism_zh: 合作备忘录与实施协议衔接公共机构和企业，将能源技术嵌入城市规划与真实用户场景。
mechanism_en: A memorandum and implementation agreements connect public agencies and firms, embedding technology in planning and real user settings.
observed_zh: NEDO公开2011—2016年示范案例，包含正能量建筑、汽车共享及充电管理、家庭能耗可视化、社区能源管理四类任务。
observed_en: NEDO documents the 2011–2016 project: positive-energy buildings, EV sharing and charging, household consumption visualisation and community energy management.
constraints_zh: 建筑规范、用户行为和数据使用条件不同，技术跨境复制需要制度与运营同步适配。
constraints_en: Building rules, user behaviour and data-use conditions vary; transfer needs institutional and operational adaptation.
transfer_zh: 从城市真实需求出发选择试验场，明确公共部门、技术企业和居民各自的权责。
transfer_en: Select test sites around real urban needs and define responsibilities of public authorities, technology firms and residents.

title_en: Wind turbine blades End of Life through Open HUBs for circular materials in sustainable business models

To this end, EoLO-HUBs will develop 3 open hubs to co-design, co-create and demonstrate new technologies, organizational structures, business models and legal recommendations to implement CE according to the needs of the different European regions. The Knowledge Hub will connect stakeholders to effectively collaborate on similar initiatives, sharing data and spilling over g
actors_zh: 由FUNDACION AITIIP（西班牙）协调。登记参与方共15家，来自6个国家；其中企业8家，高校1家、研究机构4家。
actors_en: Coordinated by FUNDACION AITIIP (ES). 15 registered participants in 6 countries: 8 companies, 1 higher-education and 4 research organisations.
mechanism_zh: Horizon Europe创新行动。项目期为2023-01-01至2026-12-31；欧盟最高资助额为9.99百万欧元，登记总成本为12.09百万欧元。
mechanism_en: Horizon Europe IA; 2023-01-01 to 2026-12-31. Maximum EU contribution EUR 9.99 million; registered total cost EUR 12.09 million.
observed_zh: 官方登记技术目标：建立知识、陆上以及跨行业与海上三个开放枢纽。知识枢纽分享数据和实践；示范枢纽连接叶片拆解、涂层回收、溶剂解聚及热解等路线，并考虑复合材料跨行业使用。登记目标是接近90%的叶片材料回收，并配套商业模式和法律安排研究。
observed_en: Registered technical objectives: Wind turbine blades End of Life through Open HUBs for circular materials in sustainable business models

title_zh: PILATUS：硅异质结背接触电池数字化中试线
title_en: Digitalised pilot lines for silicon heterojunction tunnel interdigitated back contact solar cells and modules
summary_zh: 基于背接触硅异质结tunnel-IBC技术建设硅片、电池与组件三条数字化中试线。登记目标为硅片产能15兆瓦、电池190兆瓦、组件年产能至少170兆瓦，结合在线计量与户外监测改进制造，最终良率目标不低于90%。这些为计划指标，不是已核实产出。 联合体包括6个国家的13家机构，其中企业8家、高校及研究机构5家；欧盟最高资助额10.16百万欧元。
summary_en: PILATUS is a 3-year project aiming to demonstrate by 2025 three digitalised pilot lines for the production in Europe of silicon wafers, solar cells, and modules. PILATUS will leverage on the patented and already proven back-contacted silicon heterojunction “tunnel-IBC” technology to ensure achieving its ambitious targets. PILATUS will prove a production capacity of 15 MW for M10 silicon wafers in Norway using polysilicon from Europe and demonstrate the feasibility of an expansion to 5 GW wafer production capacity. PILATUS’ PV module pilot line will reach a minimum of 170 MW of annual production capacity, accompanied with 190 MW cell capacity
actors_zh: 由UNIRESEARCH BV（荷兰）协调。登记参与方共13家，来自6个国家；其中企业8家，高校2家、研究机构3家。
actors_en: Coordinated by UNIRESEARCH BV (NL). 13 registered participants in 6 countries: 8 companies, 2 higher-education and 3 research organisations.
mechanism_zh: Horizon Europe创新行动。项目期为2022-11-01至2025-10-31；欧盟最高资助额为10.16百万欧元，登记总成本为13.33百万欧元。
mechanism_en: Horizon Europe IA; 2022-11-01 to 2025-10-31. Maximum EU contribution EUR 10.16 million; registered total cost EUR 13.33 million.
observed_zh: 官方登记技术目标：基于背接触硅异质结tunnel-IBC技术建设硅片、电池与组件三条数字化中试线。登记目标为硅片产能15兆瓦、电池190兆瓦、组件年产能至少170兆瓦，结合在线计量与户外监测改进制造，最终良率目标不低于90%。这些为计划指标，不是已核实产出。
observed_en: Registered technical objectives: Digitalised pilot lines for silicon heterojunction tunnel interdigitated back contact solar cells and modules

title_zh: 中美清洁汽车联合研发知识产权安排
title_en: US–China clean-vehicle R&D IP arrangements
summary_zh: 清洁汽车联合研发通过技术管理计划约定知识产权利用，为跨国公私研究团队提供合作安排。
summary_en: A Technology Management Plan establishes IP-use arrangements for cross-border public–private clean-vehicle research.
actors_zh: 美国能源部、阿贡国家实验室、中国相关主管部门、清华大学及公私研究团队。
actors_en: US DOE, Argonne National Laboratory, Chinese authorities, Tsinghua University and public/private research teams.
mechanism_zh: 两国牵头机构组织团队和联合工作计划；技术管理计划对接既有清洁能源研究中心合作框架。
mechanism_en: National lead institutions organise teams and joint work plans; the management plan implements the CERC cooperation framework.
observed_zh: 美国能源部公布2016—2020年技术管理计划及阿贡国家实验室、清华大学的牵头安排，并标明文件不具法律约束力。
observed_en: DOE publishes the 2016–2020 plan and Argonne/Tsinghua lead arrangements, identifying the instrument as not legally binding.
constraints_zh: 历史协议不能证明当前合作持续；制度设计需区分合作意愿、合同可执行性和研究安全限制。
constraints_en: Historical agreements do not prove continuing cooperation; intent, contract enforceability and research-security limits must be distinguished.
transfer_zh: 可借鉴事先明确知识产权利用和双方牵头责任的做法，但应按现行规则评估协议效力与合作边界。
transfer_en: Define IP use and lead responsibilities in advance, while assessing enforceability and cooperation boundaries under current rules.

title_zh: 欧盟清洁氢能伙伴关系
title_en: EU Clean Hydrogen Partnership
summary_zh: 公共部门、产业与研究界联合支持氢能研发和示范，将制氢、储运与终端应用纳入协同布局。
summary_en: Public authorities, industry and researchers jointly support hydrogen research and demonstration across production, storage, distribution and use.
actors_zh: 欧盟委员会、Hydrogen Europe与Hydrogen Europe Research。
actors_en: European Commission, Hydrogen Europe and Hydrogen Europe Research.
mechanism_zh: 以公私伙伴关系组织研发项目，并通过氢谷将不同环节与区域需求衔接。
mechanism_en: A public–private partnership organises projects, while hydrogen valleys connect value-chain activities with regional needs.
observed_zh: 公私伙伴关系将欧盟委员会、产业组织与研究组织纳入共同架构；氢谷项目将生产、储运和终端使用在区域层面连接。
observed_en: The partnership joins the Commission, industry and research organisations; hydrogen valleys connect production, storage, distribution and use at regional level.
constraints_zh: 氢谷适配取决于电力成本、稳定用氢需求、基础设施与许可条件，不能仅靠设备投资形成生态。
constraints_en: Valley suitability depends on electricity costs, sustained hydrogen demand, infrastructure and permits, not equipment investment alone.
transfer_zh: 以明确终端需求组织产业伙伴，将共同研发、示范设施与基础设施责任同步安排。
transfer_en: Organise partners around concrete demand, aligning joint research and demonstration facilities with infrastructure responsibilities.

title_zh: 澳大利亚CSIRO氢能产业任务
title_en: Australia CSIRO Hydrogen Industry Mission
summary_zh: 以产业任务组织氢能研究、技术示范和国际合作，连接国内应用与出口价值链的技术需求。
summary_en: A mission links hydrogen research, demonstration and international cooperation with domestic and export value-chain needs.
actors_zh: CSIRO、澳大利亚研究团队、产业伙伴及海外研发机构。
actors_en: CSIRO, Australian researchers, industrial partners and overseas research organisations.
mechanism_zh: 产业任务将研究网络、国际合作和示范设施连接，用实际试验推动技术走向商业准备阶段。
mechanism_en: The mission connects research networks, international cooperation and facilities to test technologies approaching commercial readiness.
observed_zh: 官方记录Hadean Energy利用氢能示范设施测试千瓦级电解槽组件，并将国际研究合作作为产业任务的一部分。
observed_en: Official material records Hadean Energy testing a kilowatt-class electrolyser bundle and international research cooperation within the mission.
constraints_zh: 出口价值链取决于海外需求、成本与认证；研发合作不能消除这些市场约束。
constraints_en: Export chains depend on external demand, costs and certification; research partnerships do not remove these constraints.
transfer_zh: 用产业任务统筹研究和试验，但将技术验证、市场承诺与规模化投资分别评估。
transfer_en: Coordinate research and testing through a mission, while assessing technical validation, demand commitments and scale-up separately.

title_zh: 联合国气候技术中心与网络需求驱动援助
title_en: CTCN demand-driven technology assistance
summary_zh: 由发展中国家提出技术需求，经国家联络机构确认后，组织专家网络提供适配当地的技术支持。
summary_en: Developing countries request technology assistance through national focal points, with expert networks providing locally tailored support.
actors_zh: CTCN、国家指定实体、申请机构以及实施技术支持的网络成员。
actors_en: CTCN, National Designated Entities, applicants and implementing network members.
mechanism_zh: 国家联络机构核对需求与本国优先事项；中心与申请方形成支持方案，再选择实施伙伴。
mechanism_en: National focal points check alignment with priorities; CTCN and applicants design support plans and select implementing partners.
observed_zh: 官方流程依次包括国家需求确认、共同设计技术支持方案、选择实施伙伴；服务覆盖能力建设、技术试点与制度框架。
observed_en: The documented process covers national needs confirmation, support-plan design and implementing-partner selection, spanning capacity, pilots and institutional frameworks.
constraints_zh: 技术适配依赖受援机构能力和后续实施资源，专家报告不能自动转化为持续运营。
constraints_en: Suitability depends on recipient capabilities and implementation resources; expert advice does not automatically create sustained operation.
transfer_zh: 后发国家可用明确场景提出需求，将外部专家支持与本地组织、人员培训和后续融资衔接。
transfer_en: Latecomer countries can specify application needs and link external expertise with local organisations, training and follow-on financing.

title_zh: 欧洲InnoEnergy教育、创新与创业协同
title_en: European InnoEnergy education–innovation–enterprise model
summary_zh: 将创业教育、企业加速与能源创新支持结合，连接高校、产业和金融参与方。
summary_en: Entrepreneurial education, acceleration and energy-innovation support connect higher education, industry and finance.
actors_zh: EIT支持建立的知识与创新共同体、大学、企业、投资者与创新团队。
actors_en: An EIT-established Knowledge and Innovation Community, universities, firms, investors and innovators.
mechanism_zh: 国际教育与创业支持相衔接，通过网络连接业务开发、产业资源和创新技术商业化。
mechanism_en: International education connects with venture support and networks for business development, industrial resources and commercialisation.
observed_zh: EIT资料记载共同体2010年建立，创业加速、国际硕士教育和产业网络被组合为能源技术商业化支持体系。
observed_en: EIT documentation records establishment in 2010 and a combination of acceleration, international master's education and industrial networks supporting commercialisation.
constraints_zh: 平台网络可提供入口，但资本投入和市场准入仍需按技术与国家情境判断，不能由成员关系推定收益。
constraints_en: Networks provide access, but investment and market entry remain technology- and country-specific; membership does not establish returns.
transfer_zh: 将研究生培养与产业问题、创业实践和资本对接结合，保持技术能力与商业验证并重。
transfer_en: Combine graduate education with industrial challenges, venture practice and finance while retaining both technical and market validation.

title_zh: 巴西EMBRAPII产业研发与国际合作
title_en: Brazil EMBRAPII industrial R&D and international cooperation
summary_zh: 经认证的研究单元与企业共同定义研发项目，并以公共支持分担前竞争阶段的研发成本。
summary_en: Accredited research units and firms define R&D projects, with public support sharing pre-competitive development costs.
actors_zh: EMBRAPII、巴西研究与技术机构、企业及国际合作资助伙伴。
actors_en: EMBRAPII, Brazilian research and technology institutions, companies and international funding partners.
mechanism_zh: 企业直接与研究单元协商技术和商业范围；国际项目由各国伙伴分别向本国支持机构申报。
mechanism_en: Firms negotiate technical and commercial scope with research units; international partners apply through their respective national agencies.
observed_zh: 国际合作流程要求巴西企业与国外伙伴分别在本国申报，企业可直接与研究单元协商技术与商业范围。
observed_en: International procedures require Brazilian and foreign partners to apply domestically; firms negotiate technical and commercial scope with research units.
constraints_zh: 研究单元能力与企业需求是否匹配，以及两国资助条件是否同步，是跨境项目的重要约束。
constraints_en: The fit between research capabilities and firm demand, alongside coordination of national funding conditions, constrains cross-border projects.
transfer_zh: 后发国家可认证已有研究机构，而非先新建大量机构，以产业合同和绩效要求组织国际研发接口。
transfer_en: Latecomer countries can accredit existing institutions and organise international R&D around industrial contracts and capability requirements.

title_zh: Eurostars中小企业跨境联合研发
title_en: Eurostars SME-led cross-border R&D
summary_zh: 由创新型中小企业牵头国际研发联合体，以市场导向项目连接不同国家的企业和科研团队。
summary_en: Innovative SMEs lead international consortia linking companies and researchers through market-oriented R&D.
actors_zh: Eureka网络、欧盟及参与国资助机构；瑞士由Innosuisse提供项目支持。
actors_en: Eureka, the EU and participating funding agencies, including Innosuisse in Switzerland.
mechanism_zh: 共同项目与国际评审对接国家资助体系；资格、可资助费用和支持强度受参与方所在地规则约束。
mechanism_en: Joint projects connect international assessment with national funding; eligibility and support remain subject to domestic rules.
observed_zh: 公开资格指南要求创新型中小企业牵头并组成独立实体联合体；瑞士官方页面说明其如何对接国际项目与本国支持。
observed_en: Public eligibility guidance requires an innovative SME lead and independent consortium entities; Swiss guidance explains the international-to-national funding interface.
constraints_zh: 协调难点在于多国资助节奏、联合体责任和成果分配，而非单纯增加合作伙伴数量。
constraints_en: Coordination centres on funding schedules, consortium responsibilities and allocation of results, not partner counts.
transfer_zh: 区域间复制时，应先协调国家资助接口、项目退出与知识产权约定，再开放企业联合申报。
transfer_en: For regional replication, align funding interfaces, exit procedures and IP agreements before opening joint applications.

title_zh: 德国弗劳恩霍夫应用研究与国际合作
title_en: Fraunhofer applied research and international cooperation
summary_zh: 以企业委托研发、长期合作和创新集群衔接科学研究与工业应用，并通过国际合作连接外部能力。
summary_en: Contract research, strategic partnerships and innovation clusters connect applied science with industrial use and international capabilities.
actors_zh: 弗劳恩霍夫研究机构、企业、大学及国际合作伙伴。
actors_en: Fraunhofer institutes, companies, universities and international partners.
mechanism_zh: 企业技术需求进入合同研发；长期合作支持连续研发，集群与衍生企业拓展成果转化路径。
mechanism_en: Industrial problems enter contract research; long-term partnerships, clusters and spin-offs provide routes to translation.
observed_zh: 官方合作指南提供合同研发、长期战略伙伴、创新集群和衍生企业四类转化渠道；国际布局结合伙伴与市场分析。
observed_en: Official guidance identifies contract R&D, strategic partnerships, clusters and spin-offs; international engagement includes partner and market assessment.
constraints_zh: 模式依赖稳定的应用研究能力与企业付费需求；研究机构数量并不能替代技术吸收能力。
constraints_en: The model needs sustained applied-research capabilities and firms able to commission research; institute counts cannot substitute for absorptive capacity.
transfer_zh: 先建立面向产业共性难题的研究单元与清晰合同，再开展跨境合作；经费结构需适应当地企业能力。
transfer_en: Build specialised units and clear contracts around industrial problems first; adapt funding arrangements to local firms before scaling international cooperation.

title_zh: 绿色电力未来使命跨国协同
title_en: Green Powered Future Mission collaboration
summary_zh: 以共同创新路线图组织高比例可再生电力研究，比较不同地理与气候条件下的系统灵活性和集成路径。
summary_en: A shared roadmap coordinates high-renewable power research across geographies, focusing on flexibility and system integration.
actors_zh: 中国、意大利和英国共同牵头，其他参与方提供研究、政策和示范合作。
actors_en: China, Italy and the UK co-lead, with other participants contributing research, policy and demonstration cooperation.
mechanism_zh: 将技术优先事项、示范项目、数字工具与可复制性研究衔接，形成供不同国家选择的技术路径。
mechanism_en: Innovation priorities connect with demonstrations, digital tools and replicability studies to develop pathways for different countries.
observed_zh: 共同路线图于2021年11月发布，围绕可再生电力、系统灵活性和集成安排研究与示范；中国、意大利、英国共同牵头。
observed_en: A roadmap released in November 2021 organises research and demonstrations on renewable power, flexibility and integration, co-led by China, Italy and the UK.
constraints_zh: 电力市场、气候条件和灵活性资源不同，单一技术组合难以直接复制到所有国家。
constraints_en: Power markets, climate and flexibility resources differ; no single technology mix is directly transferable everywhere.
transfer_zh: 跨国共同任务应比较系统条件，在当地电网约束下验证储能、需求响应和控制技术的组合。
transfer_en: Joint tasks should compare system conditions and validate storage, demand response and control combinations under local grid constraints.

title_zh: 南非HySA氢能研发与产业试验
title_en: South Africa HySA research and industrial testing
summary_zh: 高校、研究机构和企业围绕氢能设备与燃料电池开展研发，通过本地试验设施连接技术与产业应用。
summary_en: Universities, research institutions and firms develop hydrogen equipment and fuel cells, using local facilities to connect research and industrial applications.
actors_zh: 南非DSTI、西北大学、CSIR等HySA机构；部分示范与丰田南非合作。
actors_en: South Africa DSTI, North-West University and CSIR/HySA institutions; Toyota South Africa participates in a demonstration.
mechanism_zh: 专业中心形成研发分工，试验平台支持原型、部件和系统验证，产业伙伴参与应用示范。
mechanism_en: Specialised centres divide research tasks; platforms support prototype and system validation with industrial demonstrations.
observed_zh: 移动加氢设施于2025年2月建成，DSTI公开其与丰田南非的合作及设施交付；CSIR报告记录HySA专业中心间的分工。
observed_en: A mobile hydrogen refuelling facility was completed in February 2025; DSTI documents Toyota South Africa cooperation and handover, while CSIR records specialised centres.
constraints_zh: 示范设施证明了工程试验能力，但不能单独证明大规模氢能市场成熟或项目盈利。
constraints_en: Demonstration facilities establish testing capabilities, not the maturity or profitability of a large hydrogen market.
transfer_zh: 资源优势需与本地研发、知识产权和工程技能结合；先形成可测试的产品与应用再扩大产业链投资。
transfer_en: Combine resource advantages with local R&D, IP and engineering skills, testing products and applications before expanding investment.

title_zh: 国际数据空间可信数据共享
title_en: International Data Spaces trusted data sharing
summary_zh: 通过参考架构、连接器与认证规则组织企业间数据共享，强调数据提供者对使用条件的控制。
summary_en: Reference architecture, connectors and certification organise inter-company sharing with provider control over data-use conditions.
actors_zh: 国际数据空间协会、成员组织、连接器开发者与数据空间参与方。
actors_en: IDSA, member organisations, connector developers and data-space participants.
mechanism_zh: 公开技术规范和认证框架连接身份、可信交换和数据使用控制，为协同研发与产业数据利用提供接口。
mechanism_en: Public specifications and certification connect identity, trusted exchange and usage control for research and industrial data collaboration.
observed_zh: 协会公开参考架构和认证框架，采用连接器、数据使用条件和可追溯机制组织可信交换，提供区别于全面集中数据的平台路径。
observed_en: Public architecture and certification frameworks use connectors, usage conditions and traceability for trusted exchange, offering an alternative to fully centralised platforms.
constraints_zh: 该案例为制度与技术基础设施对照，不是能源项目成果；技术可互通和法律可跨境须分别判断。
constraints_en: This is an institutional/technical comparator, not an energy-project outcome; technical interoperability and legal transferability are separate questions.
transfer_zh: 能源数据平台可采用可控共享而非全面集中：先界定数据用途、访问权限和审计责任，再连接多方。
transfer_en: Energy platforms can favour controlled sharing over full centralisation, defining purposes, access and audit responsibilities before interconnection.

title_zh: 国际能源署技术合作计划
title_en: IEA Technology Collaboration Programme
summary_zh: 通过跨国专家组开展能源技术研发与示范，将政府、研究机构和产业需求连接到共同任务。
summary_en: International expert groups connect governments, research organisations and industry through energy RD&D tasks.
actors_zh: 国际能源署合作框架；各技术合作计划的政府、产业及研究参与方。
actors_en: IEA cooperation framework and the government, industry and research participants of individual programmes.
mechanism_zh: 围绕共同技术问题组织任务，参与方共享专业知识与研究工作；具体任务和资源承诺由各计划安排。
mechanism_en: Participants organise tasks around shared technical problems; individual programmes arrange work and resource commitments.
observed_zh: 框架成立于1975年；官网按技术领域提供在运行的合作计划目录，供研究机构与产业方识别合作入口。
observed_en: Established in 1975, the framework provides a directory of ongoing programmes by technology area for research and industrial participants.
constraints_zh: 共同目标有助于合作持续，但各方投入、数据权限和成果使用仍需在任务层面明确。
constraints_en: Shared goals support cooperation, but task-level agreements still need to define contributions, data access and use of results.
transfer_zh: 后发国家可从有本地应用场景的任务切入，以试验数据和专业人才交换知识，而非复制全部研发体系。
transfer_en: Latecomer countries can enter tasks relevant to local applications, contributing test data and expertise rather than duplicating entire R&D systems.

title_zh: IECRE可再生能源国际合格评定
title_en: IECRE renewable-energy conformity assessment
summary_zh: 以统一规则和国际标准组织可再生能源设备合格评定，推动认证机构与测试实验室之间的一致实施。
summary_en: Common rules and international standards organise renewable-equipment conformity assessment across certification bodies and test laboratories.
actors_zh: IEC及IECRE体系中的认证机构、实验室、供应商和终端用户。
actors_en: IEC and certification bodies, laboratories, suppliers and end users participating in IECRE.
mechanism_zh: 规则统一证书含义、信息提交与合格评定流程，寻求减少重复工作并协调体系内分歧。
mechanism_en: Rules align certificate meanings, information requirements and assessment procedures, seeking to reduce duplication and resolve disagreements.
observed_zh: 体系规则统一证书含义和信息要求，公开证书平台支持检索已签发记录，为设备供应链提供可核查的合格评定入口。
observed_en: System rules align certificate meanings and information requirements; a public registry enables checks of issued certificates for equipment supply chains.
constraints_zh: 标准、检测能力与市场监管要求需要共同衔接，国际证书不能替代目的地法律合规。
constraints_en: Standards, testing capabilities and market rules need alignment; international certificates do not replace destination-law compliance.
transfer_zh: 对出口导向产业，建设可参与国际合格评定的实验室，比只增加本地标准数量更有针对性。
transfer_en: For export industries, develop laboratories able to participate in international assessment rather than merely adding domestic standards.

title_zh: 摩洛哥Green Innoboost绿色创新支持
title_en: Morocco Green Innoboost green innovation support
summary_zh: 将创新资金、创业支持与绿色能源试验设施结合，帮助技术团队连接科研平台和商业伙伴。
summary_en: Innovation finance, venture support and green-energy test facilities connect technology teams with research platforms and commercial partners.
actors_zh: IRESEN、创新团队、大学、企业及潜在投资者。
actors_en: IRESEN, innovators, universities, companies and prospective investors.
mechanism_zh: 提供Green Energy Park等设施入口，同时支持采购服务、技术试验与投资者联系。
mechanism_en: Access to facilities such as Green Energy Park is combined with services procurement, testing and investor connections.
observed_zh: 国际能源署记录资金、设施和投资者对接支持，并指出IRESEN支持科特迪瓦太阳能研究平台，以测试热带条件下的技术。
observed_en: IEA documents finance, facilities and investor connections, and records IRESEN support for a solar research platform in Côte d'Ivoire to test tropical conditions.
constraints_zh: 设施可用性必须与工程辅导和本地市场需求结合；试验条件不同会影响技术适配。
constraints_en: Facility access must be combined with engineering support and local demand; environmental differences affect suitability.
transfer_zh: 将公共试验平台与创业服务打包，跨区域推广时先验证当地气候、维护能力和付费需求。
transfer_en: Bundle public testing with venture services, and validate climate, maintenance capabilities and customer demand before regional transfer.

title_zh: 国际太阳能联盟STAR-C能力建设网络
title_en: ISA STAR-C capacity-building network
summary_zh: 建设太阳能技术与应用资源中心网络，把培训、共享设施、测试和技术应用能力带入成员国。
summary_en: Solar technology resource centres connect training, shared facilities, testing and application capabilities across member countries.
actors_zh: 国际太阳能联盟、成员国与当地培训及技术机构；联盟由印度和法国共同发起。
actors_en: ISA, member countries and local training/technical institutions; the alliance originated with India and France.
mechanism_zh: 以国家或区域中心承接技能培养、技术知识和应用服务，连接本地机构与国际太阳能能力网络。
mechanism_en: National or regional centres provide skills, knowledge and application services, linking local institutions with an international network.
observed_zh: 官方项目资料列明资源中心的培训、测试、孵化及标准化功能，并记录2018—2019年来自25国的133人参加培训。
observed_en: Official project material identifies training, testing, incubation and standardisation functions and records 133 trainees from 25 countries in 2018–2019.
constraints_zh: 设备部署之外，本地运维人员、机构能力和可持续服务经费决定中心是否有效。
constraints_en: Beyond equipment, local maintenance skills, institutional capacity and sustainable service funding determine usefulness.
transfer_zh: 通过已有高校或技术机构构建区域资源中心，把人才培养与项目运维需求一起安排。
transfer_en: Build centres through existing universities or technical institutions and connect training with project operation needs.

title_zh: ITER国际聚变研发与实物贡献机制
title_en: ITER international fusion research and in-kind contributions
summary_zh: 成员共同建设大型聚变科研装置，通过实物贡献、共享实验结果和知识产权安排组织跨国研发。
summary_en: Members jointly develop a fusion research facility through in-kind contributions and arrangements for shared results and intellectual property.
actors_zh: 中国、欧盟、印度、日本、韩国、俄罗斯、美国；装置位于法国。
actors_en: China, EU, India, Japan, Korea, Russia and the US; the facility is located in France.
mechanism_zh: 成员分担建设等成本，国内机构对接设备供给，国际协议界定组织治理及成果共享。
mechanism_en: Members share costs and supply equipment through domestic agencies; international agreements define governance and sharing of results.
observed_zh: 成员共同承担建设、运行和退役成本，并共享实验结果与项目产生的知识产权；装置用于验证聚变的科学和技术可行性。
observed_en: Members share construction, operation and decommissioning costs, experimental results and generated IP; the facility tests scientific and technological feasibility of fusion.
constraints_zh: 大型设施合作要求长期资金承诺、接口标准与可执行的治理安排，不能等同于一般企业研发联盟。
constraints_en: Large-facility cooperation requires long-term financing, interface standards and implementable governance, unlike a routine business R&D alliance.
transfer_zh: 对高投入共性技术，可学习共享设施与贡献责任设计；应限定任务边界并明确成果使用和退出条件。
transfer_en: For capital-intensive technologies, shared facilities and contribution responsibilities are transferable, provided task boundaries and result-use conditions are explicit.

title_zh: 肯尼亚气候创新中心本地创业与国际连接
title_en: Kenya Climate Innovation Center local ventures and global links
summary_zh: 向本地气候企业提供技术和商业支持，并通过大学及国际伙伴合作连接创新竞赛、孵化和融资。
summary_en: Local climate ventures receive technical and business support, linked to competitions, incubation and finance through university and international partnerships.
actors_zh: KCIC、肯尼亚企业、斯特拉斯莫尔大学，以及瑞士驻肯尼亚使馆和SICPA等合作方。
actors_en: KCIC, Kenyan ventures, Strathmore University, the Swiss Embassy in Kenya and SICPA.
mechanism_zh: 以创业团队的实际环境问题为起点，连接技术支持、市场信息、设施与融资准备。
mechanism_en: Support starts from practical environmental problems and links expertise, market intelligence, facilities and finance readiness.
observed_zh: 中心自2012年开展企业支持，公开太阳能、电动出行等领域服务；清洁技术竞赛与大学、瑞士机构合作吸纳早期团队。
observed_en: Operating since 2012, the centre documents solar and electric-mobility support; a university and Swiss-partner competition engages early-stage teams.
constraints_zh: 此模式侧重技术吸收和创业能力，并非所有团队都承担基础科学研究；竞赛入选不证明商业成功。
constraints_en: The focus is absorption and entrepreneurship rather than basic research in every venture; selection is not commercial success.
transfer_zh: 能力有限地区可先补足技术、市场与融资之间的接口，以应用需求筛选创新，而非照搬大型研发中心。
transfer_en: Regions with limited capacity can strengthen technical, market and finance interfaces, selecting demand-led innovations rather than copying large research centres.

title_zh: 麻省理工能源计划产业会员合作
title_en: MIT Energy Initiative industry membership
summary_zh: 产业会员将现实能源问题与MIT研究团队连接，通过研究支持和行业交流对接科研议题。
summary_en: Industry membership connects real-world energy problems with MIT research teams through research support and exchange.
actors_zh: MIT Energy Initiative、不同规模企业以及公共部门会员。
actors_en: MIT Energy Initiative, companies of different sizes and public-sector members.
mechanism_zh: 会员提供产业问题与研究机会，研究团队开展相关研究；分层参与方式拓展合作入口。
mechanism_en: Members bring industrial problems and research opportunities; tiered participation provides different entry routes.
observed_zh: 会员制度面向不同规模的企业及公共部门，提供研究交流、合作机会和跨学科能源研究的参与渠道。
observed_en: Membership offers research exchange, collaboration opportunities and interdisciplinary energy engagement to firms of different sizes and public-sector organisations.
constraints_zh: 大企业与中小企业的研究预算和议题影响力可能不同，应单独安排可负担的参与方式。
constraints_en: Large and smaller firms differ in research budgets and agenda-setting capacity; affordable participation routes matter.
transfer_zh: 高校平台可将产业问题清单、跨学科研发和可分层参与的合作制度结合，避免只依赖单一资助方。
transfer_en: University platforms can combine industrial problem lists, interdisciplinary research and tiered engagement to avoid dependence on one sponsor.

title_zh: 英国ORE Catapult风电开放测试
title_en: UK ORE Catapult open wind testing
summary_zh: 开放大型测试设施与工程能力，联合产业伙伴验证风机、叶片和电气系统，衔接研发与认证需求。
summary_en: Large-scale facilities and engineering expertise help industrial partners validate turbines, blades and electrical systems for development and certification.
actors_zh: ORE Catapult、GE Renewable Energy等产业伙伴，以及研究与认证相关参与方。
actors_en: ORE Catapult, industrial partners including GE Renewable Energy, and research/certification participants.
mechanism_zh: 采用代表性试验与电网模拟等能力，减少研发测试对现场条件的依赖，连接研究、工程与产品验证。
mechanism_en: Representative testing and grid emulation connect research and engineering with product validation, reducing reliance on field conditions.
observed_zh: 公开资料记录GE风机测试合作；评估报告说明eGrid验证结果被英国电网接受用于替代部分现场数据。
observed_en: Public records document GE turbine testing; an evaluation describes National Grid acceptance of eGrid results in place of field data.
constraints_zh: 测试可支持合格评定，但不等于所有目的地市场自动认可；设备尺度和利用率影响设施经济性。
constraints_en: Testing can support conformity assessment but does not guarantee acceptance in every market; scale and utilisation affect facility economics.
transfer_zh: 共享大型测试设施比企业各自建设更适合共性验证需求，但需同步设计认可范围和产业参与机制。
transfer_en: Shared facilities suit common validation needs, provided recognition scope and industrial participation are designed together.

title_zh: IEA PVPS光伏可靠性跨气候研究
title_en: IEA PVPS Task 13 cross-climate reliability research
summary_zh: 汇集不同气候区光伏运行资料与试验经验，支持组件质量、可靠性和发电量评估。
summary_en: Operating data and testing experience from different climates support assessments of PV quality, reliability and yield.
actors_zh: IEA PVPS Task 13研究团队及参与机构、行业使用者。
actors_en: IEA PVPS Task 13 researchers, participating institutions and industry users.
mechanism_zh: 跨区域研究对比新应用和环境条件，形成可供项目开发、运营与质量管理使用的报告。
mechanism_en: Cross-regional research compares applications and environments, producing reports for development, operation and quality management.
observed_zh: 官方列明2026—2029年跨气候光伏研究，2026年项目决策报告把质量管理、发电性能和经济价值连贯分析。
observed_en: Official material identifies the 2026–2029 cross-climate research phase; a 2026 report links quality management, performance and economic value.
constraints_zh: 运行数据的可比性取决于试验条件、采样和指标口径；建议并非具有强制力的全球统一标准。
constraints_en: Comparability depends on testing conditions, sampling and indicator conventions; guidance is not a binding global standard.
transfer_zh: 技术引进应配套本地气候运行数据与可靠性验证，利用国际研究降低重复试验而非省略当地验证。
transfer_en: Technology adoption should include local operating data and reliability checks, using international work to reduce duplication rather than eliminate local validation.

title_zh: 印美太阳能研究联合体SERIIUS
title_en: India–US Solar Energy Research Institute SERIIUS
summary_zh: 联合印度与美国研究力量，围绕光伏和光热发电技术成本开展协作，衔接两国太阳能发展需求。
summary_en: Indian and US researchers collaborated on PV and concentrating solar power costs, aligning research with both countries' solar needs.
actors_zh: 印度科学研究院、NREL、桑迪亚国家实验室及相关研发伙伴。
actors_en: Indian Institute of Science, NREL, Sandia National Laboratories and research partners.
mechanism_zh: 联合体以共同技术任务组织研究；光热研究包括发电循环、集热器和接收器等环节。
mechanism_en: Shared tasks organise research, including power cycles, collectors and receivers for concentrating solar power.
observed_zh: 桑迪亚2012年报告记录光伏、光热研究任务；其公开的2016年光热循环技术经济论文注明SERIIUS资助，形成可追溯科研成果。
observed_en: Sandia's 2012 report records PV and CSP tasks; a public 2016 solar-cycle technoeconomic paper acknowledges SERIIUS support, providing a traceable research output.
constraints_zh: 这是历史合作案例，不能由早期研究计划推定目前仍按原规模运行，也不能把性能目标当成已实现指标。
constraints_en: This is a historical case: early plans do not establish current scale or achieved performance.
transfer_zh: 适合比较具有相近技术需求但不同应用条件的国家，联合任务需包含面向当地条件的试验和人才培养。
transfer_en: Joint tasks are useful where technical needs overlap but application conditions differ; local testing and training should be included.

title_zh: WIPO GREEN绿色技术供需对接
title_en: WIPO GREEN technology matchmaking
summary_zh: 通过技术与需求数据库连接绿色技术供给者和寻求解决方案的机构，提供许可、合作和合资线索。
summary_en: A technology-and-needs database connects green-technology suppliers and seekers, providing leads for licensing, collaboration and joint ventures.
actors_zh: 世界知识产权组织、技术持有者、企业、机构和非政府组织。
actors_en: WIPO, technology holders, companies, institutions and NGOs.
mechanism_zh: 供给方发布技术，需求方描述应用问题，平台开展自动匹配并连接技术与潜在使用者。
mechanism_en: Suppliers list technologies and seekers state application needs; automated matching connects potential counterparts.
observed_zh: 公开数据库覆盖从原型到可销售产品，允许发布出售、许可、合作和合资信息，并支持技术与需求的自动匹配。
observed_en: The public database covers prototypes through marketable products, with sale, licence, collaboration and joint-venture information and automated matching.
constraints_zh: 许可条件、适用场景与技术成熟度仍须交易双方协商，平台无法替代知识产权尽调。
constraints_en: Licensing terms, use conditions and maturity still require negotiation; the platform cannot replace IP due diligence.
transfer_zh: 开放平台宜同时结构化记录技术能力和真实需求，补充许可状态、试验条件和联络渠道。
transfer_en: Open platforms should structure both capabilities and demand, with licensing status, test conditions and contact routes.

title_zh: 剑桥科学园大学土地与产业研发集聚
title_en: Cambridge Science Park university land and industrial research
summary_zh: 剑桥大学三一学院1970年创办的科学园，利用大学土地和长期运营安排，为研究型企业提供集聚空间，连接学术研究与产业发展。
summary_en: Founded by Trinity College Cambridge in 1970, the science park uses university land and long-term stewardship to connect research-intensive firms with academia.
actors_zh: 剑桥大学三一学院、园区运营团队和入园科研及科技企业。
actors_en: Trinity College Cambridge, the park operator and resident research and technology firms.
mechanism_zh: 通过大学关联的空间载体组织科研企业集聚，使企业接近大学研究和人才网络；园区提供的组织环境与具体项目成果分开记录。
mechanism_en: A university-linked location places firms close to academic research and talent networks; the enabling environment is recorded separately from project outcomes.
observed_zh: 官方历史明确1970年创办，并介绍长期容纳生命科学、电子与可持续材料等企业研发活动。
observed_en: The official history records the 1970 foundation and subsequent research activity in life sciences, electronics and sustainable materials.

title_zh: 深圳虚拟大学园跨校科研与产业对接
title_en: Shenzhen Virtual University Park research and industrial links
summary_zh: 深圳虚拟大学园自1999年起集聚境内外高校资源，面向深圳产业组织科研、人才培养与成果转化。园区通过联席会议等方式连接高校和地方创新需求。
summary_en: Founded in 1999, the park connects domestic and overseas universities with Shenzhen research, training and translation needs through a shared local platform.
actors_zh: 深圳市科技创新主管部门、园区服务机构及入园高校，官方会议报道列举清华大学、北京大学和香港大学等。
actors_en: Shenzhen science and technology authorities, the park service organisation and participating universities, including Tsinghua, Peking University and the University of Hong Kong.
mechanism_zh: 地方提供共享组织载体，引入不同大学的科研与人才资源，再通过园区协调开展本地合作。其机制重在跨校资源对接，不把大学名称数量作为转化效果。
mechanism_en: A shared local organisation brings together university resources and coordinates industrial links; its function is inter-university access rather than a count of institutional names.
observed_zh: 2024年联席会议回顾园区1999年成立的历程，并报道其资源集成实践于2023年入选国家自主创新示范区改革创新典型案例。
observed_en: The 2024 joint meeting recalled the 1999 foundation and reported recognition of its resource-integration practice in a national reform case list in 2023.

title_zh: 斯坦福研究园大学与企业研发共址
title_en: Stanford Research Park university and industrial research co-location
summary_zh: 斯坦福大学与帕洛阿尔托1951年合作建立的研究园，通过大学附近的研发空间承接科技企业与研发团队，形成大学知识、人才和企业研发活动的连接。
summary_en: Founded in 1951 through a partnership between Stanford and Palo Alto, the park hosts companies and research teams close to university knowledge and talent.
actors_zh: 斯坦福大学、帕洛阿尔托市及入园企业，官方介绍列明Varian、惠普、SAP和特斯拉等历史或现有研发参与者。
actors_en: Stanford University, the City of Palo Alto and tenants, with the official history naming Varian, HP, SAP and Tesla among past or present participants.
mechanism_zh: 由大学关联园区提供研发集聚空间和社区联系，企业保持独立运营，并通过邻近大学接触科研和人才资源。
mechanism_en: A university-affiliated park provides research space and community links while companies operate independently and access nearby academic resources.
observed_zh: 官方园区历史将起点标为1951年，并记录多个时期企业研发部门在园区布局；这些企业不被假定为同时在场或共同完成同一项目。
observed_en: The official history dates the park to 1951 and records corporate research tenants over different periods, without implying simultaneous tenancy or participation in one project.

title_zh: 荷兰TNO应用研究与产业合作
title_en: TNO applied research and industrial collaboration
summary_zh: 荷兰1932年依法设立的应用科学研究组织，围绕社会和产业问题组织科研合作，在能源、产业、建筑和数字技术等领域提供研究能力。
summary_en: Established by law in 1932, TNO organises applied research around societal and industrial problems, including energy, industry, buildings and digital technology.
actors_zh: TNO应用研究团队、企业合作方和公共部门；不同项目的参与者按各自协议组织。
actors_en: TNO research teams, industrial partners and public organisations, with participation arranged at project level.
mechanism_zh: 以独立应用研究机构衔接知识研究与产业需要，按研究主题开展多方合作，不要求所有企业将研发活动集中到同一园区。
mechanism_en: An independent applied-research organisation connects knowledge with industrial needs through thematic collaborations rather than requiring all research to share one park.
