constraints_zh: 共享产线需管理过敏原、清洁和配方保密，中试结果还要通过具体产品合规验证。
constraints_en: Shared lines require allergen, cleaning and recipe confidentiality controls plus product-specific compliance checks.
transfer_zh: 对食品企业采用预约式中试与专业支持，把工艺测试和市场小批量验证连接。
transfer_en: Offer booked pilots with technical support, linking process tests to small-batch market validation.

title_zh: 乌拉圭Latitud应用研发与产业链服务
title_en: Uruguay Latitud applied R&D and value-chain services
summary_zh: LATU的研发创新基金会Latitud与生产部门合作，用科学技术改进企业价值链和可持续性。
summary_en: Latitud, LATU's R&D foundation, works with production sectors to improve industrial value chains and sustainability.
actors_zh: Latitud、乌拉圭技术实验室LATU、应用研究人员及企业。
actors_en: Latitud, LATU, applied researchers and firms.
mechanism_zh: 以企业和产业链改进机会组织应用研究，让研究结果进入生产问题解决过程。
mechanism_en: Industrial improvement opportunities organise applied research and its use in production problem-solving.
observed_zh: 官方成立五周年回顾说明基金会以LATU能力服务企业，推动技术引入和知识生成。
observed_en: The official five-year review documents the use of LATU capabilities for firms' technology adoption and knowledge development.
constraints_zh: 产业服务范围不代表各行业采用同一种路径，食品和材料工艺要求需分别处理。
constraints_en: A broad service remit does not imply a single pathway; food and materials require distinct process conditions.
transfer_zh: 以价值链的具体损耗、质量与资源效率问题组织合作，保持企业参与研究设计。
transfer_en: Organise collaboration around losses, quality and resource efficiency, involving firms in research design.

title_zh: 新西兰Scion林业与生物经济工程服务
title_en: New Zealand Scion forestry and bioeconomy engineering services
summary_zh: Scion为林业、工业制造和先进技术客户提供咨询、检测、中试开发与科研成果商业化服务。
summary_en: Scion offers advice, testing, pilot development and research commercialisation for forestry, manufacturing and technology clients.
actors_zh: Scion研究人员、工程与商业化人员及国内外企业客户。
actors_en: Scion researchers, engineering/commercialisation specialists and domestic/international clients.
mechanism_zh: 将研究咨询、技术测试与中试开发组合，为客户补充产品和工艺开发能力。
mechanism_en: Advice, testing and pilot development supplement clients' product and process capabilities.
observed_zh: 官方服务页明确咨询、技术建议、检测、中试开发及成果商业化的服务链条。
observed_en: The official service page documents the chain from consulting and testing to pilots and commercialisation.
constraints_zh: 服务清单说明可提供的能力，并非具体客户已取得效果；机构改革不改变历史案例的日期属性。
constraints_en: A service list describes capabilities, not client impacts; institutional reforms do not make historical observations current outcomes.
transfer_zh: 围绕生物质资源、材料工艺和客户验证提供连续工程服务，不以论文数量替代产业交付。
transfer_en: Deliver continuing services around biomass, materials processes and customer validation rather than publication counts.

title_zh: 深圳先进院产业创新协同
title_en: SIAT industry-oriented research collaboration
summary_zh: 中国科学院、深圳市与香港中文大学共建科研机构，以研究平台连接医疗器械和生物制造产业创新。
summary_en: CAS, Shenzhen and the Chinese University of Hong Kong jointly established SIAT, linking research to medical-device and biomanufacturing innovation.
actors_zh: 中国科学院、深圳市政府、香港中文大学及产业创新中心。
actors_en: CAS, Shenzhen government, CUHK and industrial innovation centres.
mechanism_zh: 以科研平台为基础，牵头组建高性能医疗器械创新中心和生物制造产业创新中心。
mechanism_en: Research capabilities underpin the high-performance medical-device and biomanufacturing innovation centres led by SIAT.
observed_zh: 机构简介明确记载三方共建关系及两类产业创新中心，不将中心设立等同于产品成功。
observed_en: The institutional profile documents the founding partnership and industrial centres; their establishment is not evidence of product success.
constraints_zh: 医工和生物制造转化需要验证场景、质量控制及专业监管能力，不能仅复制组织名称。
constraints_en: Medical and biomanufacturing translation also require validation settings, quality control and regulatory capabilities.
transfer_zh: 围绕产业共性难题建设专业研发中介，将临床或生产验证责任落实到合作方。
transfer_en: Build specialised intermediaries around shared industrial challenges and allocate clinical or production validation responsibilities to partners.

title_zh: 松山湖医工融合创新中心
title_en: Songshan Lake medical-engineering innovation centre
summary_zh: 广东医科大学与东莞理工学院共建医工平台，通过医院需求、工程研发及企业合作开发医疗设备原型。
summary_en: Guangdong Medical University and Dongguan University of Technology jointly connect medical needs, engineering and firms to develop device prototypes.
actors_zh: 广东医科大学、东莞理工学院、医疗场景合作方及华为等企业。
actors_en: The two universities, medical-setting partners and firms including Huawei.
mechanism_zh: 两校共同提供资金、场地和人员，围绕康复器具、智慧医疗及生物材料开展联合研发。
mechanism_en: The universities contribute funds, facilities and personnel for rehabilitation devices, smart healthcare and biomaterials.
observed_zh: 大学发布的2025年纪实记录医用物流机器人等样机及染色体核型分析、口腔导航等七台套原型设备。
observed_en: The university's 2025 account records medical-logistics prototypes and seven prototype devices including karyotype analysis and dental navigation.
constraints_zh: 原型不等于获批产品，医工合作必须继续经过临床验证与注册评价。
constraints_en: Prototypes are not approved products; clinical validation and regulatory assessment remain necessary.
transfer_zh: 在研发早期明确临床需求、工程验收与注册路径，避免只考核样机数量。
transfer_en: Specify medical needs, engineering acceptance and regulatory pathways early rather than rewarding prototype counts alone.

title_zh: 国家合成生物技术创新中心研发转化平台
title_en: National Synthetic Biotechnology Innovation Centre
summary_zh: 合成生物中心以公司作为法人运营主体，将技术研发、成果转化、企业孵化和资本运营纳入同一平台。
summary_en: The centre uses a corporate operator to integrate R&D, technology transfer, incubation and capital operations.
actors_zh: 天津国家合成生物技术创新中心有限公司、科研团队及产业化企业。
actors_en: The centre's operating company, research teams and commercialisation firms.
mechanism_zh: 通过专业法人承接技术开发与转化服务，组织科研成果向企业应用衔接。
mechanism_en: A specialised legal operator connects technical development and transfer services to industrial applications.
observed_zh: 研究所2025年公开说明确认公司的法人和管理运营机构身份及四类业务职能。
observed_en: The institute's 2025 notice identifies the legal/operating entity and its four functions.
constraints_zh: 运营职能不等于量产能力，生物工艺仍须验证批次稳定性、成本和安全。
constraints_en: Operating functions do not establish manufacturing readiness; bioprocesses still require repeatability, cost and safety tests.
transfer_zh: 针对生物工艺分别设置实验验证、放大和生产准入节点，明确平台与企业的责任。
transfer_en: Set distinct laboratory, scale-up and production-admission gates, allocating responsibilities between platform and firms.

title_zh: 数据中心低能耗集成光互连
title_en: Ultra-Energy-Efficient Integrated DWDM Optical Interconnect
summary_zh: 惠普实验室与加州大学圣巴巴拉分校拟将低成本激光制造、低能耗光子调谐与既有平台结合，开发用于高性能计算和数据中心的多通道集成光收发器。
summary_en: Hewlett Packard Labs will develop a low energy consumption, ultra-efficient, high-speed technology to transmit data as light in high-performance computing systems and data centers. The team will combine recent breakthroughs in low-cost laser manufacturing and ultra-efficient photonic tuning technology with their established platform. It will demonstrate a fully integrated optical transceiver capable of sending data faster than 1,000 gigabytes per second over 40 simultaneous channels, even in rigorous practical operating conditions with widely varying…
actors_zh: Hewlett Packard Labs；合作单位：University of California, Santa Barbara。
actors_en: Hewlett Packard Labs; named partners: University of California, Santa Barbara
mechanism_zh: 企业研究实验室与高校光子学研究结合，围绕实际运行温度条件验证光互连技术。
mechanism_en: ARPA-E OPEN 2018 research collaboration led by Hewlett Packard Labs with the named partners.
observed_zh: ARPA-E项目 3000，OPEN 2018计划。登记资助3,191,608美元；项目期2020-04-01至2023-12-31；官网状态为历史项目。
observed_en: ARPA-E project 3000, OPEN 2018. Listed award: USD 3,191,608. Technical objectives are not achieved performance or commercial output.

title_zh: 数据中心无缝光互连网络
title_en: Seamless Interconnect Networks
summary_zh: 麻省理工团队拟开发统一的数据中心光通信技术，通过新型光子材料、器件、异质集成与低成本封装设计，提高互连的能效和带宽密度。
summary_en: The Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) will develop a unified optical communication technology for use in datacenter optical interconnects. Compared to existing interconnect solutions, the proposed approach exhibits high energy efficiency and large bandwidth density, as well as a low-cost packaging design. Specifically, the team aims to develop novel photonic material, device, and heterogeneously integrated interconnection technologies that are scalable across chip-, board-, and rack-interconnect hierarchy levels. The MIT design uses an optical bridge to connect silicon…
actors_zh: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)；合作单位：Dartmouth College、LaXense Inc.。
actors_en: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT); named partners: Dartmouth College; LaXense Inc.
mechanism_zh: 高校光子研究与LaXense技术开发结合，共同研究材料、器件与互连封装。
mechanism_en: ARPA-E ENLITENED research collaboration led by Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) with the named partners.
observed_zh: ARPA-E项目 3593，ENLITENED计划。登记资助1,564,529美元；项目期2017-07-01至2021-04-15；官网状态为历史项目。
observed_en: ARPA-E project 3593, ENLITENED. Listed award: USD 1,564,529. Technical objectives are not achieved performance or commercial output.

title_zh: 数据中心相干共封装光网络
title_en: Coherent Wavelength Switched Co-packaged Optics to Disrupt Datacenters/HPC
summary_zh: 加州大学圣巴巴拉团队拟将光学器件与交换芯片共同封装，简化传统远距离相干通信技术，使其适用于数据中心和高性能计算的紧凑节能互连。
summary_en: The UC Santa Barbara team aims to develop a networking solution based on coherent co-packaged optics (optics and switch silicon together in the same package), which enable the transport of much more information. Coherent link technology underpins all long-distance fiberoptic communications, but today is too complicated, power hungry, and bulky to be used within datacenters. This project aims to demonstrate a simplified, highly energy-efficient coherent link architecture based on electro-absorption modulators, semiconductors that can modulate the intensity of a laser beam, in a multi-micron…
actors_zh: University of California, Santa Barbara (UC Santa Barbara)；合作单位：Rockley Photonics, Inc.。
actors_en: University of California, Santa Barbara (UC Santa Barbara); named partners: Rockley Photonics, Inc.
mechanism_zh: 高校与Rockley Photonics合作，把相干光通信方法推进到芯片封装内。
mechanism_en: ARPA-E ENLITENED research collaboration led by University of California, Santa Barbara (UC Santa Barbara) with the named partners.
observed_zh: ARPA-E项目 3620，ENLITENED计划。登记资助850,000美元；项目期2020-08-25至2023-02-24；官网状态为历史项目。
observed_en: ARPA-E project 3620, ENLITENED. Listed award: USD 850,000. Technical objectives are not achieved performance or commercial output.

title_zh: 数据中心芯片封装光子集成
title_en: Photonic Integration for Datacenters
summary_zh: 加州大学圣巴巴拉拟将高效光子接口直接集成到芯片封装中，协同设计光子和电子组件，以提高网络交换机带宽并减少互连能耗。
summary_en: The University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB) will develop and demonstrate a technology platform that integrates efficient photonic interfaces directly into chip "packages." The simultaneous design and packaging of photonics with electronics will enable higher bandwidth network switches that are much more energy efficient. Traditional electronic switches toggle connections between wires, each wire providing a different communication channel. Having a limited number of communication channels means that electronic switches can lead to "fat" hierarchical networks, consuming energy each time…
actors_zh: University of California, Santa Barbara (UC Santa Barbara)；合作单位：Lucidean Inc.。
actors_en: University of California, Santa Barbara (UC Santa Barbara); named partners: Lucidean Inc.
mechanism_zh: 高校与Lucidean合作，将光子接口设计和电子封装制造连接。
mechanism_en: ARPA-E ENLITENED research collaboration led by University of California, Santa Barbara (UC Santa Barbara) with the named partners.
observed_zh: ARPA-E项目 4132，ENLITENED计划。登记资助12,377,750美元；项目期2017-09-01至2025-04-29；官网状态为历史项目。
observed_en: ARPA-E project 4132, ENLITENED. Listed award: USD 12,377,750. Technical objectives are not achieved performance or commercial output.

title_zh: 北航杭州创新研究院
title_en: Beihang Hangzhou Innovation Institute
summary_zh: 省、市、区与北航共建研究院，围绕低空安全、具身智能、空间智能和量子传感组织研究平台。
summary_en: A province–city–district partnership with Beihang organises platforms for low-altitude safety, embodied intelligence, spatial intelligence and quantum sensing.
actors_zh: 北京航空航天大学、浙江省、杭州市、滨江区与研究团队。
actors_en: Beihang University, Zhejiang, Hangzhou, Binjiang district and research teams.
mechanism_zh: 依托空天信息学科优势，由研究中心和前沿平台组织专业任务。
mechanism_en: Research centres and frontier platforms organise specialist tasks using aerospace and information-science capabilities.
observed_zh: 官方简介明确四个研究方向及八个研究中心、十六个前沿创新平台。
observed_en: The official profile specifies four directions, eight research centres and sixteen frontier platforms.
constraints_zh: 平台数量不是产业采用率，任务与地方企业需求的连接需要单独验证。
constraints_en: Platform counts are not adoption rates; connections to local industrial demand require separate validation.
transfer_zh: 将国家科技任务和地方应用场景分别设置交付节点，防止两类目标相互替代。
transfer_en: Set separate milestones for national research missions and local applications so one does not substitute for the other.

title_zh: 韩国ETRI中小企业技术转化支持
title_en: Korea ETRI SME technology-commercialisation support
summary_zh: ETRI专门转化部门围绕公共研究成果建立商业化支持体系，帮助中小企业增强技术竞争力。
summary_en: ETRI's dedicated division commercialises public-research technologies and supports SME technical competitiveness.
actors_zh: 韩国电子通信研究院技术商业化部门与中小企业。
actors_en: ETRI's technology-commercialisation division and SMEs.
mechanism_zh: 将技术转移与企业支持制度结合，帮助研发成果进入企业应用和业务开发。
mechanism_en: Technology transfer combines with SME support to connect research results to industrial applications and business development.
observed_zh: 官方组织说明明确商业化体系建设、技术转移支持及中小企业培育职责。
observed_en: The official division profile identifies commercialisation-system development, transfer support and SME development functions.
constraints_zh: 公共技术供给必须匹配企业工程和市场能力，不能从组织职责推定采用效果。
constraints_en: Public technology supply must match firm engineering/market capabilities; responsibilities do not establish adoption impacts.
transfer_zh: 技术许可附带必要的工程咨询和企业吸收支持，按采用与产品验证评价转化。
transfer_en: Pair licensing with engineering advice and absorptive support, assessing adoption and product validation.

title_zh: 海西研究院团队与产业示范转化
title_en: Haixi institute team-based technology translation
summary_zh: 海西研究院把前沿研究、关键技术和产业示范连接，通过团队、项目与成果共同转化推动光芯片产业应用。
summary_en: Haixi links frontier research, enabling technologies and industrial demonstrations through team/project-based translation of optical-chip research.
actors_zh: 海西研究院、福建物构所、科研团队及中科光芯等产业化主体。
actors_en: Haixi, Fujian's structure-of-matter institute, researchers and firms including Sino-Semiconductor.
mechanism_zh: 以人才团队、项目和成果成组对接产业化主体，而非仅出售单项专利。
mechanism_en: Teams, projects and results are transferred together to industrial operators rather than through isolated patent sales.
observed_zh: 研究所2015年介绍记录开放创新价值链及半导体激光器、探测器成果与企业衔接。
observed_en: The institute's 2015 account documents the innovation chain and connections between laser/detector research and firms.
constraints_zh: 历史转化案例不能证明当前产品市场地位；产业化仍依赖制造和可靠性能力。
constraints_en: Historical transfer does not establish current market position; manufacturing and reliability capabilities remain necessary.
transfer_zh: 对团队持续服务、产品工艺和客户验证共同约定责任，避免专利转让后研发支持中断。
transfer_en: Agree ongoing team support, process delivery and customer validation to avoid discontinuity after patent transfer.

title_zh: 哈工大先进技术研究院成果对接
title_en: HIT advanced-technology institute industrial matchmaking
summary_zh: 哈工大先研院组织人工智能与机器人专场，将高校技术成果与地方产业、科技投资及转化服务机构对接。
summary_en: HIT's institute connects AI/robotics research with local industry, technology investors and transfer services through specialist matchmaking.
actors_zh: 哈工大先研院、黑龙江科技部门、新产投集团、投资及成果转化服务机构。
actors_en: HIT's institute, Heilongjiang science authorities, industrial investors and transfer-service organisations.
mechanism_zh: 以细分技术专场集中展示成果，组织产业与资本方参与交流和对接。
mechanism_en: Domain-specific events present research and convene industrial and investment partners.
observed_zh: 校方2024年报道列出人工智能与机器人首场活动及政府、投资、产业联盟等参与主体。
observed_en: The 2024 university account identifies the first AI/robotics event and participating government, investors and industrial alliance.
constraints_zh: 路演和对接只是合作入口，不能据此判断已经完成许可或形成产业收入。
constraints_en: Events are entry points, not evidence of completed licensing or industrial revenue.
transfer_zh: 跟踪对接后的技术尽调、联合试验和合同实施，形成专场活动的后续交付链。
transfer_en: Track technical due diligence, joint trials and contract implementation after matchmaking.

title_zh: 埃及NilePreneurs物联网产业加速
title_en: Egypt NilePreneurs industrial IoT accelerator
summary_zh: 尼罗大学NilePreneurs与QNB埃及合作推出物联网加速器，帮助本地中小企业和初创企业采用数字技术。
summary_en: NilePreneurs and QNB Egypt launched an IoT accelerator supporting digital adoption by local SMEs and startups.
actors_zh: 尼罗大学NilePreneurs、QNB埃及、中小企业与初创企业。
actors_en: Nile University/NilePreneurs, QNB Egypt, SMEs and startups.
mechanism_zh: 大学技术与创业支持连接金融机构和企业数字化场景，以加速计划支持物联网应用。
mechanism_en: University technical/venture support connects finance and industrial digitalisation through an IoT accelerator.
observed_zh: 大学2025年3月公告确认合作推出加速器，面向工业4.0、本地制造与数字转型。
observed_en: A March 2025 university announcement confirms the accelerator and its Industry 4.0/manufacturing focus.
constraints_zh: 启动公告不能证明企业已实现降本或效率提升，需要应用前后的实际指标。
constraints_en: Launching does not establish cost or efficiency gains; before/after operating metrics are needed.
transfer_zh: 把小规模场景试点与技能训练结合，以设备互联、可靠性和用户采用作为阶段验收。
transfer_en: Combine small application pilots with skills training, assessing connectivity, reliability and user adoption.

title_zh: 上海微技术工业研究院超越摩尔中试
title_en: SITRI More-than-Moore engineering and pilot platform
summary_zh: 上海工研院为超越摩尔集成电路提供共性技术研发、全流程中试与产业孵化服务。
summary_en: SITRI provides shared R&D, full-process piloting and incubation for More-than-Moore integrated circuits.
actors_zh: 上海市科委、嘉定区政府、新微集团、合作企业与创新团队。
actors_en: Shanghai science authorities, Jiading government, SIMIT-related group, partner firms and innovation teams.
mechanism_zh: 将科学研究、工艺开发、中试和孵化配置在研发转化功能型平台，向合作伙伴开放技术支持。
mechanism_en: A functional R&D/transfer platform connects research, process development, piloting and incubation for partners.
observed_zh: 官网确认2013年成立及共同发起主体，并列出全流程中试、共性技术研发和人才培养职能。
observed_en: The official profile identifies the 2013 founding partners and functions in full-process piloting, common technologies and training.
constraints_zh: 共线工艺需处理客户保密、排产和良率责任，专利或孵化数量不能替代制造验证。
constraints_en: Shared processing needs confidentiality, scheduling and yield responsibilities; patent/incubation counts are not manufacturing validation.
transfer_zh: 以工艺可复现性、企业试用和工程交付约束中试投入，建立清晰的共享设施使用规则。
transfer_en: Tie pilot investment to repeatable processes, firm trials and engineering delivery, with clear shared-facility rules.

title_zh: 智利天主教大学创新中心开放协作
title_en: Chile UC Innovation Centre open collaboration
summary_zh: 大学创新中心以共享空间、数字制造和企业联合实验连接研究人员、创业者及产业用户。
summary_en: The university centre connects researchers, entrepreneurs and industry through shared space, digital fabrication and joint laboratories.
actors_zh: 智利天主教大学创新中心、学者、创业团队及企业合作平台。
actors_en: UC's innovation centre, academics, entrepreneurs and industrial collaboration platforms.
mechanism_zh: 将制造原型与企业需求平台共置，促进跨学科交流及从原型到试点的合作。
mechanism_en: Co-located fabrication and demand platforms support interdisciplinary exchange and prototype-to-pilot cooperation.
observed_zh: 官网列出面向企业和学者开放的FabLab，以及连接企业问题与初创技术的Claro Lab。
observed_en: The official page identifies a FabLab open to firms/researchers and Claro Lab linking industrial problems to startup technologies.
constraints_zh: 共置能够创造接触机会，但不能据此推断合作产生因果收益。
constraints_en: Co-location creates contact opportunities, not causal evidence of benefits.
transfer_zh: 围绕共同任务设置共享空间，明确企业问题、实验条件和后续产品验证责任。
transfer_en: Configure shared space around tasks, with clear industrial problems, experimental conditions and validation responsibilities.

title_zh: 中国科大先研院技术熟化与联合研发
title_en: USTC Institute of Advanced Technology joint R&D
summary_zh: 先研院以工程中心和企业联合实验室组织技术开发、熟化、中试与成果验证。
summary_en: The institute uses engineering centres and joint industrial laboratories for development, maturation, piloting and validation.
actors_zh: 中国科大先研院、科研团队及行业龙头企事业单位。
actors_en: USTC IAT, research teams and industrial/public-sector partners.
mechanism_zh: 科研团队组建技术开发和产业运营队伍，联合实验室按企业需求开展定制化研发。
mechanism_en: Research teams form technical and commercialisation units; joint laboratories deliver demand-led customised R&D.
observed_zh: 官网研发机构简介明确记载技术熟化、中试放大、成果验证和定制化开发职能。
observed_en: The official R&D profile documents maturation, scale-up, validation and customised development functions.
constraints_zh: 联合实验室数量不能说明合同履约质量，需要检查企业投入、验证及持续使用。
constraints_en: Joint-laboratory counts do not establish delivery quality; investment, validation and continued use need checking.
transfer_zh: 将联合实验室支持与企业任务、交付及后续使用挂钩，避免重挂牌轻运营。
transfer_en: Tie joint-laboratory support to firm tasks, deliverables and continued use rather than establishment alone.

title_zh: 武汉光电工业技术研究院专业转化
title_en: Wuhan optoelectronics industrial technology institute
summary_zh: 华中科技大学光学工程学科通过专业研究院把人才培养、基础研究、技术研发与光电子成果转化连接。
summary_en: HUST's optical-engineering capabilities connect training, basic research, development and optoelectronics transfer through an industrial institute.
actors_zh: 华中科技大学光学工程团队、武汉光电工业技术研究院及产业合作企业。
actors_en: HUST optical-engineering teams, the industrial institute and industrial collaborators.
mechanism_zh: 依托光谷产业场景配置技术转移、工程示范和人才培养服务，衔接学科平台与产业链。
mechanism_en: Transfer, engineering demonstrations and training connect disciplinary capabilities to Optical Valley's industrial value chains.
observed_zh: 大学2017年学科介绍记载牵头成立研究院及专业化创新创业服务体系。
observed_en: A 2017 university profile documents the institute and its specialist innovation/entrepreneurship services.
constraints_zh: 学科集聚不是产业协同的充分条件，具体产品仍需企业集成与客户验证。
constraints_en: Disciplinary concentration is insufficient; products still require firm integration and customer validation.
transfer_zh: 围绕光电子产业共性工艺和工程验证组织服务，允许企业参与任务选择及验收。
transfer_en: Build services around shared optoelectronics processes and engineering validation, involving firms in task selection and acceptance.

title_zh: 襄阳光电工业技术研究院需求揭榜
title_en: Xiangyang optoelectronics demand-led problem solving
summary_zh: 研究院围绕襄阳臭氧污染监测需求，组织高校团队和产品厂商开发便携式激光雷达。
summary_en: The institute connects university teams and manufacturers to portable-lidar development for Xiangyang ozone monitoring.
actors_zh: 襄阳光电工业技术研究院、华中科技大学团队和国内产品厂商。
actors_en: The Xiangyang institute, HUST teams and domestic product manufacturers.
mechanism_zh: 以地方应用问题提出技术任务，高校提供探测技术，厂商负责产品实现。
mechanism_en: Local application problems define tasks, universities supply sensing technology and manufacturers implement products.
observed_zh: 学院转载报道记载2021年成立的研究院及便携式臭氧探测激光雷达合作。
observed_en: The college-hosted account documents the institute established in 2021 and the portable ozone-lidar collaboration.
constraints_zh: 单次揭榜不能保证长期运维，应区别原型交付、监测有效性与持续服务。
constraints_en: A challenge award does not guarantee maintenance; prototype delivery, monitoring validity and ongoing service are distinct.
transfer_zh: 把场景方、科研方和产品方共同纳入验收，以实际环境下的测试结果约束任务。
transfer_en: Include users, researchers and manufacturers in acceptance, using tests in the operating environment.

title_zh: 之江实验室智能计算协同与成果转化
title_en: Zhejiang Lab intelligent-computing collaboration
summary_zh: 之江实验室以智能计算任务牵引高校与企业协同，并通过成果转化平台和基金推进应用。
summary_en: Zhejiang Lab organises university–industry cooperation around intelligent computing and uses a transfer platform and fund for applications.
actors_zh: 之江实验室、浙江大学、杭州电子科技大学、浙大城市学院及产业伙伴。
actors_en: Zhejiang Lab, Zhejiang University, Hangzhou Dianzi University, Zhejiang University City College and industrial partners.
mechanism_zh: 联合建设研究与算力平台，以之科控股和成果转化基金衔接科研成果与应用。
mechanism_en: Joint research and computing platforms connect to applications through Zhike Holdings and a technology-transfer fund.
observed_zh: 2024年公开通报记载合作平台、材料智能计算研究及成果转化评价安排。
observed_en: A 2024 public account documents collaborative platforms, materials intelligent-computing research and transfer-evaluation arrangements.
constraints_zh: 大型计算设施具有固定成本；任务导向应防止与企业近期应用需求脱节。
constraints_en: Large computing facilities carry fixed costs; mission-oriented work must retain links to actual industrial needs.
transfer_zh: 对共性算力与应用项目分别设定预算和验收指标，以真实任务检验平台使用价值。
transfer_en: Budget and evaluate shared computing separately from application projects, using real tasks to test platform value.

title_zh: 碳中和与能源智联国际大科学计划（CNEST）
title_en: Carbon Neutrality and Energy System Transformation (CNEST)
summary_zh: 清华大学牵头发起的国际大科学计划培育项目，联合高校、研究机构和能源企业，研究碳中和约束下能源系统如何规划、运行与转型。项目将全球碳流监测与能量、物质及信息流分析结合，利用大数据和人工智能优化能源生产、供应、储存与使用，并组织跨学科、跨国联合研究。
summary_en: CNEST is an international big-science cultivation programme initiated and led by Tsinghua University. It brings universities, research institutes and energy companies together to investigate energy-system planning, operation and transformation under carbon-neutrality constraints, combining global carbon-flow monitoring with energy, material and information flows and data-driven optimisation.
actors_zh: 清华大学牵头，清华大学碳中和研究院参与组织。启动报道列明北京大学、北京师范大学、华北电力大学、耶鲁大学、帝国理工学院、剑桥大学等参与方；官网成员页还列示新加坡国立大学、西门子、日立等科研与产业机构。此处国别标签对应这些有明确依据的机构所在地，不代表全部成员国。
actors_en: Tsinghua University leads the initiative, with organisational participation from its Institute for Carbon Neutrality. The launch report names Peking University, Beijing Normal University, North China Electric Power University, Yale, Imperial College London and Cambridge. The official membership page also lists NUS, Siemens and Hitachi. Country tags cover these documented institutional locations, not every member country.
mechanism_zh: 以共同科学问题组织六项研究任务：能源系统理论、全球碳流观测、能源网络、智能协同技术、低碳及零碳和负碳技术、数字孪生。高校和科研机构提供系统建模与监测研究，产业参与方带入工程问题和应用需求；年度国际论坛与专业期刊承担研究交流、议题讨论和成果传播。
mechanism_en: Six research tasks address system theory, global carbon-flow observation, energy networks, intelligent coordination, low-, zero- and negative-carbon technologies, and digital twins. Academic teams contribute modelling and monitoring research, while industry brings engineering questions and application needs. International forums and a specialist journal provide channels for research exchange and dissemination.
observed_zh: 2023年11月22日举行培育项目启动工作座谈会。2025年6月27日至29日在北京举办首届国际论坛，官方报道记载19个国家的400余位代表参会，并发布北京倡议及《碳中和科技评论（英文）》期刊。2026年4月3日公布的论坛征稿通知进一步列出能源转型评估、碳监测与核算、能源网络、人工智能与能源等议题。
observed_en: A cultivation-project launch meeting took place on 22 November 2023. The first international forum was held in Beijing on 27–29 June 2025, with more than 400 representatives from 19 countries according to the official report; it launched the Beijing Initiative and Technology Review for Carbon Neutrality. A forum call published on 3 April 2026 listed topics including transition assessment, carbon monitoring and accounting, energy networks, and AI and energy.
constraints_zh: 跨国能源系统研究的执行条件包括监测与模型口径可比、数据使用授权明确、工程验证场景可获得，以及学术研究和企业应用之间的任务分工。合作网络与论坛活动能够支撑交流，但技术效果仍需由具体项目的运行数据和独立验证证明。
constraints_en: Implementation depends on comparable monitoring and modelling methods, clear data-use permissions, access to engineering validation settings and agreed academic–industrial responsibilities. Collaboration and forums support exchange; technical performance requires project-level operating evidence and independent validation.
transfer_zh: 中国地方可围绕电力系统、工业园区或城市能源系统提出可验证的共同问题，将高校的建模与碳监测能力同企业的设备、工况和试验场景配对。政府支持宜落实到数据接口、联合研究任务和示范验证条件，并通过分阶段工程结果评估合作，而非只以签约或参会规模判断成效。
transfer_en: Chinese regions can define testable questions around power systems, industrial parks or urban energy systems and pair university modelling and carbon-monitoring capabilities with industrial equipment and operating settings. Public support can focus on data interfaces, joint tasks and validation facilities, with cooperation assessed through staged engineering results rather than agreement or attendance counts.

title_zh: 日本AIST Solutions产业桥接
title_en: Japan AIST Solutions industrial bridging
summary_zh: AIST Solutions与日本产业技术综合研究所协同，从工程、市场、加速和资本等环节支持研究型初创企业。
summary_en: AIST Solutions works with AIST to support research-based startups through engineering, marketing, acceleration and capital.
actors_zh: AIST Solutions、日本产业技术综合研究所及获支持初创企业。
actors_en: AIST Solutions, AIST and supported research-based startups.
mechanism_zh: 把公共研究机构的技术能力与专业化商业支持连接，协同推进技术的事业化。
mechanism_en: Public-research capabilities connect to specialised commercial support for technology deployment.
observed_zh: 官方创业支持页列出工程、营销、商业加速和资本增强等支持环节。
observed_en: The official startup-support page identifies engineering, marketing, business acceleration and capital support.
constraints_zh: 该机构是日本桥接机制的案例，并不代表所有日本企业或行业采用同一模式。
constraints_en: This exemplifies a Japanese bridging mechanism, not a single model used by all Japanese firms or sectors.
transfer_zh: 将公共研究资源与专业转化职能分工，依据具体企业技术瓶颈选择支持方式。
transfer_en: Separate public-research and professional transfer responsibilities and match support to firms' technical bottlenecks.

title_zh: 中国东盟技术转移协作网络
title_en: China–ASEAN technology-transfer cooperation network
summary_zh: 中国东盟技术转移中心以政府间工作机制、联合工作组和企业协作网络连接跨境技术供需。
summary_en: The China–ASEAN centre connects cross-border technology supply and demand through intergovernmental mechanisms, working groups and firms.
actors_zh: 技术转移中心、广西及东盟合作部门、联合工作组与企业。
actors_en: The centre, Guangxi/ASEAN agencies, joint working groups and firms.
mechanism_zh: 通过双边技术转移机制组织合作，再以企业网络承接对接活动。
mechanism_en: Bilateral transfer mechanisms organise cooperation, with enterprise networks supporting matchmaking.
observed_zh: 广西官方白皮书记载截至2020年11月已与九个东盟国家建立双边机制，并形成企业协作网络。
observed_en: An official Guangxi white paper records bilateral mechanisms with nine ASEAN countries by November 2020 and an enterprise network.
constraints_zh: 机制和成员数不等于技术交易成功，跨境项目仍受法规、知识产权和本地吸收能力约束。
constraints_en: Mechanisms and membership are not completed transfers; regulation, IP and local absorptive capacity still constrain projects.
transfer_zh: 以具体技术合同、合规支持和本地实施伙伴作为跨境合作的交付单元。
transfer_en: Use technical contracts, compliance support and local implementation partners as the units of cross-border delivery.

title_zh: 北京协同创新研究院中心与基金联动
title_en: Beijing Institute of Collaborative Innovation centre–fund coupling
summary_zh: 研究院按行业组织高校与企业共建协同创新中心，并以专属基金连接项目遴选和后续投入。
summary_en: The institute organises university–industry centres by sector and links project selection to dedicated funds.
actors_zh: 参与高校、行业领军企业、协同创新中心及其基金。
actors_en: Participating universities, industrial firms, collaborative centres and their funds.
mechanism_zh: 采用中心与基金二元耦合安排，由基金遴选及领投项目，科研和产业人员共同参与。
mechanism_en: Centres and funds are coupled: funds select and lead investments while research and industrial staff participate.
observed_zh: 教育部所属机构2018年介绍记载行业中心、专属基金及基础研究、应用研究、产业人员的分工。
observed_en: A 2018 education-agency profile documents sector centres, dedicated funds and roles spanning basic research, applied research and industry.
constraints_zh: 这是特定时期的制度记录；基金投资决定、科研评价和公共支持需避免相互替代。
constraints_en: This is a historical institutional record; investment decisions, research assessment and public support need distinct accountabilities.
transfer_zh: 明确中心与基金的决策权限、知识产权及关联交易规则，按技术验证阶段释放资金。
transfer_en: Specify centre/fund decision rights, IP and related-party rules; release funding by validation stage.

title_zh: 重庆大学璧山先进技术研究院转化孵化
title_en: Chongqing University Bishan advanced-technology incubation
summary_zh: 璧山研究院结合校内团队成果转化与校企共同转化，利用校地平台承接企业孵化和中试。
summary_en: Bishan combines university-team and joint university–industry transfer through a local platform for incubation and piloting.
actors_zh: 重庆大学、璧山地方合作方、校内科研团队及校企合作企业。
actors_en: Chongqing University, Bishan partners, research teams and university–industry firms.
mechanism_zh: 按团队自主转化与校企共同转化组织孵化，并与空间太阳能、生物制造中试场景衔接。
mechanism_en: Incubation follows team-led and joint transfer routes, connected to space-solar and biomanufacturing pilot settings.
observed_zh: 2026年大学报道记录两类各九家孵化企业入驻、新产品发布及中试平台调研。
observed_en: A 2026 university report records nine firms in each transfer category, product releases and pilot-platform visits.
constraints_zh: 入驻与产品发布不等于销售或成熟产能，需要继续验证客户和工程需求。
constraints_en: Occupancy and product releases are not sales or mature capacity; customers and engineering requirements need further validation.
transfer_zh: 按许可、自主创业和校企合作分别管理权属与评价，公共场景向多种转化路径开放。
transfer_en: Manage ownership and appraisal separately for licensing, startups and joint transfer; open public test settings to multiple routes.

title_zh: 印度理工马德拉斯研究园产学共置
title_en: India IIT Madras Research Park industry–academia co-location
summary_zh: 研究园将产业研发与大学学者共置，通过共享交流和研发环境连接知识应用与产品服务。
summary_en: The research park co-locates industrial R&D and academics to connect knowledge with products and services.
actors_zh: 印度理工马德拉斯、研究园、产业研发团队与学者。
actors_en: IIT Madras, the research park, industrial R&D teams and academics.
mechanism_zh: 正式、非正式和主题交流空间支持持续接触，在共同研发环境中组织产业学术合作。
mechanism_en: Formal, informal and thematic spaces support ongoing interaction and industrial–academic research cooperation.
observed_zh: 学校官方介绍明确大学研究园定位及用于持续产学协作的工作、交流与网络空间。
observed_en: The university profile identifies the park and its working/networking spaces for sustained industry–academia cooperation.
constraints_zh: 空间共置不是合作合同，仍需解决项目选择、人员时间与知识产权。
constraints_en: Co-location is not a collaboration contract; project selection, staff time and IP still need agreements.
transfer_zh: 园区准入与实际联合研发挂钩，通过技术经理人把非正式交流转成可执行项目。
transfer_en: Link tenancy to actual joint R&D and use technology managers to turn informal contacts into executable projects.

title_zh: 阿根廷INTI工业技术转移
title_en: Argentina INTI industrial technology transfer
summary_zh: INTI向工业尤其是中小企业提供技术诊断、原型、工艺开发及多种技术转移合同。
summary_en: INTI provides diagnostics, prototypes, process development and flexible technology-transfer contracts, especially for SMEs.
actors_zh: 国家工业技术研究院、多学科技术人员及食品、能源、交通等企业。
actors_en: INTI, multidisciplinary specialists and firms in food, energy, mobility and other industries.
mechanism_zh: 以实验室和中试能力诊断产品与工艺问题，通过合作、许可或特许权使用费等方式分担风险。
mechanism_en: Laboratories/pilots diagnose product and process problems; cooperation, licensing and royalty arrangements share risks.
observed_zh: 官方服务页列出专利、许可、专属及风险共担合同，以及中试与先进实验室支持。
observed_en: The service page lists patents, licensing, exclusive/risk-sharing contracts, pilot plants and laboratories.
constraints_zh: 风险共担合同需有可核查的销售和权属安排，否则难以收取后续收益。
constraints_en: Risk-sharing contracts require auditable sales and ownership arrangements to support later returns.
transfer_zh: 按企业问题选择咨询、合同研发或许可，不要求所有成果都设立新公司。
transfer_en: Choose advice, contract R&D or licensing to fit firm problems rather than forcing spin-outs for every result.

title_zh: 江苏省产业技术研究院合同科研网络
title_en: JITRI contract-research and industrial innovation network
summary_zh: 江苏产研院以专业研究所、企业需求和全球创新资源组织应用研究，探索合同科研与团队激励。
summary_en: JITRI organises applied research around specialist institutes, firm demand and global capabilities, using contract research and team incentives.
actors_zh: 江苏产研院、专业研究所团队、产业企业及合作高校。
actors_en: JITRI, specialist institute teams, industrial firms and partner universities.
mechanism_zh: 通过项目经理、团队控股、拨投结合与合同科研，把研发责任和成果转化收益连接。
mechanism_en: Project managers, team ownership, grant–investment combinations and research contracts connect delivery responsibility to transfer incentives.
observed_zh: 官方概况列出一所两制、合同科研、项目经理、团队控股、股权激励等改革安排。
observed_en: The official profile lists differentiated institute arrangements, research contracts, project managers, team ownership and equity incentives.
constraints_zh: 合同收入不能覆盖所有公共研发，团队控股也需配合知识产权与公共资产规则。
constraints_en: Contracts cannot fund all public research; team ownership needs compatible IP and public-asset rules.
transfer_zh: 区分共性能力建设与企业合同任务，给予团队明确激励，同时保留公共投入绩效审查。
transfer_en: Separate shared-capability building from industrial contracts, with explicit team incentives and accountability for public funding.

title_zh: 毛里求斯产学合作研发资助
title_en: Mauritius Collaborative Research and Innovation Grant Scheme
summary_zh: 计划要求本地公司与学术或研究机构合作申请支持具有商业潜力的研发项目。
summary_en: The scheme requires local firms to partner with academic/research institutions on commercially promising R&D.
actors_zh: 毛里求斯研究与创新理事会、本地企业及学术研究机构。
actors_en: MRIC, local companies and academic/research institutions.
mechanism_zh: 以联合申请把企业技术需求和研究能力连接，资助合作研发而非单独的机构建设。
mechanism_en: Joint applications connect industrial demand to research capabilities, funding collaborative R&D rather than institutions alone.
observed_zh: 官方规则明确公司作为主要申请人，与本地学术或研究机构共同提交创新研发项目。
observed_en: Official rules identify the firm as lead applicant with a local academic/research partner.
constraints_zh: 商业潜力属于遴选条件，不是项目已经商业成功；小经济体还需考虑市场规模。
constraints_en: Commercial potential is a selection criterion, not realised success; small economies also face market-size constraints.
transfer_zh: 用企业需求与合作协议约束资助，分阶段核查技术、客户和持续融资条件。
transfer_en: Condition grants on demand and collaboration agreements, with staged checks of technology, customers and follow-on finance.

title_zh: 加拿大NRC工业研究援助
title_en: Canada NRC Industrial Research Assistance Program
summary_zh: NRC工业研究援助向加拿大中小企业提供创新研发资金，支持技术型产品与服务走向市场。
summary_en: NRC IRAP funds innovative R&D by Canadian SMEs to develop market-ready technology products and services.
actors_zh: 加拿大国家研究委员会、符合条件的加拿大中小企业及项目团队。
actors_en: NRC, eligible Canadian SMEs and project teams.
mechanism_zh: 对技术驱动的研发及相关创新活动提供资金，按企业项目连接研究投入与商业化。
mechanism_en: Funding for technology-driven R&D and innovation connects industrial projects to commercialisation.
observed_zh: 官方资金说明明确中小企业、技术产品服务研发与创新活动的支持范围。
observed_en: The official funding page specifies SME support for technology products/services and innovation activities.
constraints_zh: 公共资助不意味着商业成功，企业需承担项目实施并满足资助资格与审查。
constraints_en: Public funding is not commercial success; firms remain responsible for delivery and eligibility/review requirements.
transfer_zh: 以企业技术瓶颈和商业化计划确定资助范围，保留项目尽调及分阶段监督。
transfer_en: Define support around technical bottlenecks and commercialisation plans, with due diligence and staged monitoring.

title_zh: 澳大利亚RACE可靠可负担清洁能源合作
title_en: Australia RACE for 2030 collaborative energy research
summary_zh: RACE以行业主导的合作研究连接能源与碳转型研发、商业化、能力建设和市场应用。
summary_en: Industry-led RACE connects energy/carbon-transition research, commercialisation, capability building and market adoption.
actors_zh: 产业伙伴、澳大利亚高校、CSIRO及国际研究组织。
actors_en: Industrial partners, Australian universities, CSIRO and international research organisations.
mechanism_zh: 政府资助与伙伴现金、实物投入共同支持研发，再通过市场转化活动推广研究应用。
mechanism_en: Public grants and partner cash/in-kind contributions support research and subsequent market-transformation activities.
observed_zh: 2023年年报列出行业主导身份、大学及CSIRO伙伴，以及现金和实物共同投入方式。
observed_en: The 2023 annual report documents industry leadership, university/CSIRO partners and cash/in-kind co-contributions.
constraints_zh: 承诺资源和减排目标不等于实际支出或效果，合作资金口径需保持一致。
constraints_en: Committed resources and emissions targets are not actual expenditure or impacts; funding definitions must remain consistent.
transfer_zh: 让成果推广与研发同步规划，明确伙伴投入、试点用户和采用责任。
transfer_en: Plan dissemination alongside research and define partner contributions, pilot users and adoption responsibilities.

title_zh: 山东产业技术研究院产业链研发转化
title_en: Shandong industrial-technology research and transfer
summary_zh: 研究院围绕山东产业链布局信息技术、装备、材料、能源环保和生物医药研发，连接高校、企业与资本。
summary_en: The institute links universities, firms and capital across Shandong's ICT, equipment, materials, energy/environment and biomedicine value chains.
actors_zh: 山东省举办的新型研发机构、济南市、高校院所、企业与产业资本。
actors_en: The provincial institute, Jinan authorities, universities/research organisations, firms and industrial capital.
mechanism_zh: 以产业技术需求为牵引搭建研究、成果转化和产业化沟通桥梁。
mechanism_en: Industrial technical needs organise connections among research, transfer and commercialisation.
observed_zh: 官网明确省属事业单位及济南主管的治理结构，列出五大技术领域和产业链服务定位。
observed_en: The official site identifies provincial public-institution status, Jinan supervision, five technology domains and value-chain services.
constraints_zh: 领域宽并不等于技术优势，地方支持需落到具体研发交付与企业采用。
constraints_en: Broad scope is not technical advantage; local support should be linked to specific delivery and firm adoption.
transfer_zh: 按产业链瓶颈配置小型专业团队和阶段资金，分开评估技术开发与投资回报。
transfer_en: Allocate specialist teams and staged funding to value-chain bottlenecks, assessing technical delivery separately from investment return.

title_zh: 上海科技大学技术转移与早期孵化
title_en: ShanghaiTech technology transfer and early incubation
summary_zh: 学校将技术转移办公室、创新创业实践教育和投融资对接衔接，支持科研成果早期孵化。
summary_en: ShanghaiTech connects technology transfer, entrepreneurial education and investment matching for early research commercialisation.
actors_zh: 学校科技发展处、技术转移办公室、科研团队及投融资合作方。
actors_en: The science-development office, OTT, research teams and investment partners.
mechanism_zh: 校内专门部门协调成果运用与投融资对接，把学科、人才和孵化环节连接。
mechanism_en: Specialist offices coordinate research use and investment matching across disciplines, talent and incubation.
observed_zh: 2021年校方报道明确记载科技发展处和技术转移办公室的协调与创业投融资职能。
observed_en: A 2021 university account documents the coordinating and investment-matching roles of the two offices.
constraints_zh: 专业许可和创业孵化需要不同能力，早期资本对接也不保证形成持续收入。
constraints_en: Licensing and incubation require different capabilities; early investor access does not guarantee sustained revenue.
transfer_zh: 在成果披露时同时评估许可与创业路径，采用有技术背景的专业转化人员。
transfer_en: Assess licensing and startup routes at disclosure and employ transfer professionals with relevant technical expertise.

title_zh: 斯坦福大学技术许可与创业支持
title_en: Stanford technology licensing and startup support
summary_zh: 技术许可办公室把高校发明披露、技术检索、许可、早期转化资金及产业合同服务连接。
summary_en: OTL links invention disclosure, technology discovery, licensing, early transfer funding and industrial contracting.
actors_zh: 斯坦福研究人员、技术许可办公室、产业合同办公室及潜在被许可企业。
actors_en: Stanford researchers, OTL, the Industrial Contracts Office and prospective licensees.
mechanism_zh: 通过技术目录匹配被许可方，创业资源和HIT基金支持早期研究向应用推进。
mechanism_en: A technology catalogue matches licensees while startup resources and the HIT Fund support early translation.
observed_zh: 官方网站提供可许可技术目录、创业资源、HIT基金及产业合同办公室入口。
observed_en: The official site provides a licensable-technology catalogue, startup resources, HIT Fund and industrial-contracting services.
constraints_zh: 这是硅谷科研创业网络的一个节点，不代表硅谷全体企业，也不能将许可额等同于区域绩效。
constraints_en: This is one node in Silicon Valley's research–venture network, not the whole ecosystem or a regional performance measure.
transfer_zh: 借鉴发明披露、专业许可和利益冲突审查接口，而非机械复制园区与风险投资规模。
transfer_en: Adapt disclosure, professional licensing and conflict-of-interest interfaces rather than copying park or venture-fund scale.

title_zh: StartX科研创业者互助网络
title_en: StartX founder support network
summary_zh: StartX以非营利创业者网络提供导师、教育和资源支持，不向参与企业收取费用或索取股权。
summary_en: StartX provides mentorship, education and resources through a nonprofit founder network without charging fees or taking equity.
actors_zh: StartX、斯坦福背景创业者、导师及创业社群。
actors_en: StartX, Stanford-affiliated founders, mentors and the founder community.
mechanism_zh: 以持续的同行支持和专业导师降低创业早期的信息与能力障碍。
mechanism_en: Ongoing peer support and mentoring address early-stage information and capability barriers.
observed_zh: 斯坦福创业网络官方介绍说明导师、教育和社区支持及不收费、不取股权的安排。
observed_en: Stanford's entrepreneurship network documents mentoring, education, community support and the no-fee/no-equity arrangement.
constraints_zh: 成员资格和既有网络是前提，不能推定对所有后发地区企业同样有效。
constraints_en: Eligibility and existing networks are prerequisites; equal effectiveness in other regions cannot be assumed.
transfer_zh: 建设专业导师和同行服务，区分孵化服务与商业投资，不以入驻率替代创业质量。
transfer_en: Build mentoring and peer services, separate incubation from investment, and avoid treating occupancy as venture quality.

title_zh: 河北清华发展研究院校地技术转移
title_en: Hebei Tsinghua institute for regional technology transfer
summary_zh: 省校共建研究院将清华和京津创新资源与河北产业需求连接，方向包括高端装备、低碳环保与新型储能。
summary_en: A province–university institute links Tsinghua and Beijing–Tianjin capabilities with Hebei industry, including equipment, low-carbon technologies and storage.
actors_zh: 河北省、清华大学、京津科研团队及河北产业合作方。
actors_en: Hebei province, Tsinghua University, Beijing–Tianjin researchers and Hebei industrial partners.
mechanism_zh: 以人才汇聚、项目承载、成果转化和产业服务平台承接跨地区合作。
mechanism_en: Talent, project-hosting, transfer and industrial-service platforms support interregional cooperation.
observed_zh: 机构简介列出八个布局方向，并明确推动京津人才、技术、项目与资金向河北集聚。
observed_en: The profile lists eight domains and the connection of Beijing–Tianjin talent, technologies, projects and capital to Hebei.
constraints_zh: 转移并非简单搬迁；当地工程配套和企业吸收能力决定技术能否被采用。
constraints_en: Transfer is not relocation alone; local engineering support and firms' absorptive capacity condition adoption.
transfer_zh: 围绕河北企业可执行的工艺任务组织合作，技术交付与落地配套同步约定。
transfer_en: Organise cooperation around executable industrial tasks and agree technical deliverables alongside local implementation support.

title_zh: 清华x-lab创新创业教育与团队培育
title_en: Tsinghua x-lab entrepreneurship and venture development
summary_zh: 清华x-lab把跨学科创新创业教育与团队培育结合，为科研创业者补充商业化和组织能力。
summary_en: Tsinghua x-lab combines interdisciplinary entrepreneurship education with team development for research-based founders.
actors_zh: 清华经管学院、联合共建院系、创新创业团队及商业合作机构。
actors_en: Tsinghua SEM, participating departments, entrepreneurial teams and business partners.
mechanism_zh: 通过教育、项目培育和生态连接，将技术团队与商业机构对接，而非仅提供办公空间。
mechanism_en: Education, venture development and ecosystem connections link technical teams to business organisations rather than merely providing offices.
observed_zh: 官方介绍列出团队建设、商业化合作与公益性成果转化职能，平台面向清华学生、校友和教职工。
observed_en: The official profile documents team-building, commercialisation partnerships and nonprofit transfer support for the Tsinghua community.
constraints_zh: 校园创业服务依赖学科和导师网络，不能以参与培训人数衡量产业化成效。
constraints_en: Campus entrepreneurship depends on disciplinary and mentor networks; training attendance is not industrial impact.
transfer_zh: 把原型验证、客户访谈和团队分工作为早期支持节点，商业投资与公益教育分别管理。
transfer_en: Use prototype tests, customer interviews and team roles as early milestones; manage investment separately from nonprofit education.

title_zh: 西安交大创新港企业主导联合研发
title_en: XJTU Innovation Harbour enterprise-led joint R&D
summary_zh: 创新港将高校研究能力与企业主导研发中心、成果孵化和人才共享连接，服务产业技术任务。
summary_en: Innovation Harbour links university research to enterprise-led R&D centres, incubation and shared talent for industrial tasks.
actors_zh: 西安交通大学、西咸新区、参与企业、科研团队与金融合作方。
actors_en: XJTU, Xixian New Area, participating firms, researchers and financing partners.
mechanism_zh: 企业作为需求、投入、管理与转化主体，共建联合研发中心；孵化器与人才共用机制提供后续衔接。
mechanism_en: Firms define demand, investment, management and transfer in joint centres; incubation and shared recruitment provide follow-through.
observed_zh: 校方2024年介绍明确一中心、一孵化、两围绕、一共享安排，以及高校招、企业供的人才合作机制。
observed_en: The university's 2024 account documents joint centres, incubation, value-chain alignment and university–firm shared recruitment.
constraints_zh: 企业主导要求承担真实投入和长期任务，联合挂牌不能替代管理权与验收责任。
constraints_en: Enterprise leadership requires real investment and durable tasks; joint branding cannot substitute for decision rights and acceptance responsibilities.
transfer_zh: 先确定企业任务、资金和工程负责人，再配置校企中心；人才共聘应明确考核和知识产权。
transfer_en: Agree industrial tasks, financing and engineering leads before establishing centres; define joint-staff appraisal and IP.

title_zh: 可重复使用衬底功率晶体管制造
title_en: High-Power Transistor Fabrication
summary_zh: MicroLink团队拟改进高性能功率晶体管制造方法，减少昂贵氮化镓晶圆只能使用一次的成本约束，以推动高效功率变换器件的可负担制造。
summary_en: MicroLink Devices will engineer affordable, high-performance transistors for power conversion. Currently, high-performance power transistors are prohibitively expensive because they are grown on expensive gallium nitride (GaN) semiconductor wafers. In conventional manufacturing processes, this expensive wafer is permanently attached to the transistor, so the wafer can only be used once. MicroLink Devices will develop an innovative method to remove the transistor structure from the wafer without damaging any components, enabling wafer reuse and significantly reducing…
actors_zh: MicroLink Devices；合作单位：Ammono、Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University、University of Notre Dame、TriQuint Semiconductor。
actors_en: MicroLink Devices; named partners: Ammono; Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University; University of Notre Dame; TriQuint Semiconductor
mechanism_zh: 半导体企业联合高校和器件企业，将材料衬底处理与晶体管制造相结合。
mechanism_en: ARPA-E SWITCHES research collaboration led by MicroLink Devices with the named partners.
observed_zh: ARPA-E项目 2828，SWITCHES计划。登记资助3,225,000美元；项目期2014-03-10至2017-12-09；官网状态为历史项目。
observed_en: ARPA-E project 2828, SWITCHES. Listed award: USD 3,225,000. Technical objectives are not achieved performance or commercial output.

title_zh: 水射流地下中压电缆单次敷设
title_en: High Speed Installation of Buried Medium Voltage Electrical Distribution Lines Using a Single Pass System
summary_zh: 亚利桑那州立团队拟用高压水射流导向钻头成孔并抽走泥浆，同时敷设电缆和管道，以减少硬钻头对既有地下设施的损坏风险。
summary_en: Arizona State University is developing a water-jet underground construction tool that would deploy medium-voltage electrical cables and conduits simultaneously underground with a lower risk to existing utilities by eliminating the need for a hard drill bit. The proposed tool creates a borehole by passing high-pressure water through a steering drill head and then vacuuming the slurry back out of the borehole to clear a path for excavation. At the same time, the system installs conduit to reduce cost and schedule impacts from reaming and duct pulling…
actors_zh: Arizona State University (ASU)；合作单位：Brierley Associates Corporation、Vermeer Manufacturing Company。
actors_en: Arizona State University (ASU); named partners: Brierley Associates Corporation; Vermeer Manufacturing Company
mechanism_zh: 高校与地下工程、设备企业协作，将非传统钻进方法用于配电线路施工。
mechanism_en: ARPA-E GOPHURRS research collaboration led by Arizona State University (ASU) with the named partners.
observed_zh: ARPA-E项目 2945，GOPHURRS计划。登记资助4,263,082美元；项目期2024-09-06至2027-09-05；官网状态为进行中。
observed_en: ARPA-E project 2945, GOPHURRS. Listed award: USD 4,263,082. Technical objectives are not achieved performance or commercial output.

title_zh: 低成本高功率超导材料制造
title_en: High-Power Superconductors
summary_zh: Grid Logic与北卡罗来纳州立拟以极薄低成本金属复合层包覆超导微粒，开发新型制造工艺，以降低高功率发电、输电和配电中的超导材料成本。
summary_en: Grid Logic is developing a new type of electrical superconductor that could significantly improve the performance (in $/kA-m) and lower the cost of high-power energy generation, transmission, and distribution. Grid Logic is using a new manufacturing technique to coat very fine particles of superconducting material with an extremely thin layer-less than 1/1,000 the width of a human hair-of a low-cost metal composite. This new manufacturing process is not only much simpler and more cost effective than the process used to make today's state-of-the-art high-power superconductors, but also it…
actors_zh: Grid Logic；合作单位：North Carolina State University。
actors_en: Grid Logic; named partners: North Carolina State University
mechanism_zh: 超导企业与高校合作，将颗粒包覆研究连接至电力导体制造。
mechanism_en: ARPA-E OPEN 2012 research collaboration led by Grid Logic with the named partners.
observed_zh: ARPA-E项目 2995，OPEN 2012计划。登记资助3,828,075美元；项目期2013-03-05至2016-06-04；官网状态为历史项目。
observed_en: ARPA-E project 2995, OPEN 2012. Listed award: USD 3,828,075. Technical objectives are not achieved performance or commercial output.

title_zh: 20千伏氮化镓中压功率模块
title_en: 20-kV GaN Switch Technology Demonstrated in High-Efficiency Medium-Voltage Building Block
summary_zh: 弗吉尼亚理工团队拟通过高质量衬底和生长技术减少厚层氮化镓杂质，再采用三维封装强化散热，开发用于可再生能源并网和输配电的中压模块。
summary_en: Virginia Tech will accelerate deployment of power electronics into grid-scale energy applications by developing 20 kV GaN devices integrated into a medium-voltage (MV) power module. For the GaN power devices, high-quality substrates and innovative growth techniques will be used to reduce the background impurity contamination in the thick layers needed to block 20 kV. The power module will be fabricated using three-dimensional packaging for improved thermal management and high-power density at 20 kV. The power module will enable the full potential of high-voltage, high-temperature, and…
actors_zh: Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University (Virginia Tech)；合作单位：United Technologies Research Center、National Laboratory of the Rockies、SixPoint Materials, Inc.、University of Notre Dame。
actors_en: Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University (Virginia Tech); named partners: United Technologies Research Center; National Laboratory of the Rockies; SixPoint Materials, Inc.; University of Notre Dame
mechanism_zh: 高校功率半导体研究与企业、国家实验室合作，将器件生长推进至模块封装。
mechanism_en: ARPA-E OPEN 2018 research collaboration led by Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University (Virginia Tech) with the named partners.
observed_zh: ARPA-E项目 3030，OPEN 2018计划。登记资助3,171,562美元；项目期2019-09-01至2023-03-31；官网状态为历史项目。
observed_en: ARPA-E project 3030, OPEN 2018. Listed award: USD 3,171,562. Technical objectives are not achieved performance or commercial output.

title_zh: 低成本垂直氮化镓功率器件
title_en: Vertical GaN Devices
summary_zh: 加州大学圣巴巴拉团队拟开发垂直氮化镓半导体器件，在减少器件尺寸的同时提升高功率电子性能，并降低传统横向氮化镓器件的制造成本。
summary_en: The University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB) will develop new vertical gallium nitride (GaN) semiconductor technologies that will significantly enhance the performance and reduce the cost of high-power electronics. UCSB will markedly reduce the size of its vertical GaN semiconductor devices compared to today's commercially available, lateral GaN-on-silicon-based devices. summary_en: RESURGENCE addresses industrial circular water systems in a wide perspective which embraces efficient technologies for water circularity, energy and feedstock recovery, with the aim of contribute to EU climate neutrality, circularity, and competitiveness.RESURGENCE will work in 4 case studies that include 3 industrial sectors – Pulp&Paper, Chemical and Steel – as well as a 4th case to explore the synergies between urban water treatment and industries.Innovative solutions will be tested for water treatment – membranes, electrochemical technologies, adsorbents, advanced oxidation processes and hybrid biological systems – exploring also the reco
actors_zh: 由FUNDACION CENTRO TECNOLOGICO DE INVESTIGACION MULTISECTORIAL（西班牙）协调。登记参与方共18家，来自12个国家；其中企业8家，高校6家、研究机构1家。
