title_zh: 澳大利亚HILT重工业低碳合作研究中心
title_en: Australia HILT heavy-industry low-carbon CRC
summary_zh: HILT把钢铁、氧化铝和水泥等企业与研究机构连接，开展重工业低碳技术开发与示范。
summary_en: HILT connects heavy-industry firms and researchers on low-carbon technologies for steel, alumina and cement.
actors_zh: HILT、工业企业、CSIRO、高校及澳大利亚能源市场运营机构等伙伴。
actors_en: HILT, industrial firms, CSIRO, universities and partners including AEMO.
mechanism_zh: 以产业共性技术任务组织企业、大学与政府合作，在技术选择中引入能源系统约束。
mechanism_en: Shared industrial tasks organise cooperation, bringing energy-system constraints into technology choices.
observed_zh: 官方能源基础设施项目报道列出十二个产业与研究参与方，以及能源成本和转型路径建模任务。
observed_en: The official infrastructure-project report names 12 industrial/research participants and energy-cost/pathway modelling tasks.
constraints_zh: 能源成本情景不是已实现的减排效果，应分开处理模型假设和示范结果。
constraints_en: Energy-cost scenarios are not realised emissions reductions; assumptions and demonstrations must remain separate.
transfer_zh: 由多家企业提出共同瓶颈，用共享模型和工程试验降低重复研发成本。
transfer_en: Let firms define shared bottlenecks and use common models/engineering trials to reduce duplicated R&D.

title_zh: 南非CSIR产业创新共享设施
title_en: South African CSIR industry-innovation facilities
summary_zh: CSIR向产业开放大规模原型、预商业制造及专业技术能力，支持实验室验证向中试制造衔接。
summary_en: CSIR opens large-scale prototyping, pre-commercial manufacturing and specialist capabilities to industry.
actors_zh: 南非CSIR、科技主管部门、企业及产业创新合作资金。
actors_en: CSIR, science authorities, firms and the Industry Innovation Partnership Fund.
mechanism_zh: 公共资金支持专业设施，以共享设备、研发技能和企业网络连接产品开发与放大。
mechanism_en: Public support funds specialist facilities combining equipment, research skills and business networks for development and scale-up.
observed_zh: 官网列出生物制造、纳米材料、生物炼制和光子原型等设施，服务从验证延伸至中试制造。
observed_en: The official page lists biomanufacturing, nanomaterials, biorefinery and photonics facilities spanning validation to piloting.
constraints_zh: 本例按共享设施支持体系计一次，不将其下属设施再次累计为独立成果。
constraints_en: This case counts the support system once; subordinate facilities are not added as independent outcomes.
transfer_zh: 优先建设企业难以独立承担的工程验证能力，并以设施使用、交付和企业投入考核运营。
transfer_en: Prioritise validation capabilities beyond individual firms' resources; evaluate use, delivery and firm contributions.

title_zh: 肯尼亚德丹基马蒂大学科技园
title_en: Kenya Dedan Kimathi Science and Technology Park
summary_zh: 科技园面向设计制造、材料、生物技术及信息技术，将大学知识与企业、初创团队和市场连接。
summary_en: The park links university knowledge to firms, startups and markets in manufacturing/materials, biotechnology and ICT.
actors_zh: 德丹基马蒂理工大学、科技园、企业、政府及投资合作方。
actors_en: DeKUT, the science park, firms, government and investment partners.
mechanism_zh: 以共享服务、孵化和技术技能转移组织园区协同，连接本地与更广泛市场。
mechanism_en: Shared services, incubation and technology/skills transfer organise cooperation and market connections.
observed_zh: 官网目标说明列出三类技术领域、企业共同服务和大学产业间技术及商业技能转移。
observed_en: The official objectives identify three domains, shared business services and university–industry technology/skills transfer.
constraints_zh: 目标说明是组织设计，不代表园区全部设施已建成或企业实现增长。
constraints_en: Objectives describe institutional design, not completed facilities or demonstrated firm growth.
transfer_zh: 先建设有明确企业需求的共享工程服务，再分阶段扩建孵化和场地设施。
transfer_en: Start with shared engineering services backed by demand, then expand incubation and facilities in stages.

title_zh: 广工大数控装备协同创新研究院
title_en: GDUT CNC equipment collaborative institute
summary_zh: 校地共建数控装备研发载体，将运动控制、机器人和3D打印团队接入佛山制造产业集群。
summary_en: A university–government platform connects motion-control, robotics and 3D-printing teams with Foshan manufacturing clusters.
actors_zh: 广东工业大学、省市区政府、固高科技等企业及研发团队。
actors_en: GDUT, provincial and local governments, firms including Googol Technology, and research teams.
mechanism_zh: 地方提供建设条件，高校负责经营管理；企业与高校团队共同开发制造装备。
mechanism_en: Local authorities provide facilities and start-up support; the university manages the institute and teams co-develop equipment with firms.
observed_zh: 大学2015年报道记载固高科技与校内团队合作，并列出精密装备、机器人与3D打印创新中心。
observed_en: A 2015 university account documents Googol–university collaboration and centres for precision equipment, robotics and 3D printing.
constraints_zh: 报道属于历史案例，不能推定今天的团队数量或收入；适配依赖可服务的制造客户。
constraints_en: This is a historical case, not a current headcount or revenue claim; adaptation needs manufacturing customers.
transfer_zh: 以现有装备需求组织校企联合团队，先验证企业持续付费需求再扩建设施。
transfer_en: Organise university–firm teams around equipment demand and verify recurring willingness to pay before expanding facilities.

title_zh: 广东省智能机器人研究院
title_en: Guangdong Institute of Intelligent Robotics
summary_zh: 面向机器人与智能制造，将研发、公共试验、企业孵化和投资服务配置在同一机构。
summary_en: A robotics institute combines R&D, public testing, incubation and investment services for intelligent manufacturing.
actors_zh: 东莞市政府、研究团队、装备应用企业与投资孵化平台。
actors_en: Dongguan government, research teams, equipment users and incubation/investment platforms.
mechanism_zh: 围绕3C制造需求组织机器人、机器视觉、激光器和工业数据开发，公共试验与孵化平台承接企业应用。
mechanism_en: Robotics, vision, lasers and industrial-data development address electronics manufacturing, supported by testing and incubation.
observed_zh: 松山湖官方2020年介绍列出七类平台及面向企业的智能装备应用；这些是该时点的机构实践。
observed_en: A 2020 official profile records seven platform functions and equipment applications for firms; these are historical observations.
constraints_zh: 依赖制造企业持续提出可验证的工艺需求，基金与公共试验应分别核算绩效。
constraints_en: The arrangement needs verifiable industrial process demand; funds and public testing require separate performance accounts.
transfer_zh: 由制造企业给出验收场景，研究院负责技术组合与试验；公共资金支持共性平台而非替代企业订单。
transfer_en: Let manufacturers specify acceptance scenarios while the institute integrates and tests technologies; public funding should support shared capabilities rather than replace orders.

title_zh: 加纳KNUST技术咨询与制造转移中心
title_en: Ghana KNUST Technology Consultancy Centre
summary_zh: 中心以工程研究、先进制造、技术转移和技术创业培训连接大学与产业。
summary_en: The centre connects university capabilities to industry through engineering research, advanced manufacturing, transfer and entrepreneurship training.
actors_zh: 夸梅恩克鲁玛科技大学技术咨询中心、工程研究人员及技术服务用户。
actors_en: KNUST's consultancy centre, engineering researchers and technology-service users.
mechanism_zh: 把工程技术能力与企业技能、创业训练结合，支持技术采用和商业过程改进。
mechanism_en: Engineering capabilities combine with industrial skills and entrepreneurial training for adoption and process improvement.
observed_zh: 官方简介确认1972年成立及工程研究、制造、技术转移与创业技能培训等职责。
observed_en: The official profile records establishment in 1972 and functions in engineering, manufacturing, transfer and entrepreneurship skills.
constraints_zh: 技能建设与产品商业化有不同时间尺度，培训完成不等于企业已经采用技术。
constraints_en: Skills development and commercialisation have different timescales; training completion does not establish adoption.
transfer_zh: 将操作训练与现场工艺改进共同安排，按企业掌握和重复使用技术检验培训。
transfer_en: Link practical training to process improvements and verify mastery through repeat use by firms.

title_zh: 秘鲁ITP产业创新与技术转移网络
title_en: Peru ITP CITE productive-innovation and transfer network
summary_zh: ITP的CITE网络通过产业技术服务连接生产企业与技术能力，并以市场研究支持技术采用和转移决策。
summary_en: ITP's CITE network connects producers to technical services, using market research to inform adoption and transfer decisions.
actors_zh: 秘鲁生产技术研究院、CITE网络与接受技术服务的企业。
actors_en: ITP, CITE centres and industrial service users.
mechanism_zh: 在技术服务体系中纳入市场需求研究，为采用、适配、开发和技术转移提供决策依据。
mechanism_en: Market-demand research informs adoption, adaptation, development and transfer within technical services.
observed_zh: ITP官方仓储收录市场研究应用于研发创新的手册，明确技术采用与专业服务改进的适用方向。
observed_en: ITP's repository holds a market-research manual covering technology adoption and improvement of specialist services.
constraints_zh: 手册是工作方法依据，不是所有中心已获得产业绩效的证明。
constraints_en: A manual documents methods, not industrial results across all centres.
transfer_zh: 技术服务立项前识别用户与需求，用企业试用反馈修订服务内容和转移方式。
transfer_en: Identify users and demand before starting services, then revise delivery and transfer routes using trial feedback.

title_zh: 哥伦比亚SENA技术园原型开发网络
title_en: Colombia SENA Tecnoparque prototype-development network
summary_zh: 技术园网络向创新者提供免费专业指导和实验设施，支持研发想法形成可运行原型。
summary_en: Tecnoparque provides free specialist advice and laboratories to develop functional R&D prototypes.
actors_zh: 哥伦比亚国家职业培训局、技术园多学科团队、创新者与企业。
actors_en: SENA, multidisciplinary technology-park teams, innovators and firms.
mechanism_zh: 在电子通信、生物与纳米技术、工程设计和数字技术方向，组合个性化指导与实验室访问。
mechanism_en: Personalised advice and lab access cover electronics/telecoms, biotechnology/nanotechnology, engineering/design and digital technologies.
observed_zh: SENA官方介绍明确免费服务、功能原型、技术适配与转移等服务环节。
observed_en: SENA's official profile documents free services, functional prototyping, adaptation and technology transfer.
constraints_zh: 原型完成不等于量产或收入，下一步仍需客户、认证和生产组织。
constraints_en: Functional prototypes are not mass production or revenue; customers, certification and production organisation remain necessary.
transfer_zh: 以原型性能和企业试用决定后续支持，将公共训练与商业化融资分开衔接。
transfer_en: Use prototype performance and industrial trials to select follow-on support, linking public training to separate commercial finance.

title_zh: 巴西SENAI圣保罗创新与技术研究所网络
title_en: Brazil SENAI São Paulo innovation and technology institutes
summary_zh: SENAI圣保罗把技术教育、应用研发和实验室服务结合，按企业需求定制工业技术方案。
summary_en: SENAI-SP integrates technical education, applied R&D and laboratory services for tailored industrial solutions.
actors_zh: SENAI圣保罗创新与技术研究所、专业人员及工业客户。
actors_en: SENAI-SP institutes, technical specialists and industrial clients.
mechanism_zh: 通过研究所网络提供研发、检测和咨询，将技能培养与技术采用连接。
mechanism_en: A network delivers R&D, testing and consulting, connecting workforce skills to technology adoption.
observed_zh: 官方介绍列出十八个工业服务领域，以及数字化、脱碳和工业4.0等技术方向。
observed_en: The official profile lists 18 industrial service fields and work on digitalisation, decarbonisation and Industry 4.0.
constraints_zh: SENAI是服务实施网络，EMBRAPII是另一资助协作安排，两者相关但不能混作同一成果。
constraints_en: SENAI delivers services while EMBRAPII is a distinct funding arrangement; linked activities are not identical outcomes.
transfer_zh: 把产业培训与专业研发服务组织成连续支持，以企业实际工艺改进而非服务项目数评价。
transfer_en: Link industrial training to specialist R&D, assessing process improvements rather than service counts.

title_zh: 南非技术创新署高校技术站计划
title_en: South African TIA Technology Stations Programme
summary_zh: 技术站依托技术大学，为中小企业提供工程解决方案和技术开发服务，连接高校能力与生产需求。
summary_en: University-based technology stations provide engineering solutions and technology development for SMEs.
actors_zh: 南非技术创新署、技术大学、技术站与中小企业。
actors_en: TIA, universities of technology, technology stations and SMEs.
mechanism_zh: 在高校配置技术转移基础设施及专业人员，以技术改进支持本地供应商参与产业链。
mechanism_en: University facilities and specialists support technology transfer and supplier upgrading.
observed_zh: 官方计划页记录技术站设于高校，并明确其企业技术开发、工程问题解决和技术转移职能。
observed_en: The programme page documents university hosting, industrial development, engineering problem-solving and transfer functions.
constraints_zh: 企业工程基础和持续需求影响服务效果；不能把技术站数量当作区域生产率。
constraints_en: Firm capabilities and sustained demand condition results; station counts are not regional productivity.
transfer_zh: 围绕中小企业共同工艺问题设站，以企业试用、工程交付和技能掌握评价服务。
transfer_en: Create stations around shared SME process problems; assess industrial trials, delivery and skills adoption.

title_zh: 天津大学浙江国际创新设计与智造研究院
title_en: Tianjin University Zhejiang design and manufacturing institute
summary_zh: 天津大学与绍兴市共建独立法人研究院，结合创新设计、智能制造、企业共建研发与孵化。
summary_en: Tianjin University and Shaoxing jointly established an institute combining design, intelligent manufacturing, joint R&D and incubation.
actors_zh: 天津大学、绍兴市政府、入驻团队和企业联合研发中心。
actors_en: Tianjin University, Shaoxing government, resident teams and joint industrial R&D centres.
mechanism_zh: 以开放办院方式建设企业共建研发中心和成果转化工作站，面向地方产业需求承接项目。
mechanism_en: Open collaboration supports joint industrial centres and a transfer station responding to local industrial demand.
observed_zh: 官方简介记载2021年成立，并列出创新设计、低碳智造及电子信息等孵化方向。
observed_en: The profile records establishment in 2021 and incubation in design, low-carbon manufacturing and electronics.
constraints_zh: 研究院与天津大学浙江研究院（绍兴）为不同载体，名称近似不能合并统计。
constraints_en: This is distinct from Tianjin University's other Shaoxing institute; similar names must not be merged.
transfer_zh: 围绕企业设计和工艺改进需求建立联合任务，明确知识产权与产业化责任。
transfer_en: Create joint tasks around firms' design and process needs, with clear IP and commercialisation responsibilities.

title_zh: 岳麓山工业创新中心组网攻关
title_en: Yuelushan industrial innovation network
summary_zh: 中心以节点实验室和专业研究部组织跨机构研究，围绕湖南重点产业链的基础问题与技术瓶颈开展攻关。
summary_en: The centre uses node laboratories and specialist divisions for cross-institution research on Hunan's industrial bottlenecks.
actors_zh: 岳麓山工业创新中心、高校科研团队、技术经理人与湖南制造企业。
actors_en: The centre, university researchers, technology managers and Hunan manufacturers.
mechanism_zh: 节点实验室提供制造、设计、检测和加工能力，技术经理人负责匹配企业问题与科研团队。
mechanism_en: Node labs provide manufacturing, design, testing and processing capabilities; technology managers match industrial problems to researchers.
observed_zh: 省政府2025年介绍记录四个节点实验室、八个专业研究部及低碳充填等联合研究实践。
observed_en: The provincial 2025 profile records four node labs, eight specialist divisions and joint work including low-carbon backfilling.
constraints_zh: 平台网络需要可执行的协同合同，跨机构团队规模不能代替任务进度与交付。
constraints_en: Networks need executable collaboration contracts; team size is not task progress or delivery.
transfer_zh: 让技术经理人参与需求定义和合同组织，以企业采用和可验证的工艺改进评价攻关。
transfer_en: Involve technology managers in demand definition and contracting; evaluate adoption and verifiable process improvement.

title_zh: 浙江大学绍兴研究院
title_en: Zhejiang University Shaoxing institute
summary_zh: 浙江大学与绍兴市共建研究院，把集成电路、新材料等研发和地方产业服务连接起来。
summary_en: Zhejiang University and Shaoxing jointly connect integrated-circuit and materials research with local industrial services.
actors_zh: 浙江大学、绍兴市政府、研发团队及产业合作方。
actors_en: Zhejiang University, Shaoxing government, research teams and industrial collaborators.
mechanism_zh: 校地共建独立法人机构，公共技术平台承接检测、传感器和封装等产业需求。
mechanism_en: An independent city–university institute uses shared technical platforms for testing, sensors and packaging.
observed_zh: 官网列出微电子功率检测、MEMS传感器和集成电路先进封装三类公共技术平台。
observed_en: The official profile lists public platforms for power-device testing, MEMS sensors and advanced IC packaging.
constraints_zh: 平台跨多个方向，实际适配取决于本地企业需求与设备使用，而非高校品牌。
constraints_en: Multiple technology domains require demonstrated local demand and equipment use, not university branding alone.
transfer_zh: 按产业链具体工艺缺口配置公共服务，并公开企业使用和成果交付的可比记录。
transfer_en: Configure services around specific value-chain gaps and retain comparable records of firm use and deliverables.

title_zh: 浙江工业大学嵊州研究院厨电协同
title_en: ZJUT Shengzhou kitchen-appliance collaboration
summary_zh: 研究院深耕嵊州厨房电器产业，与厨具企业合作改进集成灶风机系统。
summary_en: The institute works with Shengzhou kitchen-appliance firms on integrated-cooker fan systems.
actors_zh: 浙江工业大学嵊州研究院和当地厨具企业。
actors_en: ZJUT's Shengzhou institute and local kitchen-appliance firms.
mechanism_zh: 高校研究力量围绕地方产业集群的具体产品性能问题开展联合研发。
mechanism_en: University capabilities are directed to concrete product-performance problems in a local industrial cluster.
observed_zh: 科技部2023年地方科技报道明确列出合作开发集成灶风机系统的实践。
observed_en: A 2023 MOST regional account identifies collaborative development of integrated-cooker fan systems.
constraints_zh: 单个产品案例能说明需求组织方式，不能据此推断整个浙江制造业的转化效率。
constraints_en: A product case illustrates demand organisation, not the efficiency of all manufacturing in Zhejiang.
transfer_zh: 以集群企业共同工艺需求组织小型专业团队，按产品测试和企业采用评价成果。
transfer_en: Organise specialised teams around shared cluster needs and evaluate product tests and adoption by firms.

title_zh: 澳大利亚蓝色经济合作研究中心
title_en: Australia Blue Economy Cooperative Research Centre
summary_zh: 中心把海洋可再生能源、海上生产与水产产业放在共同研究框架下，组织跨领域研发。
summary_en: The CRC combines marine renewables, offshore production and aquaculture in a joint research framework.
actors_zh: 蓝色经济CRC、产业与科研参与方及外部项目合作机构。
actors_en: The CRC, industrial/research participants and external project collaborators.
mechanism_zh: 以研究投资框架遴选项目，将海上工程、能源供给和产业应用任务连接。
mechanism_en: A research-investment framework selects projects linking offshore engineering, energy supply and industrial use.
observed_zh: 官方研究页给出五个研究领域及项目资助遴选框架，并连接成果采用和商业化策略。
observed_en: The research page lists five areas and funding-selection rules linked to adoption and commercialisation strategies.
constraints_zh: 跨行业共置增加工程接口，海洋生态、许可和系统可靠性需与技术研发同时验证。
constraints_en: Cross-sector integration adds interfaces; ecology, permits and reliability need validation alongside technology.
transfer_zh: 先界定共同场景及接口标准，再安排联合研发和海上验证，避免各技术孤立优化。
transfer_en: Define shared settings and interface standards before joint R&D and offshore validation.

title_zh: 大连化物所催化剂与反应过程放大
title_en: DICP catalyst and reaction-process scale-up platform
summary_zh: 催化平台针对辽宁化工产业共性难题开展催化剂和反应过程放大，把实验室成果与化工园区企业连接。
summary_en: The platform scales catalysts and reaction processes for Liaoning's chemicals industry, linking laboratory work to industrial-park firms.
actors_zh: 大连化物所催化平台、科研团队及长兴岛产业化企业。
actors_en: DICP's catalysis platform, researchers and Changxing Island commercialisation firms.
mechanism_zh: 把催化新材料、清洁转化工艺和中试放大组合，围绕工程化瓶颈组织技术转化。
mechanism_en: Catalytic materials, clean-conversion processes and piloting address engineering bottlenecks together.
observed_zh: 官方平台介绍列出中试职能，并记录2016年以来衍生的中科催化及延长中科两家企业。
observed_en: The official profile lists piloting functions and two spin-out firms established since 2016.
constraints_zh: 衍生企业成立不等于持续盈利，化工过程还需安全评价和连续运行验证。
constraints_en: Spin-out formation is not sustained profitability; chemical processes require safety review and continuous-operation tests.
transfer_zh: 在产业园区复用工程与安全条件，按连续工艺验证、成本和客户采用分阶段支持。
transfer_en: Reuse industrial-park engineering and safety capabilities, funding stages against process tests, costs and adoption.

title_zh: 浙江石墨烯制造业创新中心
title_en: Zhejiang graphene manufacturing innovation centre
summary_zh: 宁波材料所联合产业链企业及资本共建公司化创新中心，推进石墨烯研发、中试和应用孵化。
summary_en: CNITECH, value-chain firms and investors jointly established a corporate centre for graphene research, piloting and application incubation.
actors_zh: 宁波材料所、骨干企业、上下游企业、投资基金与产业资本。
actors_en: CNITECH, anchor firms, upstream/downstream firms, investment funds and industrial capital.
mechanism_zh: 共同出资运营研发与中试平台，将研究能力接入应用企业和产业资本。
mechanism_en: Joint investment operates research/pilot facilities connecting scientific capabilities to application firms and industrial capital.
observed_zh: 2021年官方验收报道记载公司化运营主体，以及对成果转化公司和应用孵化项目的现场考察。
observed_en: An official 2021 acceptance account documents the corporate operator and inspection of transfer companies and incubated applications.
constraints_zh: 通过验收说明建设阶段得到认可，不等于石墨烯产品已形成普遍市场需求。
constraints_en: Acceptance recognises a development stage, not general market demand for graphene products.
transfer_zh: 以应用企业试用、材料批次一致性和共同出资责任约束中心运行。
transfer_en: Govern the centre through application trials, batch consistency and co-investors' responsibilities.

title_zh: 中原关键金属实验室钼冶金成果转化
title_en: Zhongyuan critical-metals laboratory molybdenum transfer
summary_zh: 中原关键金属实验室以无氨氮钼冶金新技术成果转让，将科研攻关与三门峡金属材料产业连接。
summary_en: The laboratory connects research to Sanmenxia's materials industry through transfer of an ammonia-nitrogen-free molybdenum process.
actors_zh: 中原关键金属实验室、成果受让方及三门峡产业合作方。
actors_en: The laboratory, technology recipient and Sanmenxia industrial partners.
mechanism_zh: 围绕钼产业链技术需求开展研发，以成果转让衔接生产端应用。
mechanism_en: Research addresses molybdenum value-chain needs and uses technology transfer to connect with production.
observed_zh: 省科技厅2024年报道确认首个成果转让签约及其针对钼产业链的技术任务。
observed_en: The provincial 2024 account confirms the first transfer agreement and its molybdenum-industry focus.
constraints_zh: 签约不能代替环境绩效和生产成本验证，技术影响须在实际工况下评价。
constraints_en: An agreement is not validation of environmental performance or costs; impacts need operating-condition assessment.
transfer_zh: 将受让企业的工程验证与低污染工艺指标写入转化合同，保持实验室后续技术支持。
transfer_en: Include engineering and pollution-control tests in transfer contracts, retaining laboratory follow-up support.

title_zh: 广东腐蚀科学产业协同研究
title_en: Guangdong corrosion-science industrial collaboration
summary_zh: 面向核电、长输管道和海洋结构等工程，研究材料环境失效并提出寿命改善的控制参数。
summary_en: Research addresses environmentally assisted failure in nuclear, pipeline and marine structures and identifies parameters for longer service life.
actors_zh: 研究院腐蚀与评定团队及重大工程材料使用方。
actors_en: The institute's corrosion assessment team and users of engineering materials.
mechanism_zh: 把材料微观表征、环境和载荷分析连接到工程失效诊断及材料工艺改进。
mechanism_en: Microstructural characterisation, environmental analysis and loading are linked to failure diagnosis and process improvement.
observed_zh: 团队官方介绍明确列出核电、长输管道、海洋结构等研究对象及全流程失效因素分析。
observed_en: The official team profile identifies nuclear, pipeline and marine applications and analysis of failure factors across the production-to-service chain.
constraints_zh: 实验室试验需要与服役条件对应，寿命推断不能脱离环境、载荷和材料批次。
constraints_en: Laboratory tests must match service conditions; life predictions depend on environment, loading and material batch.
transfer_zh: 支持跨企业共享的材料可靠性评价能力，保留试验条件和适用边界而非只发布合格结论。
transfer_en: Support shared reliability assessment and preserve test conditions and applicability limits rather than only pass/fail labels.

title_zh: 兰州化物所兰州新区中试转化合作
title_en: LICP–Lanzhou New Area pilot-transfer partnership
summary_zh: 兰州化物所与兰州新区签署中试转化基地协议，将研究所技术能力与新区产业承载条件衔接。
summary_en: LICP and Lanzhou New Area agreed a pilot-transfer base linking research capabilities to local industrial capacity.
actors_zh: 兰州化物所、兰州新区及相关工程研究平台。
actors_en: LICP, Lanzhou New Area and associated engineering-research platforms.
mechanism_zh: 地方提供产业化承载条件，研究所依托实验室和工程中心推进技术转移及人才培养。
mechanism_en: Local industrial conditions connect with institute laboratories and engineering centres for transfer and training.
observed_zh: 2022年官方签约报道确认中试转化基地合作与成果转移、人才培养等任务。
observed_en: The official 2022 signing report confirms the pilot-transfer cooperation and tasks in transfer and training.
constraints_zh: 签约是组织安排，不代表基地已全面建成或形成产能。
constraints_en: Signing establishes an arrangement, not proof of completed facilities or production capacity.
transfer_zh: 将建设协议转成可验收的中试任务，明确设施开放、运营经费和环境安全要求。
transfer_en: Translate agreements into verifiable pilot tasks with access, operating-finance and environmental/safety requirements.

title_zh: 宁波材料所岱山新材料中试基地
title_en: CNITECH Daishan materials pilot base
summary_zh: 岱山县与宁波材料所共建化工新材料中试基地，连接研究、工程化、示范和产品商业化。
summary_en: Daishan county and CNITECH jointly develop a chemicals/materials pilot base linking research, engineering, demonstration and commercialisation.
actors_zh: 岱山县政府、中国科学院宁波材料所及技术转化团队。
actors_en: Daishan government, CAS CNITECH and technology-transfer teams.
mechanism_zh: 基地以化工新材料为中试对象，将工程化关键技术突破与属地产业应用衔接。
mechanism_en: Piloting focuses on new chemical materials and connects engineering breakthroughs to local industrial applications.
observed_zh: 2021年官方开工报道给出共建主体、中试对象和研究至商业化的转化路径。
observed_en: The 2021 official groundbreaking report identifies the partners, pilot focus and research-to-commercialisation pathway.
constraints_zh: 开工报道不证明后续投产率；中试设施需满足安全条件并有稳定项目来源。
constraints_en: Groundbreaking does not establish later utilisation; pilot facilities need safety conditions and sustained project demand.
transfer_zh: 先审查中试项目管线与工程安全条件，再安排公共设施投入和运营支持。
transfer_en: Review the pilot pipeline and engineering safety before committing public facilities and operating support.

title_zh: 中科新材概念验证中心
title_en: CNITECH new-materials proof-of-concept centre
summary_zh: 概念验证中心将新材料实验线、产业伙伴、专项资金及技术商业导师组合，用于验证早期成果的应用价值。
summary_en: A materials proof-of-concept centre combines experimental lines, industrial partners, dedicated funding and technical/business mentors.
actors_zh: 宁波材料所、浙江工研院发展有限公司、产业企业及技术与商业导师。
actors_en: CNITECH, Zhejiang Industrial Technology Institute Development Company, firms and technical/business mentors.
mechanism_zh: 以产业调研、可行性论证、知识产权布局和企业结对，把科学成果转成可检验的商业假设。
mechanism_en: Industry research, feasibility work, IP planning and firm matching turn research into testable commercial hypotheses.
observed_zh: 研究所刊载的2023年成立报道明确记载运营主体、专项资金与企业一对一结对安排。
observed_en: The institute's 2023 establishment account identifies the operator, dedicated funds and one-to-one matching with firms.
constraints_zh: 这是研究所刊载的媒体报道，资金安排和服务设置并不等于项目已实现商业成功。
constraints_en: This is a media account hosted by the institute; funding and services do not establish commercial success.
transfer_zh: 用小额分阶段验证确定客户、成本和工艺假设，失败项目允许退出而不强求设立企业。
transfer_en: Use small staged tests for customer, cost and process assumptions, allowing unsuccessful projects to exit without forcing company formation.

title_zh: 青海盐湖所甘河开放中试基地
title_en: Qinghai salt-lake institute Ganhe open pilot base
summary_zh: 甘河基地面向盐湖资源开发提供开放中试服务，将锂、硼、铷、铯等分离技术从实验开发推进至工艺放大。
summary_en: Ganhe offers open piloting for salt-lake resources, scaling separation technologies for lithium, boron, rubidium and caesium.
actors_zh: 青海盐湖所、中试技术团队及技术验证和工程应用用户。
actors_en: The salt-lake institute, pilot teams and technology-validation/engineering users.
mechanism_zh: 采用不同规格萃取装置及装备子平台，提供工艺开发、验证、孵化和工程应用服务。
mechanism_en: Extraction equipment at different scales supports process development, validation, incubation and engineering services.
observed_zh: 官网列出五个装备子平台、箱式萃取槽、离心萃取器及萃取塔，并明确对外开放。
observed_en: The official page lists five equipment sub-platforms, mixer-settlers, centrifugal extractors and extraction columns, with external access.
constraints_zh: 不同盐湖卤水差异较大，成功的单点试验不能直接外推到其他资源条件。
constraints_en: Brines vary substantially; successful tests at one site cannot be directly extrapolated to other resource conditions.
transfer_zh: 按资源成分和环境条件设计中试，以收率、能耗、杂质控制和工程稳定性形成交付。
transfer_en: Design pilots for resource composition and environment, delivering evidence on recovery, energy, impurity control and stability.

title_zh: 华南协同创新研究院
title_en: South China Institute of Collaborative Innovation
summary_zh: 东莞市与华南理工大学共建独立法人研究院，以地方产业需求连接高校技术资源与企业。
summary_en: Dongguan and South China University of Technology jointly established an institute connecting university capabilities with local industrial demand.
actors_zh: 东莞市政府、华南理工大学、科研团队及产业合作方。
actors_en: Dongguan government, SCUT, research teams and industrial partners.
mechanism_zh: 政府与高校共建载体，结合科学研究、技术开发、成果转化及仪器共享服务。
mechanism_en: A city–university platform combines research, technology development, transfer and shared instrumentation.
observed_zh: 官网记载2012年底挂牌，具备国家级科技企业孵化器和科研仪器设备共享管理等平台资质。
observed_en: The official profile records establishment in late 2012 and qualifications for incubation and shared research equipment.
constraints_zh: 校地共建能引入知识，但是否转化取决于企业技术吸收与持续合作。
constraints_en: University–city partnerships bring knowledge; translation still depends on firms' absorptive capacity and sustained cooperation.
