mechanism_en: Crop and livestock value chains organise research, extension and joint validation.
observed_zh: 官网列示农业研究、技术转移及区域合作安排。
observed_en: The official site identifies agricultural research, transfer and regional cooperation.
constraints_zh: 同一技术对小农户与大型企业的成本约束不同。
constraints_en: A technology faces different cost constraints among smallholders and large firms.
transfer_zh: 以区域试验和生产者反馈改进技术适配。
transfer_en: Use regional trials and producer feedback to improve adaptation.

title_zh: 乳业国家技术创新中心
title_en: National Dairy Technology Innovation Centre
summary_zh: 中心由自治区承担建设责任、企业研究院承建，联合产学研力量解决乳业全链条技术问题。
summary_en: The centre combines regional responsibility, a corporate research operator and research–industry collaboration across the dairy chain.
actors_zh: 内蒙古自治区、内蒙古乳业技术研究院、乳业企业及高校院所。
actors_en: Inner Mongolia, its dairy technology institute, dairy firms and universities/research institutes.
mechanism_zh: 以一网络、四中心、三平台组织研发，并通过知识产权服务连接创新与转化。
mechanism_en: A network, four centres and three platforms organise R&D, complemented by IP services for transfer.
observed_zh: 官方介绍确认2022年获批及呼和浩特总部布局，明确产学研共同建设。
observed_en: The official profile records approval in 2022, the Hohhot headquarters and joint industry–research construction.
constraints_zh: 龙头企业需求不能替代全行业竞争性技术遴选。
constraints_en: Anchor-firm demand should not replace competitive technology selection across the industry.
transfer_zh: 明确共性研究与企业专有成果的产权边界和使用条件。
transfer_en: Separate shared research from proprietary results through explicit ownership and access rules.

title_zh: 巴西农业研究公司开放研发合作
title_en: Embrapa open agricultural R&D collaboration
summary_zh: 公共农业研究机构以开放创新连接研究能力、共享基础设施和企业伙伴。
summary_en: A public agricultural research organisation connects research, shared infrastructure and firms through open innovation.
actors_zh: 巴西农业研究公司、公共科研机构及私人合作伙伴。
actors_en: Embrapa, public research organisations and private partners.
mechanism_zh: 联合研发及技术资产管理将研究任务与产业合作连接。
mechanism_en: Joint R&D and technology-asset management connect research tasks with industrial collaboration.
observed_zh: 官方研究页面明确开放创新、伙伴合作和技术资产安排。
observed_en: The official research page describes open innovation, partnerships and technology assets.
constraints_zh: 不能把各研究分支重复视为独立模式。
constraints_en: Research branches should not be counted repeatedly as independent models.
transfer_zh: 在合作前明确品种、数据和技术资产的使用权。
transfer_en: Specify rights to varieties, data and technology assets before collaboration.

title_zh: 新西兰费里尔研究所合同研发
title_en: New Zealand Ferrier Institute contract research
summary_zh: 大学研究所为外部客户提供化学研发，以合同安排衔接科学研究与产品开发。
summary_en: A university institute offers chemistry R&D through contracts connecting science and product development.
actors_zh: 费里尔研究所、客户企业及科研合作方。
actors_en: Ferrier Research Institute, client companies and research partners.
mechanism_zh: 保密协议、工作范围、预算及许可安排明确研发交付。
mechanism_en: NDAs, scopes of work, budgets and licensing clarify research deliverables.
observed_zh: 官方合作页面说明合同研究和知识产权合作流程。
observed_en: The official collaboration page describes contract research and IP arrangements.
constraints_zh: 合同研发仍面临技术不确定性和客户监管要求。
constraints_en: Contract R&D remains subject to technical uncertainty and client regulatory requirements.
transfer_zh: 预先约定背景知识产权、研发成果及后续使用权。
transfer_en: Agree background IP, research outputs and subsequent rights in advance.

title_zh: 尼日利亚联邦工业研究所工艺中试
title_en: FIIRO industrial process piloting
summary_zh: 联邦工业研究所通过食品等工业工艺开发和中试支持本地企业。
summary_en: FIIRO supports local firms through industrial process development and piloting, including food processing.
actors_zh: 联邦工业研究所、加工企业和创业者。
actors_en: FIIRO, processing firms and entrepreneurs.
mechanism_zh: 实验室研究、工艺放大及技术培训连接原料加工与产业应用。
mechanism_en: Laboratory research, scale-up and training connect feedstock processing with industrial use.
observed_zh: 官方介绍明确工业研发、技术适配与转移职责。
observed_en: The official profile specifies industrial R&D, adaptation and transfer responsibilities.
constraints_zh: 工艺转移仍取决于原料稳定性和质量控制。
constraints_en: Transfer depends on feedstock consistency and quality control.
transfer_zh: 在企业试用前检验加工质量、能耗及设备可维护性。
transfer_en: Check product quality, energy use and maintainability before industrial trials.

title_zh: 贵州大学与海利尔绿色农药联合研发
title_en: Guizhou University–Hailir green-pesticide joint R&D
summary_zh: 大学与农药企业签订合作协议，拟共建联合实验室并推进绿色农药定向转化。
summary_en: A university and pesticide firm agree to establish a joint laboratory and pursue targeted green-pesticide transfer.
actors_zh: 贵州大学、绿色农药全国重点实验室、海利尔药业集团。
actors_en: Guizhou University, its green-pesticide laboratory and Hailir Pesticides and Chemicals Group.
mechanism_zh: 总体协议后逐项落实研发任务，强调田间试验和安全评价。
mechanism_en: An overarching agreement is to be followed by individual R&D tasks, field trials and safety assessment.
observed_zh: 2026年9月13日校方报道确认前一日签署战略合作协议。
observed_en: A university account dated 13 September 2026 confirms the agreement signed the previous day.
constraints_zh: 签约不证明新农药已经登记或商业应用。
constraints_en: An agreement does not establish registration or commercial use of a new pesticide.
transfer_zh: 让研发、田间验证和登记责任在联合体内清晰分工。
transfer_en: Allocate research, field testing and registration responsibilities clearly within the consortium.

title_zh: 秘鲁农业创新技术开发与推广
title_en: Peru INIA technology development and extension
summary_zh: 技术开发部门组织农业技术验证、推广、技术援助及种子种苗服务。
summary_en: The development department organises agricultural validation, extension, technical assistance and seed/planting-material services.
actors_zh: 秘鲁国家农业创新研究所、研究推广网络和生产者。
actors_en: Peru’s INIA, research/extension networks and producers.
mechanism_zh: 研究成果通过验证、培训及生产资料服务进入农业应用。
mechanism_en: Research enters agriculture through validation, training and production-material services.
observed_zh: 官方部门介绍列出技术开发、转移与培训职责。
observed_en: The official division profile identifies development, transfer and training functions.
constraints_zh: 推广规模不能单独说明产量或收入提升。
constraints_en: Extension scale alone does not establish yield or income gains.
transfer_zh: 按当地品种、气候和经营规模安排验证试验。
transfer_en: Design trials around local varieties, climate and farm scale.

title_zh: 乌拉圭INIA联合研发与许可制度
title_en: Uruguay INIA joint R&D and licensing framework
summary_zh: 农业研究机构以技术许可、研发联盟和企业协议连接公共研究与产业。
summary_en: The agricultural institute links public research to industry through licensing, R&D alliances and enterprise agreements.
actors_zh: 乌拉圭国家农业研究所、研发伙伴及获许可企业。
actors_en: Uruguay’s INIA, research partners and licensees.
mechanism_zh: 知识产权与协议制度支持技术推广及企业共同开发。
mechanism_en: IP and agreement rules support diffusion and joint industrial development.
observed_zh: 2010年公开文件说明技术转移和企业合作制度。
observed_en: A public 2010 document explains transfer and industrial cooperation rules.
constraints_zh: 历史制度文本不代表2026年所有实施安排。
constraints_en: A historical framework does not establish all implementation arrangements in 2026.
transfer_zh: 区分公共推广职能与具有排他性的商业授权。
transfer_en: Distinguish public extension from exclusive commercial licensing.

title_zh: 阿根廷INTA技术转移与企业接口
title_en: Argentina INTA technology transfer and enterprise interface
summary_zh: 农业技术研究所通过技术组合、知识产权和企业合作推进成果应用。
summary_en: INTA supports uptake through a technology portfolio, IP management and industrial cooperation.
actors_zh: INTA、技术转移团队、企业和生产者。
actors_en: INTA, transfer teams, firms and producers.
mechanism_zh: 合作协议、许可和创业培育为不同技术提供承接渠道。
mechanism_en: Cooperation agreements, licensing and incubation provide differentiated transfer routes.
observed_zh: 官方技术合作页面列明技术组合与成果转移职能。
observed_en: The official linkage page identifies the technology portfolio and transfer functions.
constraints_zh: 许可签约不等于最终用户广泛采用。
constraints_en: A licence agreement does not establish broad end-user adoption.
transfer_zh: 连接研发协议、企业服务和生产者反馈。
transfer_en: Connect research agreements, enterprise services and producer feedback.

title_zh: 塞内加尔食品技术研究所中试
title_en: Senegal food technology institute piloting
summary_zh: 食品技术研究所通过实验室、加工中试和培训支持本地食品企业。
summary_en: ITA supports local food businesses through laboratories, processing pilots and training.
actors_zh: 塞内加尔食品技术研究所、食品加工企业及技术学员。
actors_en: Senegal’s ITA, food processors and technical trainees.
mechanism_zh: 谷物、水果、鱼类及乳品工艺与质量检测共同服务产品开发。
mechanism_en: Cereal, fruit, fish and dairy processing and quality tests jointly support product development.
observed_zh: 官网列明中试车间、培训及食品分析实验室。
observed_en: The official site lists pilot workshops, training and food-analysis laboratories.
constraints_zh: 实验室合格不等于持续满足出口市场要求。
constraints_en: Laboratory conformity does not establish sustained compliance in export markets.
transfer_zh: 把食品安全、保质期和工艺复现作为企业试用条件。
transfer_en: Require food safety, shelf life and process reproducibility in industrial trials.

title_zh: 新西兰林肯农业工程应用研究
title_en: New Zealand Lincoln Agritech applied research
summary_zh: 大学所有的独立研发机构把传感、农业工程、生物技术和材料研究对接产业问题。
summary_en: A university-owned independent R&D organisation connects sensing, agricultural engineering, biotechnology and materials with industry.
actors_zh: Lincoln Agritech、林肯大学、农业及材料企业。
actors_en: Lincoln Agritech, Lincoln University and agricultural/materials firms.
mechanism_zh: 跨学科研发和场景试验将科学能力转化为企业技术方案。
mechanism_en: Interdisciplinary research and contextual trials turn science into industrial solutions.
observed_zh: 官方介绍说明组织性质和农业、环境及材料方向。
observed_en: The official profile specifies its organisational form and agricultural, environmental and materials work.
constraints_zh: 田间结果受季节、土壤与经营条件影响。
constraints_en: Field results depend on seasons, soils and operating conditions.
transfer_zh: 用多场景测试验证技术的适用范围。
transfer_en: Use multi-setting trials to establish applicability.

title_zh: 蒙得维的亚巴斯德研究所LAB+创业培育
title_en: Institut Pasteur Montevideo LAB+ venture building
summary_zh: LAB+将科学项目、种子投资和运营支持组合，为生物科学创业提供承接载体。
summary_en: LAB+ combines scientific projects, seed investment and operational support for bioscience ventures.
actors_zh: 蒙得维的亚巴斯德研究所、LAB+、科研创业团队及投资伙伴。
actors_en: Institut Pasteur Montevideo, LAB+, scientific founders and investment partners.
mechanism_zh: 资金与实验基础设施、管理及法律支持共同推进科研创业。
mechanism_en: Funding, laboratory infrastructure, management and legal support jointly advance scientific ventures.
observed_zh: 2024年官方报道记录首轮支持四家科研初创企业。
observed_en: A 2024 official account records first-round support for four scientific start-ups.
constraints_zh: 获得种子投资不证明产品获批或企业盈利。
constraints_en: Seed investment does not establish approval or profitability.
transfer_zh: 把实验验证、知识产权和商业里程碑同时纳入投资安排。
transfer_en: Include validation, IP and commercial milestones in investment arrangements.

title_zh: 玻利维亚PROINPA农业技术服务
title_en: Bolivia PROINPA agricultural technology services
summary_zh: 农业研究基金会以实验室诊断、微生物质量控制及技术培训服务生产者和企业。
summary_en: PROINPA serves producers and firms through diagnostics, microbial quality control and training.
actors_zh: PROINPA、Agrolab、农业生产者及企业。
actors_en: PROINPA, Agrolab, agricultural producers and firms.
mechanism_zh: 病虫害诊断与有益微生物评价将研究能力转为可使用的技术服务。
mechanism_en: Pest diagnostics and beneficial-microbe assessment turn research capabilities into usable services.
observed_zh: 官网服务目录列明分子诊断、微生物与质量评价能力。
observed_en: The official catalogue identifies molecular diagnostics, microbiology and quality assessment.
constraints_zh: 实验室评价不能直接替代田间效果验证。
constraints_en: Laboratory assessment cannot replace field validation.
transfer_zh: 以田间条件和产品质量追踪连接诊断与应用。
transfer_en: Connect diagnostics to use through field conditions and product-quality tracking.

title_zh: 吉林农业大学菌物生物制造中试中心
title_en: Jilin Agricultural University fungal-biomanufacturing pilot centre
summary_zh: 中心面向菌物基材料、食药用菌加工和活性成分开发，补齐实验成果的中试验证环节。
summary_en: The centre pilots fungal materials, mushroom processing and active ingredients to bridge laboratory and industrial development.
actors_zh: 吉林农业大学、食药用菌教育部工程研究中心、三江实验室及产业合作方。
actors_en: Jilin Agricultural University, its mushroom engineering centre, Sanjiang Laboratory and industrial partners.
mechanism_zh: 依托高校工程研究中心与省实验室共同申报建设专业中试平台。
mechanism_en: A university engineering centre and provincial laboratory jointly establish a specialised pilot platform.
observed_zh: 2026年9月官方报道确认省级中试中心备案；规模化产品仍为发展方向。
observed_en: A September 2026 official account confirms provincial registration; scaled products remain a development direction.
constraints_zh: 备案不代表菌物新材料已形成稳定市场。
constraints_en: Registration does not establish a stable market for fungal materials.
transfer_zh: 在材料性能、加工成本和客户试用三方面设置验证门槛。
transfer_en: Set validation gates for material performance, processing cost and customer trials.

title_zh: 萨摩亚科研组织产品中试平台
title_en: Samoa SROS product-development piloting
summary_zh: 产品创新部门通过实验室和中试操作，把本地农产及自然资源研发转向增值产品。
summary_en: The division uses laboratories and piloting to develop value-added products from local agriculture and natural resources.
actors_zh: 萨摩亚科学研究组织、产品研发及中试团队、产业伙伴。
actors_en: SROS, product/pilot teams and industrial partners.
mechanism_zh: 研发、原型加工与企业协调形成从资源到产品的应用链。
mechanism_en: Research, prototyping and industry coordination connect resources to products.
observed_zh: 官方部门页面列明产品开发与中试职责。
observed_en: The official division page identifies product-development and pilot functions.
constraints_zh: 小批量试制不证明出口认证或稳定市场。
constraints_en: Small-batch pilots do not establish export certification or a sustained market.
transfer_zh: 以小规模原料供应、食品规范和运输成本设计工艺。
transfer_en: Design processes around small feedstock volumes, food rules and transport costs.

title_zh: 西藏牦牛育种政产学研合作群
title_en: Tibet yak-breeding research–industry collaboration
summary_zh: 高原生物研究团队围绕全基因组选择与体细胞克隆，联结地方育种基地、高校和畜牧服务机构。
summary_en: Plateau biologists connect genomic selection and cloning research with local breeding bases, universities and livestock services.
actors_zh: 西藏自治区高原生物所、合作科研团队、当雄等地方主体、西藏大学和畜牧总站。
actors_en: Tibet Plateau Biology Institute, research partners, Damxung/local actors, Tibet University and livestock services.
mechanism_zh: 以具体育种技术任务形成一加多合作群，连接研究、繁育与产业服务。
mechanism_en: A core-plus-partners arrangement links a defined breeding task to reproduction and industrial services.
observed_zh: 2025年官方记录提供克隆牦牛诞生时间线；种质库与转化生产线为后续规划。
observed_en: The 2025 official record provides a cloned-yak timeline; germplasm infrastructure and production lines are future plans.
constraints_zh: 单次克隆成功不证明群体增产、生态收益或成本可行。
constraints_en: A successful clone does not establish herd productivity, ecological benefit or economic viability.
transfer_zh: 持续核验繁育健康、遗传多样性与牧户使用成本。
transfer_en: Follow breeding health, genetic diversity and costs to pastoral users.

title_zh: 新疆民族药公共中试与质量平台
title_en: Xinjiang ethnic-medicine pilot and quality platform
summary_zh: 药物中试中心把公共检测、天然植物提取和口服制剂中试配置在同一平台，服务民族药企业。
summary_en: The centre combines public testing, plant extraction and oral-formulation pilots for ethnic-medicine firms.
actors_zh: 新疆理化技术研究所、药物中试技术中心、生物医药企业与中亚合作方。
actors_en: Xinjiang Technical Institute of Physics and Chemistry, its pilot centre, biopharma firms and Central Asian partners.
mechanism_zh: 以共性技术、质量分析和制剂放大连接科研与企业研发，并开展国际技术合作。
mechanism_en: Shared technologies, quality analysis and formulation scale-up link research to firms and international collaboration.
observed_zh: 官网列明三个组成平台及CMA检测资质，不将其拆成三个案例。
observed_en: The official page identifies three components and CMA testing qualification, counted as one platform.
constraints_zh: 检测资质和中试能力不能代替药品上市许可。
constraints_en: Testing qualification and pilot capacity do not replace medicine approval.
transfer_zh: 把质量标准、工艺可复现性和监管路径作为转化前置条件。
transfer_en: Make quality standards, repeatable processes and regulatory pathways prerequisites for transfer.

title_zh: 崖州湾南繁种业成果转化生态
title_en: Yazhou Bay Nanfan seed technology-transfer ecosystem
summary_zh: 科技城把种业企业、高校研究院与育种设施集聚，通过先投后股支持南繁成果转化。
summary_en: The science city co-locates seed firms, university institutes and breeding facilities, with grant-to-equity support for transfer.
actors_zh: 崖州湾科技城、中种集团、国投种业、科研院所与高校研究院。
actors_en: Yazhou Bay science city, China Seed, SDIC Seed, research institutes and university institutes.
mechanism_zh: 共享育种科研条件与专业化资金运作连接技术合同和企业落地。
mechanism_en: Shared breeding infrastructure and professionally managed finance connect technology contracts to industrial implementation.
observed_zh: 2025年官方报道列明企业与院所集聚及2024年试行的先投后股安排。
observed_en: A 2025 official account documents co-location and the grant-to-equity arrangement introduced in 2024.
constraints_zh: 生物安全、品种权与不同生态区试验制约品种推广。
constraints_en: Biosafety, variety rights and agroecological trials constrain diffusion.
transfer_zh: 将品种验证、知识产权和试验地条件一并纳入转化合同。
transfer_en: Include variety tests, IP and trial-location conditions in transfer contracts.

title_zh: 云南波顿香精香料协同研究院
title_en: Yunnan Boton flavour and fragrance collaborative institute
summary_zh: 昆明植物所、云南省科学技术院和波顿集团共同设立研究院，围绕天然香料资源开展产学研用合作。
summary_en: Kunming Institute of Botany, Yunnan Academy of Science and Boton jointly create an institute around natural fragrance resources.
actors_zh: 昆明植物研究所、云南省科学技术院、波顿集团。
actors_en: Kunming Institute of Botany, Yunnan Academy of Science and Boton Group.
mechanism_zh: 地方植物资源、科研能力与企业加工及市场接口由共建研究院衔接。
mechanism_en: A joint institute connects botanical resources and research with industrial processing and markets.
observed_zh: 2019年所年报记载2018年在昆明成立研究院；面向南亚东南亚是平台方向。
observed_en: The 2019 institute report records establishment in Kunming in 2018; South/Southeast Asian outreach is an intended direction.
constraints_zh: 历史成立记录不证明目前产量或跨境市场份额。
constraints_en: Historical establishment does not establish present output or cross-border market share.
transfer_zh: 围绕原料溯源、质量稳定性和企业试用组织联合研发。
transfer_en: Organise joint research around traceable feedstock, consistent quality and industrial trials.

title_zh: 国家数字化设计与制造创新中心
title_en: National digital design and manufacturing innovation centre
summary_zh: 高校和制造企业以公司、联盟及网络共同组织数字设计与制造技术研发。
summary_en: Universities and manufacturers organise digital design/manufacturing R&D through a company, alliance and network.
actors_zh: 华中科技大学、清华大学及相关高校、中国一汽等制造主体。
actors_en: HUST, Tsinghua and other universities, FAW and manufacturing partners.
mechanism_zh: 公司承担运营，联盟汇集需求和研发伙伴，网络支撑行业技术扩散。
mechanism_en: A company operates the platform, an alliance pools demand and partners, and a network supports diffusion.
observed_zh: 官方介绍记录2018年获批及联盟组织形式。
observed_en: The official profile records 2018 approval and the alliance structure.
constraints_zh: 研发平台成立不证明工业软件已被所有成员采用。
constraints_en: Platform formation does not establish industrial-software adoption by all members.
transfer_zh: 用兼容性测试与真实产线应用评价共性软件。
transfer_en: Evaluate shared software through interoperability tests and production-line use.

title_zh: 澳大利亚食品农业敏捷研发计划
title_en: Food Agility CRC agile research model
summary_zh: 食品农业研发计划通过敏捷研究将数字技术与企业生产场景结合。
summary_en: The programme uses agile research to connect digital technologies with food/agriculture operations.
actors_zh: Food Agility CRC、科研团队和农业食品企业。
actors_en: Food Agility CRC, research teams and food/agriculture firms.
mechanism_zh: 分阶段研究、设计思维和迭代试验让企业持续参与需求定义。
mechanism_en: Staged research, design thinking and iterative trials sustain industrial participation in defining needs.
observed_zh: 2020年官方说明发布研究敏捷性框架。
observed_en: A 2020 official account publishes the research-agility framework.
constraints_zh: 迭代框架本身不能证明收入增长或资源节约。
constraints_en: An iterative framework does not itself establish revenue growth or resource savings.
transfer_zh: 用短周期试验检验数据质量和经营决策价值。
transfer_en: Use short trials to test data quality and operational decision value.

title_zh: 科特迪瓦I2T农业无人机技术合作
title_en: Côte d’Ivoire I2T agricultural drone partnership
summary_zh: 技术研究机构与企业合作，推进农业无人机操作、喷洒和航空测绘培训。
summary_en: A technology institute partners with a company on agricultural drone operation, spraying and aerial-mapping training.
actors_zh: I2T、SCB SYSTEMS AFRICA及农业技术用户。
actors_en: I2T, SCB SYSTEMS AFRICA and agricultural technology users.
mechanism_zh: 研究机构与技术企业联合提供应用技能和场景适配支持。
mechanism_en: An institute and technology firm combine application skills with contextual adaptation.
observed_zh: 官网记录2026年7月22日合作协议及培训领域。
observed_en: The official site records the 22 July 2026 agreement and training fields.
constraints_zh: 协议不证明农户采用规模或作物增产。
constraints_en: The agreement does not establish farmer adoption or yield gains.
transfer_zh: 以操作安全、农药规范和小农户成本核验应用条件。
transfer_en: Assess operating safety, pesticide rules and smallholder costs.

title_zh: 闽都创新实验室企业联合研发
title_en: Mindu Innovation Laboratory industry-led joint R&D
summary_zh: 闽都实验室以企业出题、实验室答题连接光电子芯片和光学材料研发。
summary_en: Mindu uses company-defined problems to organise optoelectronic-chip and optical-materials research.
actors_zh: 闽都创新实验室、福建中科光芯及联合研发企业。
actors_en: Mindu Innovation Laboratory, Fujian Zhongke Optical Chip and joint-research firms.
mechanism_zh: 企业联合中心将研究任务与产品需求、工艺验证相衔接。
mechanism_en: Joint centres connect research tasks with product requirements and process validation.
observed_zh: 官方报道举出光电子芯片量产与透明荧光陶瓷成果。
observed_en: The official account describes chip manufacturing and transparent fluorescent-ceramic results.
constraints_zh: 具名成果不能外推为全部联合项目的成功率。
constraints_en: Named results do not establish success rates across all joint projects.
transfer_zh: 以具体器件指标和客户验证来组织联合研发。
transfer_en: Organise collaboration around device specifications and customer validation.

title_zh: 澳大利亚智能卫星合作研究中心
title_en: Australia SmartSat CRC
summary_zh: 卫星研究联盟联结大学、科研机构与企业，研究通信、物联网和地球观测服务。
summary_en: A satellite consortium connects universities, institutes and firms in communications, IoT and Earth-observation services.
actors_zh: SmartSat CRC、大学、研究机构和航天技术企业。
actors_en: SmartSat CRC, universities, institutes and space-technology firms.
mechanism_zh: 公共支持与联合研发组织专业技术、知识产权和产业能力。
mechanism_en: Public support and collaborative R&D combine specialist technologies, IP and industrial capabilities.
observed_zh: 官网列明联盟性质及研究方向。
observed_en: The official site identifies the consortium and research areas.
constraints_zh: 联盟研究能力不等于全部技术已通过在轨验证。
constraints_en: Research capability does not establish in-orbit validation for every technology.
transfer_zh: 区分实验室、地面系统与在轨验证里程碑。
transfer_en: Distinguish laboratory, ground-system and in-orbit milestones.

title_zh: 嵩山实验室产业研究院
title_en: Songshan Laboratory industrial research institute
summary_zh: 信息领域科研力量通过产业研究院公司组织联合研发与成果转化。
summary_en: Information-technology research partners use an industrial-institute company for joint R&D and transfer.
actors_zh: 嵩山实验室产业研究院、信息工程大学、郑州大学、中国电科第二十七研究所。
actors_en: Songshan industrial institute, Information Engineering University, Zhengzhou University and CETC 27th Institute.
mechanism_zh: 大学和专业研究机构共建公司，知识产权管理支撑产业合作。
mechanism_en: Universities and a specialist institute jointly establish a company supported by IP management.
observed_zh: 政府知识产权工作记录确认研究院及其共建单位。
observed_en: A government IP-work record identifies the institute and its founding partners.
constraints_zh: 机构设立与知识产权服务不等于产品收入。
constraints_en: Institutional establishment and IP services are not product revenue.
transfer_zh: 把科研任务、知识产权归属与企业使用条件同时明确。
transfer_en: Specify research tasks, IP ownership and industrial access together.

title_zh: 湘江实验室与湖南能源集团联合研发
title_en: Xiangjiang Laboratory–Hunan Energy joint R&D
summary_zh: 能源集团与实验室签订合作框架，将算力和人工智能研究对接电力、天然气场景。
summary_en: An energy group and laboratory agree to connect computing/AI research with power and natural-gas applications.
actors_zh: 湖南能源集团、湘江实验室、湖南工商大学。
actors_en: Hunan Energy Group, Xiangjiang Laboratory and Hunan University of Technology and Business.
mechanism_zh: 以企业数据和应用场景支撑联合研究、成果转化及示范安排。
mechanism_en: Corporate data and applications support planned joint research, transfer and demonstrations.
observed_zh: 2024年官方报道确认战略协议签署及合作领域。
observed_en: A 2024 official account confirms the agreement and its fields of cooperation.
constraints_zh: 框架协议不能证明算法已投入生产。
constraints_en: A framework agreement does not establish production deployment.
transfer_zh: 先明确数据授权、基线和现场验证责任。
transfer_en: Define data permissions, baselines and field-validation responsibilities first.

title_zh: 厄瓜多尔ESPOL创新创业实验室
title_en: Ecuador ESPOL i3lab innovation and entrepreneurship
summary_zh: 大学创新中心把技术转移、创业支持与企业创新服务结合。
summary_en: A university innovation centre combines transfer, entrepreneurship support and corporate innovation.
actors_zh: ESPOL、研究团队、创业者及企业。
actors_en: ESPOL, researchers, entrepreneurs and firms.
mechanism_zh: 培训、咨询和创新项目支持科研知识进入创业与企业应用。
mechanism_en: Training, advice and innovation projects support research-based ventures and industrial applications.
observed_zh: 官方介绍列明技术转移和创业服务。
observed_en: The official profile identifies transfer and entrepreneurship services.
constraints_zh: 参与培训不等于创办了可持续经营企业。
constraints_en: Training participation does not establish a sustainable business.
transfer_zh: 用客户试用和技术验证筛选后续创业支持。
transfer_en: Use customer trials and technical validation to select further venture support.

title_zh: 智利基金会技术示范与产业培育
title_en: Fundación Chile technology demonstration and industry development
summary_zh: 基金会通过引进和适配技术、示范企业及伙伴平台培育新产业。
summary_en: The foundation develops industries through technology adaptation, demonstration businesses and partner platforms.
actors_zh: 智利基金会、技术伙伴、企业及公共机构。
actors_en: Fundación Chile, technology partners, companies and public institutions.
mechanism_zh: 从示范企业到战略联盟，将技术机会与本地创业和产业能力结合。
mechanism_en: Demonstration businesses and strategic alliances connect technology opportunities with local entrepreneurial capacity.
observed_zh: 官方历史介绍呈现企业示范向联盟和平台合作演进。
observed_en: The official history describes an evolution from demonstration firms to alliances and platforms.
constraints_zh: 历史成功经验受行业和市场条件限制。
constraints_en: Historical experience is conditional on sector and market context.
transfer_zh: 先验证需求与本地配套，再选择投资或联盟路径。
transfer_en: Validate demand and local complements before choosing investment or alliance routes.

title_zh: 尼日利亚科研成果商业化计划
title_en: NASENI research commercialisation programme
summary_zh: 计划征集已有科研成果，为商业化研发和技术应用提供项目遴选渠道。
summary_en: The programme solicits research results for selection into commercialisation and technology-application support.
actors_zh: 尼日利亚国家科学与工程基础设施署、研究人员及项目合作方。
actors_en: NASENI, researchers and project partners.
mechanism_zh: 以申请、知识产权声明和评审衔接研究成果与商业化支持。
mechanism_en: Applications, IP declarations and review connect research results with commercialisation support.
observed_zh: 官方门户公开申请规则与成果原创性要求。
observed_en: The official portal publishes application rules and originality requirements.
constraints_zh: 开放申请不代表项目已经获得资助或投产。
constraints_en: An open application does not establish funding awards or production.
transfer_zh: 将技术验证与企业承接方案作为评审的独立内容。
transfer_en: Review validation evidence and the industrial uptake plan separately.

title_zh: 澳大利亚矿区转型合作研究中心
title_en: Australia CRC for Transformations in Mining Economies
summary_zh: 中心联合矿业、科研、政府和社区，研究矿山关闭及矿区经济转型。
summary_en: The centre joins mining, research, government and communities on mine closure and regional transition.
actors_zh: CRC TiME、矿业企业、高校、原住民及地方社区。
actors_en: CRC TiME, mining firms, universities, Indigenous and local communities.
mechanism_zh: 共同研究技术、生态与经济问题，使关闭方案与当地发展衔接。
mechanism_en: Joint technical, ecological and economic research links closure plans with local development.
observed_zh: 官网确认2020年启动及跨部门研究伙伴安排。
observed_en: The official site records a 2020 launch and cross-sector research partnerships.
constraints_zh: 研究联盟不能代替具体矿区的责任和修复资金。
constraints_en: A research alliance cannot replace site-level liabilities and restoration finance.
transfer_zh: 让社区与矿山责任主体共同定义可验证的转型目标。
transfer_en: Have communities and mine operators jointly define verifiable transition objectives.

title_zh: 新西兰电力工程产学研中心
title_en: New Zealand Electric Power Engineering Centre
summary_zh: 电力工程中心将行业合作、研究与专业人才培养配置在大学平台。
summary_en: The centre combines industry cooperation, research and professional education in a university platform.
actors_zh: 坎特伯雷大学、电力行业及电力工程教育信托。
actors_en: University of Canterbury, the power industry and the Power Engineering Excellence Trust.
mechanism_zh: 大学与行业共同支持研究、合同服务及工程教育。
mechanism_en: University and industry jointly support research, contract services and engineering education.
observed_zh: 官方介绍记录2002年建立的大学与行业共同倡议。
observed_en: The official profile records the joint university–industry initiative established in 2002.
constraints_zh: 人才培养效果与具体技术商业化应分别评价。
constraints_en: Education outcomes and technology commercialisation should be assessed separately.
transfer_zh: 把行业研究任务与工程师培养连续衔接。
transfer_en: Maintain links between industrial research tasks and engineer development.

title_zh: 澳大利亚未来能源出口合作研究中心
title_en: Australia Future Energy Exports CRC
summary_zh: 合作研究中心联合大学与能源企业，研究液化天然气效率、氢能和出口链数字化。
summary_en: The CRC joins universities and energy firms on LNG efficiency, hydrogen and export-chain digitalisation.
actors_zh: FEnEx CRC、大学、能源企业及技术供应商。
actors_en: FEnEx CRC, universities, energy firms and technology suppliers.
mechanism_zh: 产业与科研伙伴共同组织面向能源出口链的长期研发。
mechanism_en: Industrial and research partners organise sustained R&D for the energy export chain.
observed_zh: 官方介绍列明研究计划、合作组织和技术方向。
observed_en: The official profile identifies research programmes, partnerships and technical areas.
constraints_zh: 出口技术研究不证明低排放产品已有稳定市场。
constraints_en: Export research does not establish a sustained market for low-emissions products.
transfer_zh: 将出口客户要求、技术验证和基础设施约束共同纳入研发。
transfer_en: Include customer requirements, validation and infrastructure constraints in R&D.

title_zh: 哈尔滨聚变与超导产业技术创新联盟
title_en: Harbin fusion and superconductivity innovation alliance
summary_zh: 高校、科研院所和装备企业围绕聚变及超导组织跨地区产业技术联盟。
summary_en: Universities, institutes and equipment firms form a cross-regional alliance in fusion and superconductivity.
actors_zh: 哈尔滨工业大学、哈尔滨工程大学、哈电集团、相关核科学研究机构及超导企业。
actors_en: Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin Engineering University, Harbin Electric, nuclear institutes and superconductivity firms.
mechanism_zh: 联盟拟通过联合攻关、平台共享与标准协作连接科学研究和装备工程。
mechanism_en: The alliance plans joint research, shared platforms and standards collaboration linking science to equipment engineering.
observed_zh: 2026年8月官方信息确认联盟成立及具名成员。
observed_en: An August 2026 official account confirms formation and named members.
constraints_zh: 成立联盟不代表聚变发电已商业可用。
constraints_en: Alliance formation does not establish commercial fusion generation.
transfer_zh: 围绕关键部件测试和供应链质量形成分阶段联合任务。
transfer_en: Stage joint tasks around component testing and supply-chain quality.

title_zh: 纳米比亚绿色氢能研究院
title_en: Namibia Green Hydrogen Research Institute
summary_zh: 大学研究院以绿色氢能应用研究、人才培养及项目合作支撑新产业建设。
summary_en: A university institute supports green hydrogen through applied research, training and project partnerships.
actors_zh: 纳米比亚大学、氢能企业、国际高校及项目开发方。
actors_en: University of Namibia, hydrogen firms, international universities and developers.
mechanism_zh: 以大学、企业及政府合作连接人才、研究与示范项目。
mechanism_en: University–industry–government collaboration links skills, research and demonstration projects.
observed_zh: 官网列举Daures和Walvis Bay等合作及2024年加氢设施进展。
observed_en: The official page identifies Daures/Walvis Bay partnerships and a 2024 refuelling-facility milestone.
constraints_zh: 示范设施不能证明全产业链已达到商业盈利。
constraints_en: Demonstrations do not establish profitability across the value chain.
transfer_zh: 同步验证技术、当地技能形成和长期购买需求。
transfer_en: Assess technology, local skill formation and sustained offtake together.

title_zh: 青岛能源所多路径技术转移
title_en: QIBEBT multi-path technology transfer
summary_zh: 研究所通过联合项目、共建平台、许可及成果转让连接能源生物研究与企业。
summary_en: The institute links bioenergy research to firms through joint projects, platforms, licensing and technology assignment.
actors_zh: 青岛能源所、国家能源集团、中石化、中石油、山东能源及生物产业企业。
actors_en: QIBEBT, CHN Energy, Sinopec, CNPC, Shandong Energy and bioindustry firms.
mechanism_zh: 按技术和合作对象选择许可、转让或条件性股权转化，不用单一路径承接所有成果。
mechanism_en: Licensing, assignment or conditional equity arrangements are chosen for the technology and partner.
observed_zh: 官方转化概况明确合作与知识产权路径，并列举企业伙伴。
observed_en: The official transfer profile identifies cooperation/IP routes and industrial partners.
constraints_zh: 合作机制不能替代具体项目的商业验证。
constraints_en: Cooperation mechanisms do not replace commercial validation.
transfer_zh: 在签约前明确成熟度、转化责任及后续改进权。
transfer_en: Specify readiness, transfer responsibilities and improvement rights before contracting.

title_zh: 四川低碳交通研究中心
title_en: Sichuan low-carbon transport research centre
summary_zh: 交通科研机构联合工程、港口、车辆企业和高校，建设分布式低碳交通研究平台。
summary_en: A transport institute joins engineering, port and vehicle firms and a university in distributed low-carbon transport R&D.
actors_zh: 四川省交科院、蜀道集团、港投集团、设计院、比亚迪、长沙理工大学。
actors_en: Sichuan transport institute, Shudao, port operators, design institutes, BYD and Changsha University of Science and Technology.
mechanism_zh: 以一加六加多的合作网络覆盖交通建设和运营中的工程问题。
mechanism_en: A core-and-partners network addresses engineering problems in transport construction and operation.
observed_zh: 官方报道确认中心挂牌入驻天府永兴实验室。
observed_en: The official account confirms its launch within Tianfu Yongxing Laboratory.
constraints_zh: 既有交通工程不能全部归因于新中心。
constraints_en: Existing transport projects cannot all be attributed to the new centre.
transfer_zh: 由交通业主提供可测量的运营场景和减排边界。
transfer_en: Have asset operators define measurable operating scenarios and emissions boundaries.

title_zh: 天津大学精馏技术工程转化
title_en: Tianjin University distillation engineering transfer
summary_zh: 精馏工程中心连接过程研究、塔器装备及化工企业的工艺放大需求。
summary_en: The distillation centre connects process research, column equipment and industrial scale-up.
actors_zh: 天津大学精馏技术国家工程研究中心、北洋工程公司及石化企业。
actors_en: Tianjin University distillation centre, Beiyang engineering company and petrochemical firms.
mechanism_zh: 联合平台、工程设计和设备制造把分离技术送入工业过程。
mechanism_en: Joint platforms, engineering design and equipment manufacture bring separation technologies into industrial processes.
observed_zh: 大学介绍列明工艺控制、诊断、模拟和产业合作能力。
observed_en: The university profile documents control, diagnosis, simulation and industry collaboration capabilities.
constraints_zh: 单一工况性能不能直接外推至不同原料及装置。
constraints_en: Performance under one operating condition cannot be generalised to other feedstocks or plants.
transfer_zh: 以实际物料试验和运行能耗验证放大效果。
transfer_en: Validate scale-up using actual feedstocks and operating energy demand.

title_zh: 太原理工矿业学科产学研联盟
title_en: Taiyuan mining research–industry alliances
summary_zh: 矿业学科围绕绿色安全开采、煤层气和智能采矿，与能源和装备企业建立产学研联盟。
summary_en: Mining researchers organise industry alliances around safe extraction, coalbed methane and intelligent mining.
actors_zh: 太原理工大学、国家能源集团、晋能控股、太重集团、山西焦煤。
actors_en: Taiyuan University, CHN Energy, Jinneng, Taiyuan Heavy Industry and Shanxi Coking Coal.
mechanism_zh: 企业横向研发与开放实验平台连接采矿研究、装备开发和现场问题。
mechanism_en: Industrial research contracts and open laboratories connect mining research, equipment development and field problems.
observed_zh: 学院简介列出具名企业联盟和向行业开放实验平台的安排。
observed_en: The school profile names industrial alliances and laboratory access for industry.
constraints_zh: 矿业安全与生产连续性限制现场试验，合作数量不等于减排效果。
constraints_en: Safety and production continuity constrain trials; partnership counts are not emissions reductions.
transfer_zh: 让矿山业主参与测试方案，分别验证安全、效率和环境指标。
transfer_en: Involve mine operators in trials and verify safety, efficiency and environmental measures separately.

title_zh: 阿根廷Y-TEC能源联合研发公司
title_en: Argentina Y-TEC joint energy research company
summary_zh: 能源企业与公共研究机构共同设立研发公司，将能源科学与企业工程问题结合。
summary_en: An energy company and public research council establish a joint R&D company linking energy science to industrial engineering.
actors_zh: YPF、阿根廷国家科学与技术研究委员会、Y-TEC研究团队。
actors_en: YPF, CONICET and Y-TEC researchers.
mechanism_zh: 企业与科研机构共同持有研发载体，配置实验室、人才和行业合作。
mechanism_en: Corporate and research partners co-own an R&D operator combining laboratories, skills and industry collaboration.
observed_zh: CONICET介绍记录YPF与CONICET的共同设立及研发服务。
observed_en: CONICET’s profile documents joint establishment and R&D services.
constraints_zh: 设立时股权结构不等于已核验当前全部治理安排。
constraints_en: Founding ownership does not establish every present governance arrangement.
transfer_zh: 明确长期共性研究与股东专有工程任务的资源边界。
transfer_en: Separate long-term shared research from shareholder-specific engineering tasks.

title_zh: 澳大利亚先进制造联合投资项目
title_en: Australia AMGC manufacturing co-investment
summary_zh: 项目机制通过产业联合投资和科研合作支持制造技术商业化。
summary_en: The programme supports manufacturing commercialisation through industrial co-investment and research collaboration.
actors_zh: 先进制造增长中心、制造企业及科研伙伴。
actors_en: AMGC, manufacturers and research partners.
mechanism_zh: 企业共同投入并结合研究能力，推进产品与生产工艺开发。
mechanism_en: Industrial co-investment combines with research capability for product and process development.
observed_zh: 官方项目目录列明受支持项目及伙伴。
observed_en: The official portfolio identifies supported projects and partners.
constraints_zh: 预测就业和收入不等于已经实现的成效。
constraints_en: Forecast employment and revenue are not realised outcomes.
transfer_zh: 共同投资应与技术验收和客户应用节点对应。
transfer_en: Link co-investment to technical acceptance and customer applications.

title_zh: 北航江西研究院航空与数字技术转化
title_en: Beihang Jiangxi aviation and digital technology transfer
summary_zh: 研究院依托北航，围绕江西航空和电子信息产业配置研发及成果转化能力。
summary_en: The institute draws on Beihang to support R&D and transfer for Jiangxi aviation and electronics industries.
actors_zh: 北航江西研究院、北京航空航天大学和当地航空电子产业主体。
actors_en: Beihang Jiangxi institute, Beihang University and local aviation/electronics organisations.
mechanism_zh: 将航空发动机、智能制造、人工智能与工业物联网、培训配置为四块业务。
mechanism_en: Four business areas connect aero-engines, intelligent manufacturing, AI/industrial IoT and training.
observed_zh: 2023年科技局报道明确四类业务和新型研发机构身份。
observed_en: A 2023 science-authority account identifies the four areas and new R&D-institution status.
constraints_zh: 研究布局不自动形成企业订单与型号应用。
constraints_en: Research domains do not by themselves establish orders or deployment.
transfer_zh: 围绕地方制造环节制定工程交付清单，避免仅迁移高校课题。
transfer_en: Define engineering deliverables around local production, rather than relocating academic topics.

title_zh: 加纳工业研究所工程服务
title_en: Ghana CSIR industrial research services
summary_zh: 工业研究所依托仪器、加工及工程设施向企业提供应用研究和技术服务。
summary_en: The institute uses instrumentation, machining and engineering facilities for applied research and industrial services.
actors_zh: 加纳科学与工业研究理事会工业研究所及企业。
actors_en: Ghana CSIR’s Institute of Industrial Research and firms.
mechanism_zh: 共享工程能力使企业可获取专业研发、加工及测试支持。
mechanism_en: Shared engineering capacity gives firms access to specialist R&D, fabrication and testing.
observed_zh: 官网展示研究方向及铸造、数控等工程服务设施。
observed_en: The official site presents research areas and foundry/CNC engineering facilities.
constraints_zh: 设备清单不能证明企业实际使用频率。
constraints_en: An equipment list does not establish industrial utilisation.
transfer_zh: 以企业问题、交付质量和维护能力组织服务。
transfer_en: Organise services around industrial problems, deliverable quality and maintenance capacity.

title_zh: 国家数字建造技术创新中心
title_en: National digital construction technology innovation centre
summary_zh: 中心围绕数字建造组织物联网、机器人、城市信息模型和工程应用平台。
summary_en: The centre organises IoT, robotics, city information modelling and engineering applications for digital construction.
actors_zh: 华中科技大学、建筑工程企业及合作科研金融机构。
actors_en: HUST, construction companies and research/finance partners.
mechanism_zh: 一加多平台把共性技术研究与建筑、桥梁和轨道工程场景连接。
mechanism_en: A core-and-platforms structure links shared research to buildings, bridges and rail engineering.
observed_zh: 官方介绍确认2022年获批及技术平台、工程应用布局。
observed_en: The official profile records 2022 approval and the technical/application platform structure.
constraints_zh: 工程场景差异限制直接复制同一技术方案。
constraints_en: Different engineering settings limit direct replication.
transfer_zh: 按设计、施工和运维环节分别验证数字技术价值。
transfer_en: Verify digital technologies separately in design, construction and operation.

title_zh: 巴西圣保罗技术研究院共享工程服务
title_en: Brazil IPT shared engineering services
summary_zh: 技术研究院向企业提供研发、测试、技术评价与多用户工程设施。
summary_en: IPT offers firms R&D, testing, technical assessment and multi-user engineering facilities.
actors_zh: 圣保罗技术研究院、制造企业及公共技术用户。
actors_en: IPT, manufacturers and public-sector technology users.
mechanism_zh: 多学科实验与工程服务把复杂产业问题转为可测试方案。
mechanism_en: Multidisciplinary laboratory and engineering services turn industrial problems into testable solutions.
observed_zh: 官方技术服务目录明确研发、测试和共享设备能力。
observed_en: The official service catalogue identifies R&D, testing and shared equipment.
constraints_zh: 测试服务与技术创造应分别识别。
constraints_en: Testing services should be distinguished from technology creation.
transfer_zh: 按客户问题组合研发、试验及独立评价。
transfer_en: Combine R&D, experiments and independent assessment around customer problems.

title_zh: 安徽医科大学医用机器人产教合作
title_en: Anhui medical-robotics education–industry partnership
summary_zh: 临床大学、协同创新中心与机器人企业共同建立产业学院及医学智能设备公司。
summary_en: A medical university, innovation centre and robotics firm establish an industry school and medical-device company.
actors_zh: 安徽医科大学、江淮前沿技术协同创新中心、北京天智航。
actors_en: Anhui Medical University, Jianghuai collaborative innovation centre and Beijing Tinavi.
mechanism_zh: 把临床需求、工程研发、人才培养与企业承接配置在同一合作框架。
mechanism_en: The partnership connects clinical demand, engineering, training and a commercial operator.
observed_zh: 官方成果转化栏目记录2026年3月15日揭牌。
observed_en: The official transfer listing records the launch on 15 March 2026.
constraints_zh: 公司成立不代表器械获准上市。
constraints_en: Company formation does not establish device approval.
transfer_zh: 让临床验证和注册要求共同约束研发任务。
transfer_en: Use clinical validation and registration requirements to define R&D tasks.

title_zh: 肯尼亚工业研究与发展研究所
title_en: Kenya Industrial Research and Development Institute
summary_zh: 工业研究所向企业提供食品、纺织、皮革、陶瓷及能源等领域的应用研发与共用设施。
summary_en: KIRDI offers applied research and shared facilities in food, textiles, leather, ceramics and energy.
actors_zh: KIRDI、制造企业和中小企业。
actors_en: KIRDI, manufacturers and SMEs.
mechanism_zh: 研发、测试及共享生产设施支持企业改进工艺和产品。
mechanism_en: Research, testing and common manufacturing facilities support process and product improvements.
observed_zh: 官网列示技术服务及共用制造设施。
observed_en: The official site lists technical services and common manufacturing facilities.
constraints_zh: 设施可用不代表所有企业都有能力持续使用。
constraints_en: Facility availability does not establish firms’ sustained capacity to use it.
transfer_zh: 把操作培训、质量测试和企业后续维护一并纳入服务。
transfer_en: Combine operator training, quality tests and ongoing maintenance support.

title_zh: 卢旺达工业研发署企业技术升级计划
title_en: NIRDA industrial technology-upgrading programme
summary_zh: 公开征集计划向不同价值链企业提供设备升级和配套技术支持。
summary_en: An open-call programme supplies equipment upgrades and complementary technical support to firms across value chains.
actors_zh: 卢旺达工业研发署、入选企业和技术服务伙伴。
actors_en: NIRDA, selected firms and technical-service partners.
mechanism_zh: 公开遴选后将技术获取、企业能力和商业辅导结合。
mechanism_en: Selection links technology acquisition with firm capabilities and business support.
observed_zh: 2023年官方报道记录八类价值链企业获得升级设备。
observed_en: A 2023 official account records upgraded equipment for firms in eight value chains.
constraints_zh: 设备交付不等于生产率已持续提高。
constraints_en: Equipment delivery is not sustained productivity improvement.
transfer_zh: 以设备使用率、操作能力和产品质量核验升级成效。
transfer_en: Verify upgrading through utilisation, operator competence and product quality.

title_zh: 巴布亚新几内亚适用技术研究与推广
title_en: Papua New Guinea appropriate-technology development and extension
summary_zh: 大学适用技术机构围绕能源、水卫生、小工业和食品加工提供研发及技术服务。
summary_en: A university appropriate-technology institute provides R&D and services in energy, water/sanitation, small industry and food processing.
actors_zh: 巴布亚新几内亚科技大学ATCDI、项目委托方及社区产业用户。
actors_en: PNGUoT’s ATCDI, project clients and community/industrial users.
mechanism_zh: 利益相关方提出需求，大学工程团队以研究、培训和技术咨询回应。
mechanism_en: Stakeholders propose needs and university engineers respond through research, training and technical advice.
observed_zh: 大学2022年研究报告记录该机构职责和项目工作。
observed_en: The university’s 2022 research report documents its mandate and project work.
constraints_zh: 历史年度记录不证明所有项目目前仍在运行。
constraints_en: A historical annual record does not establish ongoing operation of every project.
transfer_zh: 在设计中优先考虑维修技能、备件和社区运行条件。
transfer_en: Prioritise repair skills, spare parts and community operating conditions.

title_zh: 尼日利亚产品开发研究所工程转化
title_en: PRODA industrial engineering and product development
summary_zh: 研究所围绕农业加工、陶瓷、化工及能源需求开展产品和工程研发。
summary_en: PRODA develops products and engineering solutions for agro-processing, ceramics, chemicals and energy.
actors_zh: 产品开发研究所、工业合作伙伴及技术用户。
actors_en: PRODA, industrial partners and technology users.
mechanism_zh: 需求导向研究与原型工程把实验室成果推进至可制造方案。
mechanism_en: Demand-led research and prototype engineering move laboratory results towards manufacturable designs.
observed_zh: 官网列明研究方向及产业合作职能。
observed_en: The official site identifies research areas and industry collaboration functions.
constraints_zh: 原型开发不等于具备成本竞争力的规模制造。
constraints_en: Prototypes do not establish cost-competitive manufacturing at scale.
transfer_zh: 以本地零部件供应与维护条件约束工程设计。
transfer_en: Design around local component supply and maintenance conditions.

title_zh: 秦皇岛康复器具产学研合作
title_en: Qinhuangdao rehabilitation-device collaboration
summary_zh: 工程团队、医院和康养企业联合申报智能康复器具与诊疗装备任务。
summary_en: Engineering teams, hospitals and a care company jointly pursue intelligent rehabilitation and diagnostic devices.
actors_zh: 燕山大学、康复辅具研究机构秦皇岛研究院、当地医院和中秦兴龙康养。
actors_en: Yanshan University, a Qinhuangdao rehabilitation institute, local hospitals and Zhongqin Xinglong care company.
mechanism_zh: 临床问题、工程研发与应用主体通过揭榜项目对接。
mechanism_en: Challenge-based projects connect clinical problems, engineering and application partners.
observed_zh: 校方信息确认相关团队项目入围，未将入围视作获批产品。
observed_en: The university records project shortlisting, not product approval.
constraints_zh: 入围项目不能证明器械安全性与临床效果。
constraints_en: Shortlisting does not establish device safety or clinical efficacy.
transfer_zh: 让医院参与需求定义及后续试验设计。
transfer_en: Include hospitals in requirements and subsequent trial design.

title_zh: 坦桑尼亚工业研发组织技术转移与中试
title_en: TIRDO technology transfer and pilot plants
summary_zh: 技术转移部门管理研发成果、商业潜力评估和中试设施。
summary_en: The technology-transfer division manages research outputs, commercial-potential assessment and pilot facilities.
actors_zh: 坦桑尼亚工业研发组织、研发人员和产业用户。
actors_en: TIRDO, researchers and industrial users.
mechanism_zh: 技术盘点、知识产权与许可工作将研究成果接入工程验证和市场。
mechanism_en: Technology inventories, IP and licensing connect research to engineering validation and markets.
observed_zh: 官方部门页面明确技术转移及中试职责。
observed_en: The official division page specifies transfer and pilot-plant responsibilities.
constraints_zh: 职责说明没有提供项目级商业成功率。
constraints_en: The mandate does not provide project-level commercial success rates.
transfer_zh: 围绕可交付工艺和企业吸收能力选择中试项目。
transfer_en: Select pilots around deliverable processes and firms’ absorptive capacity.

title_zh: 太原理工先进成形与智能装备中试基地
title_en: Taiyuan University forming and intelligent-equipment pilot base
summary_zh: 基地连接先进成形研究、装备研发和中试转化，并与山西机电研究院开展校企对接。
summary_en: The base connects forming research, equipment development and piloting, with engagement by the Shanxi electromechanical institute.
actors_zh: 太原理工大学机械工程学院、中国机械总院山西机电研究院。
actors_en: Taiyuan University mechanical engineering school and CAM’s Shanxi electromechanical institute.
mechanism_zh: 企业实地考察中试设施，双方围绕联合科研、市场开拓和学术共建讨论合作。
mechanism_en: Industry visits to pilot facilities support discussions on joint research, market development and academic cooperation.
observed_zh: 2026年校方记录确认中试基地已被实地参观；常态化合作属于双方后续安排。
observed_en: The 2026 university account confirms a visit to the existing base; sustained cooperation is a follow-up arrangement.
constraints_zh: 参观和合作意向不证明订单或技术采用。
constraints_en: Visits and intentions do not establish orders or adoption.
transfer_zh: 把企业零件的试制性能与工艺交付列为共同验收内容。
transfer_en: Use industrial-part trials and process deliverables for joint acceptance.

title_zh: 乌干达工业研究所中试与企业服务
title_en: Uganda Industrial Research Institute piloting and enterprise services
summary_zh: 研究所将产品配方、分析测试、机械设计和中试加工能力向企业开放。
summary_en: UIRI offers firms formulation, analytical testing, machinery design and pilot processing.
actors_zh: 乌干达工业研究所、工业企业及创业团队。
actors_en: UIRI, industrial firms and entrepreneurs.
mechanism_zh: 试制、工程制造与孵化服务降低小企业获取研发设备的门槛。
mechanism_en: Prototyping, fabrication and incubation lower barriers to R&D equipment for smaller firms.
observed_zh: 官方服务说明列明中试、测试及企业培育职能。
observed_en: The official service description identifies piloting, testing and incubation.
constraints_zh: 孵化支持不能替代市场订单与稳定供应链。
constraints_en: Incubation cannot substitute for orders and reliable supply chains.
transfer_zh: 让试制批次与客户质量要求相衔接。
transfer_en: Align pilot batches with customer quality requirements.

title_zh: 武威重离子医疗工程转化
title_en: Wuwei heavy-ion medical engineering transfer
summary_zh: 加速器科研技术与专科医院应用衔接，形成重离子医疗装备的工程和临床接口。
summary_en: Accelerator research is connected to specialist-hospital applications, linking engineering and clinical use.
actors_zh: 中国科学院近代物理研究所、武威重离子中心、甘肃省武威肿瘤医院。
actors_en: Institute of Modern Physics, Wuwei heavy-ion centre and Gansu Wuwei tumour hospital.
mechanism_zh: 科研机构提供装备技术，医疗机构承接应用与临床运行。
mechanism_en: A research institute supplies equipment technology while a hospital hosts clinical operation.
observed_zh: 官方介绍列明技术来源、装备和医院应用主体。
observed_en: The official profile identifies technology provenance, equipment and the hospital operator.
constraints_zh: 设施运行不等于所有适应症均有相同疗效。
constraints_en: Facility operation does not establish equal efficacy across indications.
transfer_zh: 同步设置装备可靠性、临床证据和运维能力门槛。
transfer_en: Set requirements for equipment reliability, clinical evidence and maintenance.

title_zh: 智利先进矿业技术中心
title_en: Chile Advanced Mining Technology Center
summary_zh: 矿业研究中心向行业提供协作研发、技术合同及实验室测试服务。
summary_en: AMTC offers collaborative R&D, technology contracts and laboratory testing to mining.
actors_zh: 智利大学矿业研究团队、矿业企业和技术用户。
actors_en: University of Chile mining researchers, mining firms and technology users.
mechanism_zh: 与企业共同定义技术任务，并通过合同研发和许可承接成果。
mechanism_en: Industry co-defines technical tasks, with contract research and licensing supporting transfer.
observed_zh: 官方合作页面列明研发、测试和技术转移服务。
observed_en: The official collaboration page identifies R&D, testing and transfer services.
constraints_zh: 合同服务能力不证明所有矿场条件下均可部署。
constraints_en: Contract capability does not establish deployability under all mine conditions.
transfer_zh: 将矿场数据、现场验证和技术责任纳入合同。
transfer_en: Include mine data, field validation and technical responsibilities in contracts.

title_zh: 澳大利亚国家微纳加工开放设施
title_en: Australian National Fabrication Facility
summary_zh: 微纳加工设施网络向科研与产业用户提供设备、工艺专家和培训。
summary_en: The fabrication network gives research and industry users equipment, process specialists and training.
actors_zh: ANFF、大学设施团队、研究人员及企业。
actors_en: ANFF, university facility teams, researchers and firms.
mechanism_zh: 用户可直接使用设施或委托技术服务，降低专用设备投入门槛。
mechanism_en: Direct access or fee-for-service work reduces barriers to specialised equipment.
observed_zh: 官方页面明确开放使用及专业技术支持方式。
observed_en: The official page specifies access and specialist support routes.
constraints_zh: 开放准入仍需安全培训、排期及适当收费。
constraints_en: Open access still requires safety training, scheduling and appropriate fees.
transfer_zh: 把设备能力、工艺支持和企业交付周期结合。
transfer_en: Combine equipment capability, process support and industrial delivery schedules.

title_zh: 澳大利亚核科学机构产业设施服务
title_en: ANSTO industrial research-facility access
summary_zh: 科研设施与专家团队支持企业材料、制造及食品问题的测试与研发。
summary_en: Research facilities and specialists support industrial testing and R&D in materials, manufacturing and food.
actors_zh: ANSTO、企业研发团队及新南威尔士州技术支持计划。
actors_en: ANSTO, industrial R&D teams and NSW technology-support programmes.
mechanism_zh: 设施服务与企业合作结合，部分中小企业项目可通过配套资助接入。
mechanism_en: Facility services link to partnerships, with matched support available for some SME projects.
observed_zh: 官方产业页面列明设施、合作及技术券支持。
observed_en: The official industry page identifies facilities, collaboration and voucher support.
constraints_zh: 有条件资助不能视为所有产业服务免费。
constraints_en: Conditional support does not mean all industrial services are free.
transfer_zh: 按技术问题选择设施并预先约定交付和数据权益。
transfer_en: Select facilities by technical need and agree deliverables and data rights in advance.

title_zh: 包头稀土研究院产业协作
title_en: Baotou rare-earth institute industrial collaboration
summary_zh: 稀土研究院与当地实验室和技术平台参与成果发布、技术需求对接及稀土材料产业交流。
summary_en: The institute joins local laboratories and platforms in technology disclosures, demand matching and rare-earth materials exchanges.
actors_zh: 包头稀土研究院、鹿城实验室、稀土产业企业和地方科技部门。
actors_en: Baotou rare-earth institute, Lucheng Laboratory, rare-earth firms and local science authorities.
mechanism_zh: 专业技术机构嵌入稀土集群，以技术需求发布和路演连接研究与企业应用。
mechanism_en: Specialist institutions are embedded in the rare-earth cluster, linking research to applications through demand calls and demonstrations.
observed_zh: 2025年政府答复列明研究院参与的学术交流与科创会客厅活动。
observed_en: A 2025 government reply identifies institute participation in scientific exchanges and technology-matching events.
constraints_zh: 活动和合作意向不能据此换算为量产规模。
constraints_en: Events and agreements cannot be converted into manufacturing output.
transfer_zh: 围绕分离、功能材料和客户验证建立可追踪的工程任务。
transfer_en: Track engineering tasks in separation, functional materials and customer validation.

title_zh: 澳大利亚未来电池产业合作研究计划
title_en: Australia Future Battery Industries CRC programme
summary_zh: 合作研究计划围绕电池价值链组织产业、政府和科研投入。
summary_en: The CRC programme combines industrial, government and research inputs across the battery value chain.
actors_zh: 未来电池产业CRC、MRIWA、大学及产业伙伴。
actors_en: Future Battery Industries CRC, MRIWA, universities and industrial partners.
mechanism_zh: 跨机构共同研究连接矿物加工、电池材料及产业能力建设。
mechanism_en: Joint research connects mineral processing, battery materials and industrial capability development.
observed_zh: 官方项目记录给出2019至2025年项目期及支持安排。
observed_en: The official project record specifies a 2019–2025 period and support arrangements.
constraints_zh: 历史项目期不能作为2026年持续运行的证明。
constraints_en: The historical period does not establish continued operation in 2026.
transfer_zh: 按原料、材料和制造环节设置可交付研究节点。
transfer_en: Set deliverable milestones for feedstocks, materials and manufacturing.

title_zh: 博茨瓦纳技术研究与创新研究所
title_en: Botswana Institute for Technology Research and Innovation
summary_zh: 研究所围绕本地产业需求开展应用研究，提供材料分析和技术开发能力。
summary_en: BITRI undertakes needs-driven applied research and provides materials analysis and technology development.
actors_zh: BITRI、企业、公共部门及社区伙伴。
actors_en: BITRI, businesses, public bodies and community partners.
mechanism_zh: 专业实验设施与联合研发连接本地资源、工程问题和企业需求。
mechanism_en: Specialist facilities and collaborative R&D connect local resources, engineering problems and industrial demand.
observed_zh: 官方简介列出能源、材料及数字技术研究与合作职责。
observed_en: The official profile identifies energy, materials and digital research and collaboration functions.
constraints_zh: 研究职能不是企业采用或商业收入的证明。
constraints_en: Research functions do not establish adoption or commercial revenue.
transfer_zh: 优先围绕企业可验证的质量和加工瓶颈开展合作。
transfer_en: Prioritise verifiable industrial quality and processing bottlenecks.

title_zh: 燕山大学昌黎金属材料绿色智造研究院
title_en: Yanshan–Changli green intelligent metals institute
summary_zh: 大学与昌黎县共建研究院，面向当地金属材料和制造企业组织联合研发及中试。
summary_en: Yanshan University and Changli County co-establish an institute for metals/manufacturing R&D and piloting.
actors_zh: 燕山大学、昌黎县及金属材料、装备和冶金企业。
actors_en: Yanshan University, Changli County and metals, equipment and metallurgy firms.
mechanism_zh: 企业提出问题，研究团队组织研发，地方政府支持共享设施与人才合作。
mechanism_en: Companies define problems, researchers organise R&D and local government supports facilities and talent cooperation.
observed_zh: 研究院简介列明共建主体、五类技术方向与联合实验室安排。
observed_en: The profile names founders, five technical areas and joint-laboratory arrangements.
constraints_zh: 订单协作模式不证明各企业已经实现网络化制造。
constraints_en: The collaboration model does not establish networked manufacturing at every firm.
transfer_zh: 以企业工艺问题和中试交付形成可复核的共同任务。
transfer_en: Build auditable joint tasks around industrial process problems and pilot deliverables.

title_zh: 长春应化所化工新材料中试基地
title_en: Changchun applied-chemistry materials pilot base
summary_zh: 基地以生态高分子、聚烯烃和橡胶中试设施补充化学研究成果的工程化开发。
summary_en: Pilot facilities for ecological polymers, polyolefins and rubber support engineering of chemical research.
actors_zh: 长春应化所、科技总公司、吉林省科技部门和工业用户。
actors_en: CIAC, its technology company, Jilin science authorities and industrial users.
mechanism_zh: 研究所与转化企业共同建设中试中心，验收覆盖建设、运行和对外服务。
mechanism_en: Institute and transfer company develop pilots assessed for construction, operation and external services.
observed_zh: 官方记录确认三个中试中心通过验收；本库将其整体计为一个基地。
observed_en: The official account records acceptance of three centres, counted here as one pilot base.
constraints_zh: 材料放大需重新验证批次和工况，不因验收而免除企业验证。
constraints_en: Scale-up needs batch and operating-condition tests beyond facility acceptance.
transfer_zh: 将公共设备开放与具体工艺保密分开管理。
transfer_en: Manage public equipment access separately from confidential processes.

title_zh: 巴西国家能源与材料研究中心开放设施
title_en: Brazil CNPEM open research facilities
summary_zh: 研究中心结合开放设施、自主科研、创新支持和培训，服务学术与产业用户。
summary_en: CNPEM combines open facilities, in-house research, innovation support and training for academic and industrial users.
actors_zh: CNPEM、外部高校研究者及企业研发团队。
actors_en: CNPEM, external academic researchers and industrial R&D teams.
mechanism_zh: 先进设备与专家共同支持材料和能源问题的实验验证。
mechanism_en: Advanced equipment and specialists jointly support experimental validation in materials and energy.
observed_zh: 官网明确四类职能及对外设施使用安排。
observed_en: The official site specifies four functions and external facility access.
constraints_zh: 学术开放使用不代表所有商业保密项目免费。
constraints_en: Academic open access does not mean every confidential commercial project is free.
transfer_zh: 分别设置开放科研与专有研发的准入和成本规则。
transfer_en: Distinguish access and cost rules for open science and proprietary R&D.

title_zh: 赣江创新研究院稀土工程试验平台
title_en: Ganjiang rare-earth engineering research platform
summary_zh: 赣江创新院把稀土研究、材料化学、资源环境与工程试验能力集中配置，服务稀土关键技术任务。
summary_en: Ganjiang integrates rare-earth science, materials chemistry, resources/environment and engineering trials for critical technology tasks.
actors_zh: 中国科学院赣江创新研究院、院地合作方和稀土产业技术用户。
actors_en: Ganjiang Institute, regional partners and rare-earth technology users.
mechanism_zh: 建制化组织基础研究和工程试验，按国家与产业需求凝练研究任务。
mechanism_en: Institutional research and engineering trials are organised around national and industrial needs.
observed_zh: 2024年科学院记录确认工程试验中心和三类研究平台的现场调研。
observed_en: A 2024 CAS account documents the engineering trial centre and three research platforms.
constraints_zh: 平台存在不等于全部稀土工艺均已工业验证。
constraints_en: Facilities do not establish industrial validation of every rare-earth process.
transfer_zh: 把关键材料任务分解为可复现试验及企业联合验证。
transfer_en: Translate materials tasks into repeatable trials and joint industrial validation.

title_zh: 贵州铝产业工程技术创新中心
title_en: Guizhou aluminium engineering innovation centre
summary_zh: 贵州大学与成黔集团共同建立工程技术中心，围绕铝土矿开发与综合利用组织研究。
summary_en: Guizhou University and Chengqian Group jointly establish an engineering centre for bauxite development and utilisation.
actors_zh: 贵州大学、贵州成黔集团及矿业工程研究团队。
actors_en: Guizhou University, Chengqian Group and mining engineering researchers.
mechanism_zh: 大学工程团队与资源企业共建中心，连接研究方向和矿产应用问题。
mechanism_en: University engineers and a resource firm co-establish a centre linking research to mineral applications.
observed_zh: 2025年3月校方记录确认中心揭牌及资源开发、综合利用研究方向。
observed_en: A March 2025 university account confirms launch and research in resource development/utilisation.
constraints_zh: 成立中心不代表已有商业化工艺。
constraints_en: Centre establishment is not evidence of a commercial process.
transfer_zh: 以原料适配、回收率和环境指标约束联合研究任务。
transfer_en: Define joint tasks through feedstock compatibility, recovery and environmental measures.

title_zh: 嘉庚创新实验室材料转化平台
title_en: Jiageng Innovation Laboratory materials transfer
summary_zh: 实验室以材料研发、公共技术服务和企业孵化衔接能源材料研究与工业应用。
summary_en: The laboratory connects energy-materials research to industry through R&D, shared services and incubation.
actors_zh: 嘉庚创新实验室、材料与氢能研发团队及孵化企业。
actors_en: Jiageng Innovation Laboratory, materials/hydrogen teams and incubated firms.
mechanism_zh: 自动化材料研究与公共服务设施支持技术验证，创业企业承接成果。
mechanism_en: Automated materials research and shared facilities support validation, with spin-outs taking results forward.
observed_zh: 2026年省政府报道确认入选产业技术基础公共服务平台，并介绍氢能成果孵化。
observed_en: A 2026 government account confirms selection as an industrial technology public-service platform and hydrogen incubation.
constraints_zh: 入选平台不能证明所有技术已达到量产要求。
constraints_en: Platform recognition does not establish manufacturing readiness for every technology.
transfer_zh: 对研发、工程放大和客户认证分别设置验收节点。
transfer_en: Separate research, scale-up and customer qualification milestones.

title_zh: 澳大利亚矿产勘探合作研究中心
title_en: Australia MinEx Cooperative Research Centre
summary_zh: 中心围绕钻探效率、钻探同步数据和全国钻探计划开展产学研合作。
summary_en: The CRC collaborates on drilling efficiency, data during drilling and the National Drilling Initiative.
actors_zh: MinEx CRC、矿业及设备企业、政府地学机构和高校。
actors_en: MinEx CRC, mining/equipment firms, geological agencies and universities.
mechanism_zh: 企业工程需求与公共地学数据共同组织研究和现场验证。
mechanism_en: Industrial engineering needs and public geoscience data jointly shape research and field validation.
observed_zh: 官方介绍列明联合研究计划和勘探技术方向。
observed_en: The official profile identifies joint programmes and exploration technologies.
constraints_zh: 研究投入不能直接视为新矿发现或开采收益。
constraints_en: Research inputs are not discoveries or extraction returns.
transfer_zh: 分别评价设备性能、数据质量和现场成本。
transfer_en: Evaluate equipment performance, data quality and field costs separately.

title_zh: 南非矿物技术研究院技术转移
title_en: Mintek minerals technology transfer
summary_zh: 技术转移办公室把矿物加工研究与客户需求、许可及商业合作连接。
summary_en: Mintek’s transfer office connects mineral-processing research with customers, licensing and commercial collaboration.
actors_zh: Mintek、矿业客户、许可企业及合资伙伴。
actors_en: Mintek, mining customers, licensees and venture partners.
mechanism_zh: 后期研发适配客户工况，结合知识产权管理、许可和企业合作。
mechanism_en: Late-stage R&D adapts to customer conditions, supported by IP management, licensing and partnerships.
observed_zh: 官方转移页面列明许可、产品销售及合资等路径。
observed_en: The official transfer page identifies licensing, product sales and joint-venture routes.
constraints_zh: 不同矿石及工况需要重新验证。
constraints_en: Different ores and operating conditions require renewed validation.
transfer_zh: 把真实矿样和连续运行要求纳入转化合同。
transfer_en: Include actual ore samples and continuous-operation requirements in transfer contracts.

title_zh: 宁东现代煤化工中试基地
title_en: Ningdong modern coal-chemical pilot base
summary_zh: 基地向院所和企业提供化工中试熟化载体，支持煤基材料、精细化工、氢能与循环利用研发。
summary_en: The base hosts chemical piloting for institutes and firms in coal-derived materials, fine chemicals, hydrogen and circular processes.
actors_zh: 宁东管委会、宁东科创公司、入驻研发机构、高校与企业。
actors_en: Ningdong authority, its innovation operator, resident research institutes, universities and firms.
mechanism_zh: 通过驻地研发机构及联合设立机构提供研发、中试、工业试验、检测和市场服务。
mechanism_en: Resident and jointly established institutes offer R&D, piloting, industrial trials, testing and market services.
observed_zh: 官方支持政策列明机构准入退出与共性服务范围；资助条款不作为实施成果。
observed_en: Official rules specify entry/exit and shared services; funding provisions are not treated as achieved results.
constraints_zh: 化工安全与煤基路径排放须独立核验，不能由技术转化推断低碳。
constraints_en: Chemical safety and coal-pathway emissions need independent assessment; transfer is not proof of decarbonisation.
transfer_zh: 在中试验收中分别记录质量、连续运行、安全和全流程能耗。
transfer_en: Record quality, continuous operation, safety and process-wide energy use at pilot acceptance.

title_zh: 清源创新实验室共建中试
title_en: Qingyuan Innovation Laboratory joint piloting
summary_zh: 清源实验室与材料及环保企业共建研发和中试设施，衔接化工研究与制造。
summary_en: Qingyuan collaborates with materials and environmental firms on R&D and pilot facilities.
actors_zh: 清源创新实验室、福建纯铭材料、远致环保。
actors_en: Qingyuan Innovation Laboratory, Fujian Chunming Materials and Yuanzhi Environmental Protection.
mechanism_zh: 共建平台、中试及人才合作将企业问题转为联合工程任务。
mechanism_en: Shared platforms, piloting and talent collaboration turn industrial problems into joint engineering tasks.
observed_zh: 2026年官方报道列举材料中试平台和环保联合研发中心。
observed_en: A 2026 official account identifies a materials pilot platform and environmental joint R&D centre.
constraints_zh: 规划产值不是已经实现的产出。
constraints_en: Projected output is not realised production.
transfer_zh: 用企业试用与连续工艺验证评价共建平台。
transfer_en: Evaluate joint platforms through industrial trials and continuous-process validation.

title_zh: 新西兰罗宾逊研究所超导工程合作
title_en: New Zealand Robinson superconducting engineering collaboration
summary_zh: 研究所把超导、低温及材料研究与工业工程和商业化合作结合。
summary_en: The institute connects superconductivity, cryogenics and materials research with industrial engineering and commercialisation.
actors_zh: 惠灵顿维多利亚大学罗宾逊研究所及产业伙伴。
actors_en: Victoria University of Wellington’s Robinson institute and industrial partners.
mechanism_zh: 物理与工程团队共同面向设备和电气应用开展研发。
mechanism_en: Physics and engineering teams jointly undertake R&D for equipment and electrical applications.
observed_zh: 官方研究所资料介绍产业协作及超导应用方向。
observed_en: Official institute material identifies industrial collaboration and superconducting applications.
constraints_zh: 先进材料性能不等于整套设备具有经济优势。
constraints_en: Material performance does not establish system-level economic advantage.
transfer_zh: 把材料验证延伸至设备效率、可靠性和维护。
transfer_en: Extend validation to equipment efficiency, reliability and maintenance.

title_zh: 云南稀贵金属材料基因工程协同平台
title_en: Yunnan rare/precious-metal materials-genome collaboration
summary_zh: 材料基因工程以计算、制备表征和数据平台支持企业主导的材料研发与验证。
summary_en: Materials-genome infrastructure supports enterprise-led materials R&D and validation through computation, characterisation and data.
actors_zh: 云南科技部门、材料企业、高校院所及材料研发平台。
actors_en: Yunnan science authorities, materials firms, research institutes/universities and R&D platforms.
mechanism_zh: 政产学研用协同组织，推进材料数据共享及验证性应用，连接资源产业与数据驱动研发。
mechanism_en: Government–industry–research coordination connects data sharing, application trials and resource industries.
observed_zh: 2023年科技厅绩效反馈确认一期平台和数据库已建成，二期应用为后续任务。
observed_en: A 2023 authority review identifies completed first-phase platforms/databases and subsequent application tasks.
constraints_zh: 数据库积累不自动缩短产业研发周期。
constraints_en: Data accumulation does not automatically shorten industrial development cycles.
transfer_zh: 用同一材料的性能、试验周期和工艺复现检验共享数据价值。
transfer_en: Assess data value through material performance, trial duration and process reproducibility.

title_zh: 南昌智能新能源汽车研究院
title_en: Nanchang intelligent new-energy vehicle institute
summary_zh: 研究院把同济大学科研能力与江西汽车企业连接，围绕新能源动力、线控底盘和汽车材料孵化企业。
summary_en: The institute links Tongji research with Jiangxi automotive firms and incubates ventures in powertrains, drive-by-wire and materials.
actors_zh: 南昌智能新能源汽车研究院、同济大学、江铃及孵化企业。
actors_en: The Nanchang institute, Tongji University, JMC and incubated firms.
mechanism_zh: 新型研发机构按市场节奏开展项目决策、转化和投资，让技术进入本地产品链。
mechanism_en: A new R&D operator combines market-facing project decisions, transfer and investment to enter local product chains.
observed_zh: 2026年政府报道列出三家孵化企业及线控底盘在江铃车型中的应用。
observed_en: A 2026 government report names three incubated firms and drive-by-wire use in JMC vehicles.
constraints_zh: 具体车型采用不能外推到所有孵化技术。
constraints_en: Adoption in specific vehicles cannot be generalised to all incubated technologies.
transfer_zh: 由整车用户共同定义功能、可靠性和量产适配要求。
transfer_en: Let vehicle users jointly define function, reliability and production requirements.
